highlights.zh: Sail Rock 的烟囱穿越
highlights.en: The chimney swim-through at Sail Rock

highlights.zh: 浅礁多，考证与复习潜都方便
highlights.en: Plenty of shallow reefs for courses and refreshers

notes: 季节：SSI 博客与 Dive The World 均写 3–9 月最佳；Big Blue（当地潜店）写 2–5 月为黄金期、6–9 月西南季风仅东岸可潜、12–1 月东北季风海况差、10–11 月安静但能见度一般。取 3–9。鲸鲨：SSI 3–4 月，Big Blue 3–5 月，DTW 同时写 2–4 月和'9 月最多'。能见度：Big Blue 旺季常 >25 m，DTW 5–20 m，取 10–25。Chumphon Pinnacle 与沉船需 AOW，整体仍按 OW 标。坐标为涛岛岛心，Chumphon Pinnacle 约在 [99.79, 10.17]。

summary.zh: 山都望乘快艇约75分钟到二战日本沉船 Katori Maru（约22米）与 Hiyoshi Maru（约21米），需进阶证书，流强、能见度常偏低；季节约4–9月。附近沙当岛为海龟保护区。
summary.en: Two WWII Japanese wrecks sunk by Dutch submarines lie about 75 min by fast boat from Santubong: Katori Maru (22 m) and the more intact Hiyoshi Maru (21 m, deck 16 m). Advanced certification needed; strong current and low visibility are common. Season roughly April to September. The nearby Satang islands are a turtle sanctuary.

highlights.zh: 二战日本沉船
highlights.en: WWII Japanese wrecks

highlights.zh: 需进阶证书
highlights.en: Advanced divers only

highlights.zh: 沙当岛海龟保护区
highlights.en: Satang turtle sanctuary

notes: Wreck details came via search extracts of these two pages, not full reads. Borneo Post (2016) reports salvagers destroyed much of Katori Maru. Satang macro and turtle species are not from the cited pages (Talang-Satang is a known turtle park); verify. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 泰国最南端小岛，属塔鲁陶海洋公园，巴克巴拉码头快艇约 90 分钟。Stonehenge 是 5–7 米浅台地，软珊瑚密集；8 Mile Rock 为外海暗礁，流急，偶见鲸鲨。
summary.en: Small island at Thailand's southern tip in Tarutao National Marine Park, about 90 minutes by speedboat from Pak Bara (via Hat Yai), or by ferry from Langkawi in high season. Stonehenge is a 5–7 m plateau of boulders thick with soft coral, best near slack tide. 8 Mile Rock is an offshore pinnacle with strong currents and occasional whale sharks, for advanced divers.

highlights.zh: Stonehenge：5–7 米巨石台地，软珊瑚密集
highlights.en: Stonehenge: 5–7 m boulder plateau covered in soft coral

highlights.zh: 8 Mile Rock：外海暗礁，流急，偶见鲸鲨
highlights.en: 8 Mile Rock: offshore pinnacle, strong current, occasional whale sharks

highlights.zh: Koh Taru：浅水避风，海马与夜潜
highlights.en: Koh Taru: sheltered shallows, seahorses and night dives

highlights.zh: 各潜点常见绿海龟
highlights.en: Green turtles common across sites

notes: Season: Southeast Asia Diving says Nov–Apr, Dive Happy Nov–May; May–Oct monsoon limits which sites are reachable. Avoid 8 Mile Rock around full/new moon (strong, shifting current, per search snippets). Uses new species id 'seahorse' (Koh Taru).

summary.zh: 沙巴西北三岛，亚庇车程约 1.5 小时到哥打毕律，再坐船约 40 分钟。约 16 个潜点，浅礁适合初学，常见海蛞蝓、海马；附近有二战沉船。儒艮现已罕见。
summary.en: Three islands off northwest Sabah: drive about 1.5 hours from Kota Kinabalu to Kota Belud, then roughly 40 minutes by boat. About 16 sites; shallow reefs suit beginners, with nudibranchs, seahorses and blue-ringed octopus. WWII wrecks lie near Usukan. Dugongs, once regular, are now rarely seen. Visibility can reach 40 m in season.

highlights.zh: 浅礁适合考证与体验潜水
highlights.en: Shallow reefs for courses and try dives

highlights.zh: Usukan 附近三处沉船
highlights.en: Three wrecks near Usukan

highlights.zh: 旺季能见度可达 40 米
highlights.en: Visibility up to 40 m in season

highlights.zh: 小岛是海龟筑巢地
highlights.en: Turtle nesting on Mantanani Kecil

notes: Only one source read gives the season (Wonderful Malaysia: best Apr–Sep, visibility best Mar–Sep, Oct–Mar boats may cancel); Sabah Tourism confirms location/access (Kuala Abai jetty, Kota Belud) but no season. Search snippets put it Mar–Oct. Dugong sightings historically Sep–Nov but now very rare (several reports), so dugong is not listed. Uses new species id 'seahorse'. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 缅甸南部近乎无人的群岛，只能从泰国拉廊船宿前往。Black Rock 峭壁有蝠鲼、鬼蝠鲼与多种鲨鱼，Western Rocky 有穿岛隧道，Burma Banks 是深海平顶山放流，流大水深。
summary.en: An almost uninhabited archipelago off southern Myanmar, reached only by liveaboard from Ranong in Thailand. Black Rock's walls draw mantas, mobulas and several shark species, Western Rocky has a tunnel through the island, and the Burma Banks are seamount drift dives. Currents are strong; operators want AOW and logged dives.

highlights.zh: Black Rock 的蝠鲼、鬼蝠鲼群与白顶、银顶鲨
highlights.en: Mantas, mobula schools and whitetip/silvertip sharks at Black Rock

highlights.zh: Western Rocky 的穿岛隧道与护士鲨
highlights.en: The island tunnel and nurse sharks at Western Rocky

highlights.zh: Burma Banks 的深海平顶山放流
highlights.en: Seamount drift dives at the Burma Banks

highlights.zh: 2–5 月鲸鲨机会最高，但能见度会被浮游生物拉低
highlights.en: Whale sharks most likely Feb–May, at the cost of visibility

notes: 季节：liveaboard.com 写 10–5 月、最佳 12–4 月；DTW 写船宿仅 11 月–5 月初运营、最佳 12–4 月；取 12–4。鲸鲨/蝠鲼 2–5 月（DTW、liveaboard.com），此时浮游生物多、能见度下降（DTW 摘要 5–40 m，取 15–35）。水温 26–27 季初升至约 30 季末（DTW、liveaboard.com）。船从拉廊/考拉/普吉出发，在高当（Kawthaung）办缅甸入境；Master Liveaboards 2027–28 班期列海洋公园与港口费 US$280 + 签证费 US$50，要求 AOW + 30 潜并推荐高氧，liveaboard.com 称多数船要约 50 潜。坐标为高当港（缅方入境口岸，也是群岛门户）；Black Rock 本体在其西北约 160 km（DTW '100 miles NW of Kawthaung'），各来源均无 GPS，未敢填。DTW 另提 High Rock 以南多数岛屿对潜水船关闭、Shark Cave 的灰礁鲨近年少见。缅甸局势会影响成行，出发前向船公司核实。

summary.zh: 越南潜水业的大本营，潜点集中在近岸的 Hon Mun 海洋保护区。没有大货，看的是海蛞蝓、娃娃鱼、狮子鱼和洞穴里的巨型海鳗；4–5 月水最清，10 月到次年 1 月雨季停潜。
summary.en: Vietnam's main dive town, with nearly all diving inside the small Hon Mun marine protected area just offshore. No big animals here; the draw is macro: nudibranchs, frogfish, lionfish and giant morays in the caverns. Water is clearest in April–May, and the rainy season stops diving from October to January.

highlights.zh: Moray Beach 的霓虹海蛞蝓与黑色娃娃鱼
highlights.en: Neon nudibranchs and black frogfish at Moray Beach

highlights.zh: Madonna Rock 的洞穴与巨型海鳗
highlights.en: Caverns and giant morays at Madonna Rock

highlights.zh: Hon Mun Wall 的直壁，偶有梭鱼经过
highlights.en: The vertical Hon Mun Wall, with the occasional barracuda

notes: 季节：越南国家旅游局网站写潜季约 2–9 月、最佳 4–5 月、10–1 月雨季、11 月最差（多数潜店停航），逐月能见度表 4–5 月 15–20 m、9 月已降到 5–10 m；Rough Guides 写 3–10 月、Hon Mun Wall 11–1 月避开。取 3–8。该官方页另称夏季偶有蝠鲼/鲸鲨经过，无其他来源佐证，未采纳。水温 1–2 月 24–25、潜季 26–29（官方页）。Hon Mun 为越南第一个海洋保护区（2001），约 8 km 离岸，有门票；搜索摘要称潜导配比最多 1:2。Hon Mun Wall 与 Madonna Rock 需一定经验，整体按 OW 标。新增物种 frogfish 目前仅此站使用。坐标为 Hon Mun 岛。

summary.zh: 芭提雅港乘船约90分钟到HTMS Khram沉船，顶部约15米、坐底约30米，外侧常见梭鱼群，适合进阶潜水员；格兰岛浅滩适合体验潜。能见度通常5–15米，流可能较强。
summary.en: HTMS Khram, a former Thai navy landing ship between Koh Larn and Koh Phai, sits upright at about 30 m with its top at 15 m; barracuda often school outside the hull. About 90 min by boat from Pattaya; currents can be strong and visibility is usually 5–15 m. Koh Larn's shallow coral suits try dives.

highlights.zh: HTMS Khram沉船
highlights.en: HTMS Khram wreck

highlights.zh: 船外梭鱼群
highlights.en: Barracuda schools by the hull

highlights.zh: 格兰岛体验潜
highlights.en: Koh Larn try dives

notes: Source covers Khram only, not HTMS Sarasin. Coords sit on Koh Larn; the Khram lies ~10 km west near Koh Phai. Wreck penetration needs wreck training. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 兰卡威以南约35公里的海洋公园岛屿，从瓜埠乘船前往；水域平静，浅礁有软珊瑚花园，浮台附近常见幼年黑鳍礁鲨，能见度通常一般。公园限人数并有定期闭园，需经持证营运商预订。
summary.en: A marine park island 35 km south of Langkawi, reached by boat from Kuah. Sheltered shallow reefs with a soft-coral garden; juvenile blacktip reef sharks are common near the floating platform. Visibility is usually modest. Visitor caps and seasonal closures apply, so book through a registered operator.

highlights.zh: 幼年黑鳍礁鲨
highlights.en: Juvenile blacktip reef sharks

highlights.zh: 软珊瑚花园
highlights.en: Soft-coral garden

highlights.zh: 浅水平静，适合浮潜
highlights.en: Calm shallows for snorkelling

notes: Wikipedia says after bleaching closures the park caps visitors at 100/week, closes Tue–Wed and Mar–May; confirm current rules. Best months inferred (dry NE-monsoon months outside the closure). Blacktip sightings come from operator snippets, not the cited page. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 马来西亚东北角的两座小岛，背包客和考证新手的大本营。浅礁、糖船沉船和 Tokong Laut 岩峰之间，绿海龟几乎天天见；季风期 11 月到次年 2 月全岛停摆。
summary.en: Two small islands off Malaysia's north-east corner, a long-time base for backpackers and new divers. Shallow reefs, the Sugar Wreck and the Tokong Laut pinnacle deliver green turtles on most days, with blacktip and bamboo sharks for the patient. Everything closes for the monsoon from November to February.

highlights.zh: Tokong Laut 岩峰的隧道与海龟
highlights.en: Tunnels and turtles at the Tokong Laut pinnacle

highlights.zh: 糖船沉船（Sugar Wreck）
highlights.en: The Sugar Wreck

highlights.zh: D'Lagoon 的放流与绿海龟
highlights.en: Drift dives and green turtles at D'Lagoon

highlights.zh: Long Beach 岸潜夜潜
highlights.en: Shore night dives off Long Beach

notes: 季节：PADI Travel 3–10 月（旺季 6–8）；Divernet 开岛 3 月初–10 月中、最佳 4–9 月、水最清 7–9 月；Diveplanit 3–10 月、旺季 5–8 月、11–2 月海况差避开。取 4–9，3 月与 10 月为肩季。水温 28–31 来自 Diveplanit；能见度 PADI 常达 20、Diveplanit 可超 25 但雨后颗粒多，取 10–25。玳瑁来源为 Divernet 写的邻岛 Lang Tengah 玳瑁与绿海龟 4–8 月产卵。坐标为大小停泊岛之间的海峡。

summary.zh: 越南西南端的度假大岛，潜水以考证和轻松潜为主。南端 An Thoi 群岛的十几座小岛潜点最多，水深 5–25 米，看软硬珊瑚和海蛞蝓，偶有蓝点魟和竹鲨；西北的海龟岛水浅不过 10 米，适合新手和浮潜。
summary.en: A large resort island off Vietnam's southwest coast, where diving is mostly courses and easy reef dives. The better sites are around the 15 islets of the An Thoi archipelago off the southern tip, at 5–25 m, with hard and soft corals and nudibranchs, plus the odd blue-spotted ray or bamboo shark. Turtle Island in the northwest is rarely deeper than 10 m and suits beginners and snorkellers.

highlights.zh: An Thoi 群岛的珊瑚礁，水深 5–25 米
highlights.en: Coral reefs of the An Thoi islets, 5–25 m

highlights.zh: 海蛞蝓、乌贼、章鱼等小型生物
highlights.en: Small life: nudibranchs, cuttlefish, octopus

highlights.zh: 西北的海龟岛水浅，适合新手与浮潜
highlights.en: Shallow Turtle Island in the northwest for beginners and snorkellers

notes: 季节：越南国家旅游局潜水合集页、Rough Guides（An Thoi 与 Turtle Island 两节都写 11–5 月、6–10 月避开）、VnExpress（2023）均写 11–5 月；PADI Travel 写旱季 10–5 月、最佳 10–4 月。按旅游局取 11–5。水温 VnExpress 26–29、PADI 28–31，取 26–31。能见度：打开的来源都没给数字；搜索摘要里 localvietnam 写平静时 10–20 m（12–3 月）、phuquocislandguide 写'最多 4 m'，按 5–15 估，待补。潜店会按海况在西北岸与南端之间选（搜索摘要）。物种：PADI 列软硬珊瑚、海蛞蝓、乌贼、章鱼、蝎子鱼，偶见竹鲨、海蛇、蓝点魟；Rough Guides 写 An Thoi 有脑珊瑚和柳珊瑚、偶有蓝点魟与竹鲨；旅游局与 VnExpress 提到海马，物种表没有对应条目，未新增；VnExpress 写西岸 Doi Moi 岛可见海龟（未写种类），未加。没有招牌大货，species 只放珊瑚与海蛞蝓。交通：经胡志明市转机或少数国际直飞，迪石（Rach Gia）快船 1.5–2.5 h（PADI）；潜水船从 An Thoi 港出发，到主要潜点约 45 分钟（Rough Guides）；Turtle Island 从 Ganh Dau 或 Dinh Cau 码头出发 30–45 分钟。坐标为南端 An Thoi 港（约值；Wikipedia 只给了全岛坐标 10.23, 103.95）。

summary.zh: 普吉日潜从查龙湾出发，分两条线。往南是大小皇帝岛：大皇帝岛坡缓水浅，是考证主场；小皇帝岛更深、流更强，偶有蝠鲼。往东是鲨鱼点、海葵礁和 1997 年沉没的 King Cruiser 渡轮，常一天潜完。
summary.en: Phuket's day boats leave Chalong Bay on two main routes. South are the Racha islands: Racha Yai's gentle slopes host much of the island's training, while deeper, current-swept Racha Noi gets occasional mantas. East, Shark Point, Anemone Reef and the King Cruiser, a car ferry that sank in 1997 and lies at up to 30 m, are usually combined in one day.

highlights.zh: 大皇帝岛的缓坡浅礁，考证与复习潜的主场
highlights.en: Racha Yai's gentle reefs, the main training ground

highlights.zh: 小皇帝岛南角放流，偶有蝠鲼与鲸鲨
highlights.en: Drift dives off Racha Noi's south point, with occasional mantas and whale sharks

highlights.zh: 鲨鱼点沙地上休息的豹纹鲨
highlights.en: Leopard sharks resting on the sand at Shark Point

highlights.zh: King Cruiser 渡轮沉船，16–30 米，常有流
highlights.en: King Cruiser ferry wreck, 16–30 m, often with current

notes: 季节：DTW 写全年可潜、高季 11–4 月且越往后越好，6–9 月低季多雨浪大，普吉船宿 10 月底–5 月中；PADI Travel 普吉页写最佳 11–4 月、2–3 月尤佳。取 11–4。PADI 中文博客称岸潜只在 11–4 月可行（岸潜未收入本条）。距离：SSI 写大皇帝岛在普吉以南 12 海里、小皇帝岛 20 海里；DTW 写 Shark Point 在查龙湾以东约 25 km；PADI 中文博客写去大小皇帝岛船程约 2 小时。深度：SSI 写大皇帝岛最深 21 m、小皇帝岛 30 m 以上、King Cruiser 16–30 m（1997 年沉没的汽车渡轮）；DTW 写大皇帝岛 3–30 m、小皇帝岛常从 18 m 起潜、King Cruiser 约 30 m 且'不适合完全新手'。PADI 中文博客称 Shark Point 自 1992 年起为海洋生态保护区。物种出处：蝠鲼、偶见鲸鲨、鲹鱼群在小皇帝岛（DTW）；豹纹鲨在 Shark Point（DTW、SSI、PADI 中文）；玳瑁在 Anemone Reef 与 King Cruiser（DTW）。水温 26°C（1–2 月）–30°C（5–6 月，DTW）；能见度 DTW 汇总 5–40 m，取 10–30。中文名：PADI 中文博客写'大小皇帝岛'、'鲨鱼角/鲨鱼点'、'海葵礁'，King Cruiser 被译作'宋神号沉船'，不通行，正文保留英文。等级：大皇帝岛 OW 即可，小皇帝岛南角与 King Cruiser 要进阶，整体按 OW 标。与 koh-phi-phi 的 Hin Bida（皮皮岛鲨鱼点）不是同一处。坐标为 Ko Racha 群岛（Wikipedia 7.6106, 98.3632），查龙码头约在 [98.34, 7.82]。

summary.zh: 登嘉楼海洋公园里的度假岛，白沙滩配清澈浅水，三十多个潜点多数不深，新手友好。北岸 Chagar Hutang 是受保护的海龟产卵地，绿海龟 5–7 月上岸最多；季风期 11–2 月基本关岛。
summary.en: A resort island inside the Terengganu Marine Park: white sand, clear shallow water and more than 30 easy dive sites. Chagar Hutang on the north shore is a protected turtle beach where green turtle nesting peaks from May to July. The island largely closes for the monsoon from November to February.

highlights.zh: 多数潜点都能遇到绿海龟
highlights.en: Green turtles on most dives

highlights.zh: 杰克鱼与梭鱼群绕礁
highlights.en: Trevally and barracuda schools around the reefs

highlights.zh: 海洋公园中心的浅水沉船可浮潜
highlights.en: A shallow wreck off the Marine Park Centre, snorkelable

highlights.zh: 黑鳍礁鲨与隆头鹦哥鱼
highlights.en: Blacktip reef sharks and bumphead parrotfish

notes: 季节：PADI Travel 写 3–10 月、旺季 6–8 月、11–2 月关闭；Wonderful Malaysia 写 4–10 月最佳、'10 月可能已太晚'、季风 11–3 月（仅 Taaras 一家度假村不关）。取 4–9 作为稳妥月份，3 月与 10 月为肩季。官方海洋公园网站（marinepark.dof.gov.my）维护中打不开，搜索摘要称其写东北季风 11–3 月。海龟：The Star 写 Chagar Hutang 由 UMT 海龟研究组（SEATRU）自 1993 年研究、2005 年设保护区，年产卵约 1,000–1,500 窝；产卵 5–9 月、高峰 5–7 月来自搜索摘要，保护区禁止一般旅游活动，只能参加度假村安排的教育行程。水温无直接来源，参照同海岸停泊岛 28–31 取 28–30。能见度 PADI 20–30、搜索摘要 18–20，取 15–30。坐标为 Pasir Panjang 海滩一带。

summary.zh: 素林国家公园里一座孤立的马蹄形石灰岩礁，岩顶贴近水面，底部约 35 米。2–4 月浮游生物多时常有鲸鲨来访，但不保证；没有鲸鲨的日子，海马、小丑虾、剃刀鱼和成群的梭鱼也够潜好几次。
summary.en: A lone horseshoe of limestone in Mu Ko Surin National Park, its top just under the surface and its base near 35 m. When plankton peaks from February to April whale sharks visit often, though never reliably; on other days seahorses, harlequin shrimp, ghost pipefish and chevron barracuda fill several dives. Currents vary, and most divers come on Khao Lak liveaboards or long speedboat day trips.

highlights.zh: 2–4 月鲸鲨机会最高，蝠鲼偶尔来清洁站
highlights.en: Best whale shark odds Feb–Apr; mantas visit the cleaning stations

highlights.zh: 海马、小丑虾、剃刀鱼等微距
highlights.en: Macro: seahorses, harlequin shrimp, ghost pipefish

highlights.zh: 岩顶周围的梭鱼与鲹鱼群
highlights.en: Chevron barracuda and trevally schools around the top

highlights.zh: 可从 Khao Lak 坐快艇一日往返
highlights.en: Doable as a speedboat day trip from Khao Lak

notes: 季节：thainationalparks（素林国家公园页）写公园 10/15–5/15 开放、天气差可能提前关闭；DTW 写 10 月–5 月初、5 月–10 月初海况差关闭；liveaboard.com 写 10–5 月以外禁潜。bestMonths 与 similan 条目一致取 11–4，10 月下半月与 5 月上半月为肩季。鲸鲨/蝠鲼 2–4 月（DTW、liveaboard.com 一致），3–4 月浮游生物多、能见度下降。坐标取 thainationalparks 页给出的 9.36277, 98.02194（该页称礁体约在素林群岛东南 18 km、离岸 45 km，最深约 28 m；DTW 写 5–35 m，liveaboard.com 写最大 35 m）。到达：DTW 写 Khao Lak 快艇 1–2 h、船宿 3–4 h、建议至少 3 天；liveaboard.com FAQ 写一日游单程 2.5–3 h、船宿通常 4 晚起；三处给的距离（40/70/80 km）互相矛盾，正文不写距离。等级：DTW intermediate–advanced，liveaboard.com 'more advanced'，thainationalparks 称新手也可，取 AOW。水温 26–29（DTW）；能见度 DTW 15–35、liveaboard.com 浮游生物爆发时约 9 m，PADI 中文潜点页写平日 10–15、晴天可到 35，取 10–30。frogfish 只有 liveaboard.com 提到，未写进 species。单独成条的理由：Khao Lak 有专跑黎塞留岩的快艇一日游，素林方向的船宿也以它为主卖点；similan 条目 highlights 第一条目前写的就是 Richelieu Rock，合并时建议把那条换掉以免重复。中文名：SSI 中文博客写'黎塞留岩'，PADI 中文页'黎塞留岩石'，liveaboard.com 中文页'瑞察硫岩'，网上也见'理查德岩'（误译）；取黎塞留岩，不加括号别名。素林国家公园门票成人 500 THB（thainationalparks）。

summary.zh: 西港外海群岛。高龙撒冷岛快艇约 40 分钟，浅礁适合初学，常见海马、海蛞蝓；更远的 Koh Tang 多为过夜船潜，水更清，可夜潜。6–9 月季风影响大。
summary.en: Islands off Sihanoukville. Koh Rong Samloem, about 40 minutes by speedboat, has shallow reefs for beginners with seahorses, nudibranchs and horned sea stars. Remote Koh Tang and Koh Prins, best on overnight boats, offer clearer water, barracuda and night dives at sites like Stingray Alley. The June–September monsoon limits diving.

highlights.zh: 高龙撒冷岛 Secret Garden 等浅礁看海马
highlights.en: Seahorses on Koh Rong Samloem reefs such as Secret Garden

highlights.zh: Nudibranch Heaven 微距
highlights.en: Nudibranch Heaven for macro

highlights.zh: Koh Tang 过夜船潜，能见度 10–30 米
highlights.en: Koh Tang overnight trips, 10–30 m visibility

highlights.zh: Koh Prins 峭壁放流超过 30 米
highlights.en: Koh Prins Drop Off: wall drift below 30 m

notes: Season: Adventure in You says dry season Nov–May is best (diving year-round); Private Scuba says heaviest monsoon Jun–Sep. Whale sharks reported at Koh Prins in Dec and May (one source only, not listed). Koh Tang boat time differs by origin: ~2 h from Koh Rong Samloem, ~4–6 h from Sihanoukville. Uses new species id 'seahorse'. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 苏梅、帕岸与涛岛之间的孤立花岗岩礁，三岛都有船去。最深 40 米，烟囱从约 18 米斜穿到 6 米；常见梭鱼、鲹鱼群，3–4 月与 9–10 月常有鲸鲨。流可较强。
summary.en: An isolated granite pinnacle between Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Koh Tao, with daily boats from all three. Max depth 40 m, a training ledge at 12 m, and the Chimney swim-through from about 18 m up to 6 m. Barracuda, trevally and batfish schools are common; whale sharks are often seen in March–April and September–October. Currents can be moderate to strong.

highlights.zh: 烟囱：约 18 米斜穿到 6 米，内有玻璃鱼
highlights.en: The Chimney: swim-through from about 18 m to 6 m, glassfish inside

highlights.zh: 梭鱼、鲹鱼、燕鱼群
highlights.en: Barracuda, trevally and batfish schools

highlights.zh: 3–4 月、9–10 月鲸鲨较多
highlights.en: Whale sharks mostly March–April and September–October

highlights.zh: 安通海洋公园 Ang Thong Pinnacle 放流
highlights.en: Ang Thong Pinnacle drift in the marine park

notes: Season: Dive The World says Samui peak Mar–Sep (Nov–Feb NE monsoon, visibility can drop to ~10 m); Big Blue says no fixed season, Mar–Apr best visibility. Chimney entry depth differs (18 m vs ~20 m). Sources are dive operators. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 安达曼海的花岗岩巨石与珊瑚坡，国家公园每年只在 10 月中到 5 月中开放，需提前买电子票。船宿通常一路北上到 Koh Bon 与 Richelieu Rock，蝠鲼和鲸鲨多在 2–4 月出现。
summary.en: Granite boulders and coral slopes in the Andaman Sea. The national park opens only from mid-October to mid-May and now requires an e-ticket. Liveaboards usually push north to Koh Bon and Richelieu Rock, where mantas and whale sharks are most likely from February to April.

highlights.zh: Richelieu Rock：鲸鲨热点，2–4 月浮游生物多时机会最大
highlights.en: Richelieu Rock: whale shark hotspot, best odds Feb–Apr

highlights.zh: Koh Bon 的蝠鲼清洁站
highlights.en: Manta cleaning station at Koh Bon

highlights.zh: 沙地上休息的豹纹鲨，多数船宿都能见到
highlights.en: Leopard sharks resting on sand, seen on most trips

highlights.zh: Elephant Head Rock 的巨石迷宫与穿越
highlights.en: Boulder swim-throughs at Elephant Head Rock

notes: 公园开放 10/15–5/15（thainationalparks 与 liveaboard.com FAQ 一致；Thaiger 报道 2025 年闭园 5/16–10/14），天气差的年份可能提前关闭；每日限额约 3,325 人，须提前买电子票。Dive The World 写船宿运营'11 月初–5 月初'，故 bestMonths 取 11–4，10 月与 5 月为肩季。鲸鲨/蝠鲼 2–4 月（DTW Richelieu 页、liveaboard.com）。Richelieu Rock 行政上属素林国家公园；Koh Tachai 岛本体 2016 年起关闭，周边潜点仍可潜。水温 26–29（DTW）与 28–30（liveaboard FAQ）合并为 26–30。等级由种子 OW 改为 AOW：DTW 两页均写 intermediate–advanced，Richelieu / Koh Bon / Elephant Head 深且有流；东侧礁坡（Anita's Reef 等）OW 可潜。坐标沿用种子（8 号岛 Koh Similan）；Richelieu Rock 约在 [98.02, 9.37]。

summary.zh: 攀牙府外海五岛国家公园，库拉布里码头或考拉出发，通常 10 月中至 5 月中开放。浅礁适合浮潜，常见海龟；可参观莫肯族村。船宿常顺路去黎塞留岩。
summary.en: Five-island national park about 55 km off Phang Nga, reached from Khura Buri pier or Khao Lak and usually open mid-October to mid-May. Shallow reefs suit snorkellers and turtles are often seen; the Moken village at Ao Bon Yai can be visited. Liveaboards usually pair it with nearby Richelieu Rock. Whale sharks and mantas are rare, best February–April.

highlights.zh: 浅礁浮潜，公园每天两趟浮潜船
highlights.en: Shallow-reef snorkelling, two park boat trips a day

highlights.zh: Ao Bon Yai 莫肯族村
highlights.en: Moken village at Ao Bon Yai

highlights.zh: 绿海龟与玳瑁上岛筑巢
highlights.en: Green and hawksbill turtles nest here

highlights.zh: 船宿顺路黎塞留岩
highlights.en: Paired with Richelieu Rock on liveaboards

notes: Opening dates vary by year: Wikipedia 15 Oct–15 May (may close early), Andaman Discoveries Oct–May / closed 30 Apr–1 Nov. Wikipedia gives best diving Dec–Apr; bestMonths 11–4 is the overlap. Some areas are closed to diving for conservation. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 登嘉楼外海小岛，龙运码头快艇约 1 小时。二十多个潜点多为峭壁与巨石，流常较强，适合进阶；海龟常见，8–10 月常有鲸鲨经过。11 月至 3 月初封岛。
summary.en: Small island off Terengganu, about an hour by speedboat from Kuala Dungun. Its twenty-odd sites are mostly walls and boulders with strong currents, suited to advanced divers. Turtles are common; whale sharks often pass in August–October, most often at Tokong Timur. The island closes to visitors from November to early March.

highlights.zh: Tokong Timur：鲸鲨最常出现，最深约 25 米
highlights.en: Tokong Timur: likeliest whale-shark site, max about 25 m

highlights.zh: Tanjung Api：急流高速放流
highlights.en: Tanjung Api: fast drift dive in strong current

highlights.zh: Gua Rajawali：洞穴与穿越
highlights.en: Gua Rajawali: caverns and swim-throughs

highlights.zh: 海龟常在岩架上休息
highlights.en: Turtles resting on rocky shelves

notes: Season (closed 1 Nov–1 Mar by Dept of Fisheries; diving mid-Mar–Oct; whale sharks Aug–mid-Oct, peak Sep) is from Asia Dive Holidays only; search snippets from other operators (XTVT Aug–Oct, TDB Jul–Sep, Ocean9 Jun–Aug) roughly agree but were not read. Bumphead parrotfish from the selection note was not confirmed by either source, so it is not listed. Most sites rated advanced; Amazing Grace (Pulau Nyireh, 24 m) is the gentler one.

summary.zh: 马来西亚东岸的度假潜水岛，从新加坡或吉隆坡半天可达，珊瑚礁浅而平静，适合考证与休闲潜。Tiger Reef 有流有大鱼，Soyak 附近的小沉船适合夜潜；11 月到次年 2 月季风停潜。
summary.en: A resort island on Malaysia's east coast, half a day from Singapore or Kuala Lumpur, with calm shallow reefs that suit courses and easy diving. Tiger Reef adds current and bigger fish, and small wrecks off Soyak make a popular night dive. The northeast monsoon shuts things down from November to February.

highlights.zh: Tiger Reef 的放流与梭鱼群
highlights.en: Drift and barracuda schools at Tiger Reef

highlights.zh: Soyak 礁的隆头鹦哥鱼与海龟
highlights.en: Bumphead parrotfish and turtles at Soyak reef

highlights.zh: Renggis 浅礁里的黑鳍礁鲨与海龟
highlights.en: Blacktip reef sharks and turtles on the shallow Renggis reef

highlights.zh: 2–3 月法老乌贼交配季
highlights.en: Pharaoh cuttlefish mating season in February–March

notes: 季节：PADI Travel 写 3–10 月、旺季 6–8 月、11–2 月多数潜店关闭；Diveplanit 写 2 月–11 月初、季风 11–1 月基本停摆；GS-Diving（当地潜店）写 4–10 月、海洋公园 11–2 月关闭。取 3–10，3 月与 10 月为肩季。能见度 3–5 月及 9–10 月 15–30 m，6–8 月降至 8–12 m（Diveplanit）。隆头鹦哥鱼与 Tiger Reef 梭鱼来源为 GS-Diving 潜点描述；法老乌贼 2–3 月交配来源为 Diveplanit。Tiger Reef 平均 25 m 有流，Chebeh 最深 45 m，整体仍按 OW 标。坐标为 Tekek 村（主码头与机场）。

name.zh: 东姑阿都拉曼海洋公园（亚庇）
name.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park (Kota Kinabalu)

summary.zh: 亚庇外海五岛，哲斯顿码头快艇约 15 分钟。浅礁适合浮潜与体验潜水，沙底常见躄鱼、海马、蓝环章鱼；能见度一般。全年可潜，3–10 月较好。
summary.en: Five islands just off Kota Kinabalu (Gaya, Manukan, Sapi, Mamutik, Sulug), about 15 minutes by boat from Jesselton Point. Shallow reefs suit snorkelling and try dives; sandy slopes hold frogfish, seahorses and blue-ringed octopus. Visibility is often limited. Diveable year-round, best March–October; whale sharks pass occasionally.

highlights.zh: 离市区码头约 15 分钟
highlights.en: About 15 minutes from the city jetty

highlights.zh: Sulug Reef 躄鱼与海蛞蝓
highlights.en: Sulug Reef: frogfish and nudibranchs

highlights.zh: Mid-Reef：5–30 米，适合新手
highlights.en: Mid-Reef: 5–30 m, easy dive

highlights.zh: 沙底微距：海马、蓝环章鱼
highlights.en: Sandy-bottom macro: seahorses, blue-ringed octopus

notes: Season: Sabah Tourism says weather stable year-round; Underwater Asia says year-round, best Mar–Oct. Whale-shark months disagree: Sabah Tourism Nov–Feb, Underwater Asia Feb–Mar. Usukan and Rice Bowl wrecks listed by Underwater Asia are ~2 h away (Usukan is near Kota Belud), not inside the park. Uses new species id 'seahorse'. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 小巽他群岛东端，阿洛岛与潘塔尔岛之间的海峡潮流强，上升流会把水温压到 20°C 出头。峭壁上常见礁鲨和犬齿金枪鱼，卡拉巴希湾的黑沙坡则是微距场。以船宿为主，适合有经验者。
summary.en: The strait between Alor and Pantar at the eastern end of the Lesser Sundas, where strong tides run and upwellings can drop the water into the low 20s °C. The walls draw reef sharks and dogtooth tuna, while the black-sand slopes of Kalabahi Bay are a muck site for rhinopias and frogfish. Mostly visited by liveaboard and best suited to experienced divers.

highlights.zh: 潘塔尔海峡的放流与峭壁，礁鲨、犬齿金枪鱼常见
highlights.en: Drifts and walls in the Pantar Strait with reef sharks and dogtooth tuna

highlights.zh: 卡拉巴希湾黑沙上的吻鲉（Rhinopias）、躄鱼和拟态章鱼
highlights.en: Rhinopias, frogfish and mimic octopus on the black sand of Kalabahi Bay

highlights.zh: 9–11 月 Current Alley 有机会见双髻鲨，9 月翻车鲀最多
highlights.en: Hammerheads possible at Current Alley in September–November; sunfish peak in September

highlights.zh: 船宿多在弗洛雷斯岛的毛梅雷登船
highlights.en: Liveaboards usually board at Maumere on Flores

notes: 新增潜点；中文名取中文维基'阿洛岛'（liveaboard.com 中文页写'亚罗士打'是错译）。季节：DTW 写 4–11 月条件最好（10–11 月流最强），季外雨多、海面乱、能见度低；9 月翻车鲀最多，9–11 月是 Current Alley 的双髻鲨窗口。liveaboard.com 正文写 3–12 月、FAQ 写约 4–10 月旱季，11–3 月较湿、远端潜点可能去不了。Divernet（2022-10，Amira 号船宿游记，毛梅雷出发）没写月份。取 DTW 的 4–11 月（liveaboard 两种说法都基本覆盖）。水温：liveaboard 写上升流时 20–24°C、局部 20°C；DTW 写 3–4 月与 10–11 月约 25°C、5–9 月 31–32°C（偏高，存疑），总表 26–32；取 20–30。能见度：DTW 通常 25–30 m、5–9 月浮游生物多时可降到 15 m 以下，总表 12–30；Divernet 在潘塔尔海峡 25–40 m；取 12–35。等级 AOW：DTW 总表写 Advanced only（Current Alley 2–4 节、要专家级放流技巧；卡拉巴希湾流小、适合经验少的人），liveaboard 写一般被视为有经验者的目的地，Divernet 写流强多变、温跃层随时上来、必须带 SMB 并会放。access：liveaboard 写先飞古邦，再转约 45 分钟航班到阿洛，船宿多从毛梅雷出发、偶尔拉布安巴焦；DTW 写有两三家度假村、集中在潘塔尔海峡，建议停留 4–5 天。DTW 写 Kal's Dream 据部分船宿反馈'不如从前'。坐标为卡拉巴希镇（维基百科 -8.217, 124.517），潘塔尔海峡潜区在其西侧，±20 km。species 首位用躄鱼代表卡拉巴希湾微距；吻鲉、犬齿金枪鱼在 species.json 里没有 id。

summary.zh: 马鲁古的港口城市，安汶湾里的泥沙坡是知名微距场：迷幻躄鱼目前只在这一带有记录，还有安汶鲉、吻鲉和麒麟鱼。能见度常在 15 米以内，找生物靠潜导。也是班达海船宿最常用的出发港。
summary.en: A port city in Maluku whose sheltered bay is a well-known muck destination. Its silty slopes hold the psychedelic frogfish, so far recorded only in the Ambon area, along with Ambon scorpionfish, rhinopias and mandarinfish. Visibility is often under 15 m and finds depend on sharp-eyed guides. Ambon is also the usual departure port for Banda Sea liveaboards.

highlights.zh: 安汶湾的迷幻躄鱼，2009 年才发现的新种
highlights.en: Psychedelic frogfish in Ambon Bay, a species discovered only in 2009

highlights.zh: Rhino City 的吻鲉与安汶鲉
highlights.en: Rhinopias and Ambon scorpionfish at Rhino City

highlights.zh: 黄昏时 Laha 约 10 米处的麒麟鱼
highlights.en: Mandarinfish at about 10 m at Laha as dusk falls

highlights.zh: 旱季在 10–4 月，与巴厘、科莫多大致相反
highlights.en: The dry season runs October–April, roughly opposite to Bali and Komodo

notes: 新增潜点。季节：DTW 写全年潜况都好，旱季 10–4 月（雨少、能见度更可能好），雨季 5–9 月雨大、甚至有风暴；Bluewater 建议 10–4 月旱季，并写 3–5 月和 10 月通常不错；liveaboard.com 写全年可潜、船宿多在 3–4 月来。取 10–4 月。水温：DTW 26–29、Bluewater 平均约 26°C，取 26–29。能见度：DTW 总表 5–15（正文称很少超过 20 m，部分泥底很低）；liveaboard 写港内约 20 m、新月与满月之间流大时可降到 4 m；Bluewater 10–30（泥底最多约 15 m）；DivePlanit（Nigel Marsh，2023-12）这次 10–15 m 以上；取 5–20。迷幻躄鱼：liveaboard 写 2009 年发现的新种，DivePlanit 写只在安汶一带发现过，DTW 没提。等级 OW：DTW 写新手到进阶，Tanjung Setan 只适合进阶。access：Bluewater 写有雅加达、美娜多、望加锡直飞，机场到安汶湾约 20 分钟车程；维基写帕蒂穆拉机场就在 Laha；DTW 写岛上有几家潜水度假村，但更推荐班达海船宿；DivePlanit 写多数船宿客人在安汶进出。岸潜没找到明确来源，access 只写 boat、liveaboard。DTW 写 Bleeker 1863 年在安汶湾记录了 783 种鱼。坐标为帕蒂穆拉机场 / Laha（维基百科 -3.710, 128.089），Laha 潜点就在机场边的湾里，±3 km。species 首位用躄鱼代表迷幻躄鱼；安汶鲉、吻鲉没有 id；豆丁海马来自 Bluewater。

summary.zh: 马尼拉以南约 3 小时车程的微距重镇，已记录的海蛞蝓近 600 种。礁石、沙坡和泥底里藏着躄鱼、拟态章鱼、蓝环章鱼和豆丁海马。多数潜点船程 10–20 分钟，1–2 月水温会降到 25°C 左右。
summary.en: A macro hub about three hours' drive south of Manila, with close to 600 nudibranch species recorded. Reefs, sandy slopes and muck sites hide frogfish, mimic and blue-ringed octopus and pygmy seahorses. Most sites are 10–20 minutes by boat, and the water cools to around 25°C in January and February.

highlights.zh: 近 600 种海蛞蝓
highlights.en: Close to 600 nudibranch species

highlights.zh: Secret Bay 泥底的拟态章鱼与蓝环章鱼
highlights.en: Mimic and blue-ringed octopus in the muck at Secret Bay

highlights.zh: Kirby's Rock 的金色豆丁海马
highlights.en: Golden pygmy seahorses at Kirby's Rock

highlights.zh: 夜里的黑水潜，看漂浮的幼体生物
highlights.en: Blackwater night dives for drifting larval critters

notes: 新增潜点。季节：DTW 菲律宾总页写全年可潜、12–4 月条件最好；Bluewater Dive Travel 写 10 月至 6 月初为主季、11–12 月和 4–5 月最好（4–5 月度假村最满）、7–8 月季风但潜点仍可去。取两者重叠的 12–4 月；10–11 月、5 月为肩季。DTW 阿尼洛潜点页没写季节。海蛞蝓：Divernet（2025-10）写近 600 种、DTW 写已鉴定 560 多种。水温：DTW 25–28；Bluewater 写通常 27.5°C、1–2 月约 25°C，有评价写 11–4 月低到 24°C，取 24–28。能见度：DTW 10–20 m、Bluewater 9–27 m，取 10–25。车程：Bluewater 写从马尼拉机场约 3 小时；DTW 写在马尼拉以南 130 km。船程 10–20 分钟（Bluewater）。流：Mainit Point、Beatrice 流明显（DTW、Bluewater）。Bluewater 是潜水旅行社，与 DTW 同类，没找到旅游局 / 主流潜水媒体的季节说法。坐标为 Twin Rocks 保护区（联合国地名培训文件 13.69088, 120.88910，学生作业，按 ±1 km 看待），位于 Mabini 半岛潜区中部。

summary.zh: 杜马盖地以南约 30 公里的火山小岛，由渔民社区参与管理，是菲律宾最早的海洋保护区之一。绿海龟和玳瑁几乎每潜都见得到，浅礁硬珊瑚茂密，外侧潜点流可以很强。多数人从杜马盖地一带坐船一日往返。
summary.en: A small volcanic island 30 km south of Dumaguete, co-managed with its fishing community and one of the Philippines' oldest marine protected areas. Green and hawksbill turtles appear on nearly every dive and the shallows carry dense hard coral, while outer sites such as Coconut Point can run strong currents. Most divers come on day trips from resorts around Dauin.

highlights.zh: 几乎每潜都有绿海龟和玳瑁
highlights.en: Green and hawksbill turtles on nearly every dive

highlights.zh: Chapel 礁墙的悬垂与洞穴
highlights.en: Overhangs and caverns on the Chapel wall

highlights.zh: Coconut Point 漂流，常见杰克鱼与海蛇
highlights.en: Drifts at Coconut Point with jacks and sea snakes

highlights.zh: Rocky Point West 的硬珊瑚
highlights.en: Dense hard coral at Rocky Point West

notes: 新增潜点（与道因微距分开，因为是单独的一日船潜行程）。全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 菲律宾总页写米沙鄢全年可潜、1–5 月旺季；liveaboard.com 阿波岛页写全年可去、5–6 月最热且海面最平静，季风季由潜导挑避风潜点。DTW 阿波岛页没写月份。保护区：DTW 写'菲律宾最古老的海洋保护区之一'、与当地渔民社区共同管理；liveaboard 写是菲律宾第二个设立的保护区、社区管理。建立年份（多处写 1982 年，1994 年宣布为 Protected Landscape and Seascape）只在搜索摘要里看到，没打开权威页，文案未写年份。重要：liveaboard.com 写台风破坏了保护区珊瑚、'目前禁止潜水以便恢复'（页面无日期）；搜索摘要显示是东南侧的保护区自 2011 年台风 Sendong（及 2012 年 Pablo）后关闭、北侧礁区未受影响。Chapel、Coconut Point、Rocky Point West、Largahan、Mamsa Point 等其余潜点照常，摘要不写'潜保护区'。水温：DTW 25–30、liveaboard 26–30，取 25–30；能见度 10–20 取 DTW。流：DTW 写温和到很强；liveaboard 写 Mamsa Point 有时禁潜、Coconut Point 外号'洗衣机'。船程：liveaboard 道因页写到阿波岛约 30 分钟；Divernet（2025-10）写多数度假村一日往返、船上午餐。DTW：距杜马盖地 30 km。杰克鱼：DTW 写 Mamsa Point 大群杰克鱼，Divernet 写有杰克鱼群。坐标为阿波岛（9°04′N 123°16′E），±1 km。

summary.zh: 民都洛海峡中的大片珊瑚礁，距西民都洛的萨布拉扬约 40 公里，1996 年列为自然公园。礁墙外常见灰礁鲨、白顶礁鲨和梭鱼群，11–3 月偶有锤头鲨。流强且多变，多数人坐船宿来，常与科隆沉船同一航次。
summary.en: A large reef system in the Mindoro Strait, about 40 km off Sablayan on Mindoro's west coast, declared a natural park in 1996. Grey reef and whitetip sharks and schooling barracuda patrol the walls, and hammerheads pass occasionally from November to March. Currents are strong and changeable. Most divers arrive by liveaboard, often on trips that add the Coron wrecks.

highlights.zh: Apo 29（梭鱼山）的梭鱼群
highlights.en: Barracuda schools at Apo 29 (Barracuda Hill)

highlights.zh: Shark Ridge 的礁鲨与鹰鳐
highlights.en: Reef sharks and eagle rays along Shark Ridge

highlights.zh: 旱季能见度可达 40 米
highlights.en: Visibility up to 40 m in the dry season

highlights.zh: 船宿 3 晚，或与科隆合并 5–7 晚
highlights.en: Three-night trips, or 5–7 nights combined with Coron

notes: 新增潜点。季节：DTW 写旱季 1–4 月最推荐（雨季 5–12 月、台风 7–10 月；蝠鲼 11–5 月、锤头鲨 11–3 月更常见）；liveaboard.com 写 12–5 月旱季最佳。取两者重叠的 1–4 月，12 月与 5 月为肩季。访问：DTW 写只能随船宿（3 晚只去阿波礁，或 5–7 晚加科隆沉船）；liveaboard.com 写船宿从八打雁或公主港出发、礁区距西民都洛 Sablayan 约 40 km、1996 年起受保护、面积 40 km²、门票外国人约 45 USD / 菲律宾人约 35 USD，并提到 Pandan 岛适合新手；PADI 博客（2025-02 更新）写船宿常把阿波礁和科隆排在一起。从 Sablayan 出发的一日 / 过夜船潜没找到能打开的权威页面（搜索摘要里 Inquirer 旧文提到每日限 105 人、最多停留两天），access 保留 boat，请复核。liveaboard 与 PADI 都写'世界第二大 / 第二长的连续珊瑚礁'，属有争议的最高级说法，文案未用。水温：DTW 26–30（正文）/ 26–29（摘要），liveaboard 26–31，取 26–30；能见度 15–40 取 DTW。等级 AOW：DTW 写中级到进阶、流强多变，Apo 29 只适合进阶。DTW 阿波礁页把'Manta Bowl（大洋蝠鲼 11–5 月）'列为潜点，疑与蒂考海峡的 Manta Bowl 混淆，未采用。species：锤头鲨为偶遇，排最后。坐标为礁区中心（约 12°40′N 120°29′E），±5 km；阿波岛（灯塔、管护站）在礁区西南部。

summary.zh: 邦劳岛西南外海的小岛，设有海洋保护区。5–18 米的浅台外缘陡降成礁墙，常有成千条大眼鲹盘旋，也有梭鱼群、绿海龟和玳瑁。流多半温和，偶尔变强，船一般一早从邦劳岛出发。
summary.en: A small island off southwest Panglao with a marine protected area. A 5–18 m reef flat drops into walls where thousands of big-eye trevally circle, especially at the Sanctuary and Black Forest, alongside chevron barracuda and green and hawksbill turtles. Currents are usually mild but can pick up. Boats leave Panglao early in the morning.

highlights.zh: 保护区礁墙上的杰克鱼风暴
highlights.en: Big-eye trevally swirling over the Sanctuary wall

highlights.zh: Black Forest 的黑珊瑚与漂流
highlights.en: Black coral and drift diving at Black Forest

highlights.zh: Diver's Heaven 的海龟
highlights.en: Turtles at Diver's Heaven

highlights.zh: 回邦劳岛还有岸潜和夜潜
highlights.en: Easy shore and night dives back on Panglao

notes: 新增潜点。全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 薄荷岛页写旱季 1–5 月能见度最好，5–7 月有护巢的褐拟鳞鲀（titan triggerfish）要当心；liveaboard.com 薄荷岛页写全年可潜，避开 11 月下旬–1 月台风多发期（台风通常从北边过）。两者都写全年。杰克鱼：liveaboard 巴里卡萨页写保护区潜点（4–60 m 礁墙）有'成千条大眼鲹'、Black Forest 有梭鱼、杰克鱼和海龟；liveaboard 薄荷岛页写 Black Forest 有 chevron 梭鱼群、保护区礁墙是杰克鱼的清洁站、海草床常有绿海龟；DTW 写杰克鱼群、梭鱼、海龟、深处有灰礁鲨，Diver's Heaven 有绿海龟、玳瑁和大躄鱼。DTW：5–18 m 浅台后陡降，流一般温和、在岛周可变强。薄荷省旅游局页（tourism.bohol.gov.ph）建议早上 7 点前从邦劳出发、下午 2 点前返回。每日限 150 名潜水员 / 浮潜者、环境费约 ₱250、1985 年设保护区——只在第三方旅游站的搜索摘要里看到，未核实，文案未写。邦劳岛岸潜 / 夜潜：DTW 写 Kalipayan 岸潜、Tawala 保护区夜潜。等级 OW：liveaboard 写 OW + 10–20 潜；Black Forest 漂流适合有经验者。水温：DTW 26–29、liveaboard 26–30，取 26–30；能见度 DTW 旱季 15–30、雨季 10–20，取 10–30。中文名'巴里卡萨岛'按国内旅游常用译名，没能用中文来源核实。坐标为巴里卡萨岛（9°31′N 123°41′E），±1 km。

summary.zh: 安汶东南的深海与火山岛，船宿多在 3–4 月和 9–11 月的换季窗口开航。班达内拉旁 1988 年的熔岩流上长满桌珊瑚；Manuk、Suanggi 等远海小岛秋季常有双髻鲨群，Manuk 海蛇尤多。
summary.en: A deep sea of volcanic islands southeast of Ambon, dived mostly by liveaboard in two short windows, around March–April and September–November. Beside Banda Neira, a lava flow from 1988 is now covered in huge table corals, while remote islands such as Manuk and Suanggi draw schooling scalloped hammerheads in October–November, and volcanic Manuk hosts large numbers of sea snakes.

highlights.zh: Manuk、Suanggi 的双髻鲨群，10–11 月新月和满月前后最集中
highlights.en: Schooling hammerheads at Manuk and Suanggi, densest around new and full moons in October–November

highlights.zh: Manuk 与 Gunung Api（海蛇岛）成群的扁尾海蛇和橄榄海蛇
highlights.en: Banded sea kraits and olive sea snakes at Manuk and Gunung Api, known as Sea Snake Island

highlights.zh: 班达内拉 Lava Flow：熔岩上长出的巨型桌珊瑚
highlights.en: Lava Flow at Banda Neira: giant table corals grown over the lava

highlights.zh: 多从安汶出发，航程 1–2 周，建议 50 潜以上
highlights.en: Trips usually start in Ambon, last one to two weeks and suit divers with 50+ logged dives

notes: 新增潜点。季节：DTW 写 2–4 月与 9–11 月最好，6–7 月雨最多，季外海面不稳、很多运营商（包括陆上潜店）停潜，8 月起能见度回升；Dive Worldwide（英国潜水旅行社，行程页 Key info）写 3–5 月与 9–11 月；liveaboard.com 写船宿主要在 9–12 月（FAQ 又写 10–12 月换季窗口、另一处写航线大致 10–4 月，自相矛盾）。取两家都覆盖的 3–4 月与 9–11 月，2 月、5 月为肩季。双髻鲨：Dive Worldwide 写 Manuk 与 Suanggi 周边在 10–11 月新月、满月前后流最强并有冷水上涌时成群最多；DTW 写 Serua 9–11 月、Run 岛 Nutmeg Drop 10–11 月可能见到；liveaboard 评论里 8–10 月见过成群、11 月有人没见到。注意有两个 Gunung Api：DTW、liveaboard 的 Lava Flow 是班达群岛的 Gunung Api 火山（1988 年喷发）；Dive Worldwide 的'海蛇岛' Gunung Api 是班达海里另一座无人火山岛。海蛇：DTW 写 Manuk 以扁尾海蛇最常见、中华海蛇较少，潜水员极少被咬；liveaboard 写 Manuk 海蛇多、附近火山口让水温偏高；Dive Worldwide 写 Gunung Api 有时成百上千条扁尾海蛇和橄榄海蛇。Suanggi 是否火山岛、有没有海蛇没找到来源，摘要只写 Manuk。水温 26–29、能见度 15–30 取 DTW 总表（liveaboard 也写 26–29）。等级 AOW：DTW 写中级到进阶，Dive Worldwide 建议 50 潜以上并有类似流况经验；liveaboard 正文与 FAQ 说法不一。access：DTW 写安汶是最常用出发港，班达群岛在安汶东南约 200 km（14 小时），建议 1–2 周；liveaboard 写雅加达每天有航班飞安汶，部分航线以萨姆拉基或'被遗忘群岛'为端点；Dive Worldwide 也有往返四王、阿洛、特里顿湾的过境航线。坐标为班达内拉岛（维基百科 -4.5175, 129.9025）；双髻鲨所在的 Manuk、Suanggi 离班达内拉都较远，这条是整片海的代表点。新物种 sea-snake 见 newSpecies。

summary.zh: 美娜多以北约 80 公里，船程近 3 小时，也可从蓝碧、布纳肯的度假村一日游。火山岩尖峰覆满软珊瑚，水流中到强，适合进阶；沙地微距点偶见儒艮。
summary.en: About 80 km north of Manado, close to 3 hours by boat, or a day trip from Lembeh or Bunaken resorts. Volcanic pinnacles covered in soft coral, with moderate to strong current, suit intermediate divers; macro sites hold pygmy seahorses and frogfish, and dugongs are occasionally seen at a sandy site.

highlights.zh: 软珊瑚尖峰
highlights.en: Soft-coral pinnacles

highlights.zh: 豆丁海马与躄鱼
highlights.en: Pygmy seahorses and frogfish

highlights.zh: 偶见儒艮
highlights.en: Occasional dugong

notes: Season from one source only: dry May–Oct, clearest water Oct–Dec, windy Jul–Sep; diveable year-round. Not the Bangka Island off Sumatra.

summary.zh: 度假岛周边船潜。西岸缓坡礁适合考证和体验潜水；Yapak 深峭壁流强，偶见鲨鱼和蝠鲼，需进阶；南边鳄鱼岛海峡软珊瑚多、海蛇常见。6–9 月西南季风时部分潜点看天气。
summary.en: Boat diving around the resort island. Gentle west-coast reefs suit courses and try dives; Yapak is a deep, current-swept wall for experienced divers with occasional sharks and mantas; the Crocodile and Laurel island channel has soft corals and many sea snakes. In the June–September southwest monsoon some sites become weather-dependent.

highlights.zh: 考证与体验潜水
highlights.en: Courses and try dives

highlights.zh: Yapak 深峭壁
highlights.en: Yapak deep wall

highlights.zh: 鳄鱼岛海蛇
highlights.en: Sea snakes at Crocodile Island

highlights.zh: Laurel 岛穿越隧道
highlights.en: Laurel Island swim-through

notes: Season sources disagree: Mar–Jun (underwaterasia) vs Nov–Apr Amihan (hotel guide). Diveable year-round. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 美娜多外海的国家海洋公园，以垂直峭壁出名，壁上挂满扇珊瑚和海绵。绿海龟在壁边休息，苏眉与鹰鳐不时游过。离市区约 40 分钟船程，流通常温和，多数潜点新手也能潜。
summary.en: A national marine park off Manado known for sheer walls hung with sea fans and sponges. Green turtles rest along the ledges while Napoleon wrasse and eagle rays pass by. The reef is about 40 minutes from town by boat, currents are usually mild, and most sites suit newer divers.

highlights.zh: Lekuan 峭壁的绿海龟，一潜常见多只
highlights.en: Several green turtles per dive on the Lekuan walls

highlights.zh: 峭壁上的扇珊瑚、海绵与软珊瑚
highlights.en: Sea fans, sponges and soft corals on the walls

highlights.zh: 可与车程约 1.5 小时的蓝碧海峡组合
highlights.en: Easy to pair with Lembeh, about 1.5 hours away by road

notes: 新增潜点；名称括号用美娜多，因为国内潜水员多以'美娜多'称呼这一行程（与'朱利安岩（拜伦湾）'同一做法）。季节：liveaboard.com 写 5–10 月旱季最佳；DTW 潜点页写 4–10 月、11 月至 2 月底可能有风雨和 1–2 m 涌浪；DTW FAQ 写北苏拉威西 3–10 月最佳、11–1 月较难预测。按'优先运营商'取 5–10 月，4 月为肩季。水温：DTW 27–30、liveaboard 28–30。能见度 20–35 取 DTW（下雨时美娜多湾潜点降得更多）；liveaboard 只写'常超 20 m'。船程：DTW 约 40 分钟（北距美娜多湾 18 km），liveaboard 30–60 / 30–45 分钟。等级：DTW 写新手到进阶都可，Bunaken Timur 一般给中级、Tanjung Kopi 需有经验潜导；liveaboard 提醒部分潜点流会突然反向、建议带 SMB。公园费：liveaboard.com 写每人每天 IDR 50,000、每年封顶 IDR 150,000，保留防水牌备查，未见官方原文。liveaboard 列出的'远洋白鳍鲨'可疑，没采用。坐标为布纳肯岛南岸 Lekuan 峭壁一带，按地图常识取，±2 km。

summary.zh: 薄荷岛西北小岛，从 Loon 码头坐船约 40 分钟。峭壁从浅礁台直落 40 米以下，常见海扇、躄鱼、豆丁海马；1–4 月清晨深处有机会见双髻鲨。
summary.en: Small island off northwest Bohol, 30–45 minutes by boat from Loon. Walls drop from a shallow reef flat past 30–40 m, with sea fans, frogfish and pygmy seahorses. Scalloped hammerheads are sometimes seen at depth off the northwest point on early-morning dives, mainly January–April.

highlights.zh: 峭壁潜水
highlights.en: Wall dives

highlights.zh: 清晨找双髻鲨
highlights.en: Dawn hammerhead dives

highlights.zh: 豆丁海马与躄鱼
highlights.en: Pygmy seahorses and frogfish

notes: Hammerhead window given as Jan–Apr (bohol-philippines) and Dec–Jun (dive-the-world); sightings not guaranteed, usually deep at dawn. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 新几内亚岛北岸的大海湾，西部是海洋国家公园。南岸夸蒂索湾的渔民在浮排下撒小鱼，鲸鲨常年聚来进食，清晨最活跃，可以水肺下到浮排下方。6–10 月四王海况差时，船宿多转来这里。
summary.en: A vast bay on the north coast of New Guinea whose western part is a marine national park. At Kwatisore Bay on the southern shore, whale sharks gather year-round beneath fishermen's bagan platforms to feed on scattered baitfish, most actively in early morning, and divers can join them on scuba. Liveaboards come mainly June–October, when Raja Ampat is rough.

highlights.zh: 夸蒂索湾浮排下的鲸鲨，常一次好几条
highlights.en: Several whale sharks at a time under the Kwatisore bagans

highlights.zh: 马诺夸里、比亚克一带的二战沉船与飞机残骸
highlights.en: WWII wrecks and aircraft around Manokwari and Biak

highlights.zh: 湾内有四种海龟，也能遇到海豚和儒艮
highlights.en: Four turtle species, plus dolphins and dugongs

highlights.zh: 船宿多从马诺夸里、纳比雷、比亚克或索龙出发
highlights.en: Liveaboards depart from Manokwari, Nabire, Biak or Sorong

notes: 新增潜点；中文名取 PADI 中文博客的'森德拉瓦西湾'（liveaboard.com 中文页作'森达拉瓦锡湾'；Cenderawasih 印尼语意为天堂鸟）。季节：鲸鲨全年都在（DTW、Bluewater、liveaboard.com 一致）；船宿季 DTW 写 6–10 月、PADI 博客'When to Go'写 6–10 月、Bluewater 写多数船宿 6–10 月（另写部分四王船 7–9 月过来）；liveaboard.com 写海况较平的是约 4–10 月旱季。取 6–10 月。巴布亚两段雨季 7–8 月与 11–12 月（DTW、Bluewater）。鲸鲨数量：DTW 只写'几条'到'几十条'，Bluewater 写'几十条'，都没有统计；PADI 写清晨最好。Bluewater 写撒小鱼是当地渔民的老做法、不是为游客而设，且这里能水肺潜、不只浮潜。水温 27–30（DTW、Bluewater），能见度 10–30（DTW、Bluewater；liveaboard 写最高 30 m）。等级 OW：DTW 总表写中级到进阶，但夸蒂索的鲸鲨潜任何级别都可，Bluewater 写各级别都适合；深沉船另需技术潜水（liveaboard）。access：DTW 写目前只推荐船宿；liveaboard 写只能船宿、多从索龙出发、常与四王或特里顿湾连走；Bluewater 写多从马诺夸里、纳比雷、比亚克出发，与北四王连走的从索龙出发。国家公园：维基百科写面积 14,535 km²、1993 年划定、2002 年宣布，湾西部为海洋国家公园。坐标为纳比雷（维基百科 -3.362, 135.503），船宿出发港之一；DTW 写夸蒂索湾在南岸、靠近纳比雷，没找到可靠坐标，±60 km。

summary.zh: 巴拉望北部布桑加岛一带。1944 年 9 月美军空袭击沉日军补给船队，留下十余艘沉船，多在 10–40 米，长满珊瑚，聚着燕鱼、石斑和狮子鱼。梭鱼湖淡水压着咸水、越潜越热；岛北岸有机会看到儒艮。
summary.en: Around Busuanga in northern Palawan, a US air raid in September 1944 sank a Japanese supply fleet, leaving more than ten wrecks at roughly 10–40 m, now coated in coral and home to batfish, groupers and lionfish. In Barracuda Lake fresh water sits over warmer salt water, and dugongs graze the seagrass near Calauit on Busuanga's north coast.

highlights.zh: Okikawa Maru、Irako 等日军沉船
highlights.en: Japanese wrecks such as the Okikawa Maru and Irako

highlights.zh: 梭鱼湖的淡咸水分层与温跃层
highlights.en: Barracuda Lake's fresh and salt layers, warming with depth

highlights.zh: Lusong 炮艇最深只有 14 米
highlights.en: The Lusong gunboat, no deeper than 14 m

highlights.zh: Calauit 海草床的儒艮
highlights.en: Dugongs on the Calauit seagrass beds

notes: 新增潜点。季节：DTW 写 12–4 月旱季最好（5–11 月雨季，7–8 月很湿）；liveaboard.com 写全年可潜，11–5 月最佳、12–3 月尤好。取重叠的 12–4 月；11 月、5 月为肩季。沉船：DTW 写至少 12 艘，深度从 Lusong 炮艇最深 14 m、Japanese Freighter 12–25 m 到 Irako 最深 43 m；liveaboard 写超过 10 艘、平均潜深约 25 m；PADI 博客写约 11 艘、多数休闲潜水可达；Divernet（2025-10）写 1944 年美军空袭击沉、长满珊瑚。日期：DTW 只写 1944 年 9 月，搜索摘要写 9 月 24 日（未打开权威页），文案只写 9 月。梭鱼湖：liveaboard 写上层淡水约 28°C、深处海水约 38°C，鱼很少，据说因一条大梭鱼得名；DTW 写约 15 m 处温差明显、底部约 32 m、33 m 处有洞口（DTW 对上下层淡 / 咸水的说法与 liveaboard 相反，采用 liveaboard：淡水在上）。儒艮：DTW 写布桑加北岸 Calauit 的 Dugong Watch 项目约 30 头，Conception、Bulalacao 岛也常见；离科隆镇较远，需专门行程。species：沉船没有贴纸，取这一带最有名的动物儒艮作贴纸；DTW 写个别沉船上有梭鱼，但不是成群的'梭鱼风暴'，所以没放 barracuda。等级 AOW：liveaboard 写 AOW + 深潜 / 沉船专长更好，OW 只能潜少数几艘；DTW 写整体中级到进阶。水温：DTW 27–30、liveaboard 25–31，合并 25–31；能见度 5–20 取 DTW。中文名写'科隆（巴拉望）'，避免与德国科隆混淆。坐标为科隆镇码头（12°00′N 120°12′E）；多数沉船在镇西南 Tangat 岛一带，±10 km。

summary.zh: 杜马盖地以南约 12 公里的火山黑沙海岸，沿岸有一串小型保护区和人工鱼礁。沙坡上常见躄鱼、火焰乌贼、拟态章鱼、蓝环章鱼和剃刀鱼，黄昏可看麒麟鱼求偶。部分潜点能岸潜，去阿波岛约半小时船程。
summary.en: A volcanic black-sand coast 12 km south of Dumaguete, lined with small marine protected areas and artificial reefs. The slopes hide frogfish, flamboyant cuttlefish, mimic and blue-ringed octopus and ghost pipefish, and mandarinfish court at dusk at Masaplod Norte. Some sites are dived from shore, and Apo Island is about 30 minutes away by boat.

highlights.zh: 火焰乌贼、拟态章鱼与蓝环章鱼
highlights.en: Flamboyant cuttlefish, mimic and blue-ringed octopus

highlights.zh: The Cars、El Dorado 等人工鱼礁
highlights.en: Artificial reefs such as The Cars and El Dorado

highlights.zh: Masaplod Norte 黄昏的麒麟鱼
highlights.en: Mandarinfish at dusk at Masaplod Norte

highlights.zh: 10–3 月 Dauin South 的剃刀鱼
highlights.en: Robust ghost pipefish at Dauin South, October–March

notes: 新增潜点（只含道因沿岸的微距；阿波岛单列为 apo-island）。全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 道因页写全年水温都暖，DTW 菲律宾总页写米沙鄢全年可潜、1–5 月旺季；liveaboard.com 道因页写全年可潜，9–12 月季风，3–6 月最暖、能见度最好。季节性物种：DTW 写 Dauin South 的粗吻剃刀鱼（robust ghost pipefish）10–3 月。水温：DTW 26–30，liveaboard 写冷月约 23°C（疑偏低），取 25–30。能见度：DTW 10–15，liveaboard 写'可达 45 m'（应指阿波岛一带），取 10–15。距离：DTW 写在杜马盖地以南 12 km；Divernet（2025-10）写车程约 20 分钟，潜点从 Bacong 到 Zamboanguita 约 9 英里，黑沙来自 Talinis 火山。岸潜：DTW 写 Masaplod Norte、Dauin South 可岸潜。麒麟鱼：DTW（Masaplod Norte 日落求偶）与 Divernet 都提到。保护区：DTW 只写道因外海有多处海洋保护区、多年社区守护，没列名字。没加火焰乌贼 / 拟态章鱼物种（物种表已有躄鱼作招牌）；以后可加 flamboyant-cuttlefish，蓝碧、马布、阿尼洛、米尔恩湾都用得上。中文名：中文潜水圈多把这一带统称'杜马盖地'，Dauin 的通行中文译名没能核实（搜索额度用完），暂写'杜马盖地（Dauin）'，请人工确认。坐标为道因镇（9°11′N 123°16′E），±1 km。

summary.zh: 婆罗洲东岸的群岛。桑加拉基岛周边常年有礁蝠鲼，5–9 月最集中；德拉旺岛码头边的海草床常有绿海龟；马拉图阿海峡的梭鱼群可上千条，流较强。卡卡班岛的无刺水母湖只能浮潜。
summary.en: An island group off the east coast of Borneo. Reef mantas are around Sangalaki all year, in the greatest numbers from May to September; green turtles graze the seagrass by Derawan's jetties; and the channel at Maratua holds a barracuda school that can top a thousand fish, in stronger current. The stingless jellyfish lake on Kakaban is for snorkelling only.

highlights.zh: 桑加拉基的蝠鲼清洁站与放流潜点，有时一次见六七条
highlights.en: Manta cleaning stations and drifts at Sangalaki, sometimes six or seven mantas at once

highlights.zh: 马拉图阿 Big Fish Country 的梭鱼群与灰礁鲨
highlights.en: Barracuda and grey reef sharks at Big Fish Country, Maratua

highlights.zh: 卡卡班岛无刺水母湖：禁止水肺，也不能涂防晒
highlights.en: Kakaban's stingless jellyfish lake: no scuba and no sunscreen

highlights.zh: 从伯劳机场坐车约 2 小时到 Tanjung Batu，再坐快艇 30–45 分钟
highlights.en: From Berau airport, about two hours by road to Tanjung Batu, then 30–45 minutes by speedboat

notes: 新增潜点（任务里的'德拉旺–桑加拉基'）；中文名德拉旺群岛、卡卡班岛取自中文维基。季节：DTW 写全年都适合潜水、雨季（12–3 月）与旱季差别不大，蝠鲼在 5–9 月浮游生物高峰最集中，桑加拉基绿海龟孵化 6–9 月最盛；Bluewater 写雨季约 11–4 月、旱季 5–10 月，蝠鲼与海龟全年都有；liveaboard.com 只写较干的月份海面更平、能见度更好，蝠鲼全年可见。取 DTW 的蝠鲼高峰 5–9 月（落在 Bluewater 的旱季内），10 月为肩季，其余月份也能潜。DTW 写 5 月中到 9 月中南风期间鲸鲨会移到 Talisayan 一带浮排。水温：DTW 28–30、liveaboard 28–30、Bluewater 约 28，取 28–30。能见度：DTW 总表 10–30（桑加拉基 8–30、平均约 20），Bluewater 15–30（平均约 20），取 10–30；德拉旺岛周边最浑。等级 OW：DTW 写桑加拉基多数不超过 20 m、OW 可潜，德拉旺码头流小；马拉图阿海峡需要钩子和放流经验。长尾鲨：DTW 写在马拉图阿与卡卡班外 30–38 m 的清洁站，多见于下午涨潮，Bluewater 也列出，放 species 末位。水母湖：DTW 写四种水母（含 Mastigias papua、Aurelia aurita），禁止水肺、禁防晒、不许触碰，曾因水母数量下降临时关闭。access：DTW 写从打拉根或伯劳机场出发，雅加达、泗水有直飞、也可经巴厘巴板转；liveaboard 写伯劳 → 约 2 小时车程到 Tanjung Batu → 快艇 30–45 分钟到德拉旺；维基写马拉图阿 2015 年通了机场。坐标取维基百科群岛坐标（2.25, 118.417），在德拉旺、桑加拉基、卡卡班之间的海面，±20 km。

summary.zh: 吕宋岛南端的海湾，约 11–5 月有鲸鲨聚集，规定只能浮潜，由受训的鲸鲨向导带领；浮游生物多，能见度常常很低。潜水员可坐船去蒂考海峡的 Manta Bowl，在强流里挂流钩看蝠鲼清洁，偶有长尾鲨。
summary.en: A bay at the southern tip of Luzon where whale sharks gather from about November to May. Encounters are snorkel-only, led by trained Butanding Interaction Officers, and plankton often clouds the water. Divers head out to Manta Bowl in the Ticao Pass, hooking into a current-swept shoal to watch mantas at cleaning stations, with occasional whale sharks and thresher sharks.

highlights.zh: 浮潜看野生鲸鲨，2–5 月最多
highlights.en: Snorkelling with wild whale sharks, best February–May

highlights.zh: Manta Bowl 的蝠鲼清洁站（需流钩）
highlights.en: Manta cleaning stations at Manta Bowl, reef hook needed

highlights.zh: 圣米格尔岛的软珊瑚坡与微距
highlights.en: Soft coral slopes and macro around San Miguel Island

notes: 新增潜点：东索（浮潜看鲸鲨）与蒂考海峡的 Manta Bowl（水肺）合为一条，因为行程总是捆绑。季节 11–5 月：DTW 菲律宾总页写东索鲸鲨 11–5 月最好；PADI 比科尔页写 11–5 月；UW Photography Guide（2010）写最早 11 月出现、2–5 月最好。搜索摘要里省政府曾报道近年 12 月就开始出现、以前多在 1–6 月（未打开原文）。WWF 菲律宾（2019-05）：1998 年起东索政府、旅游部第五区与 WWF 三方合作；搜索摘要里 WWF 写 2007 年以来识别出至少 653 头、目击从 2017 年 1790 次跌到 2018 年 589 次（未打开原页，文案未写）。规则：PADI 博客写东索湾不允许水肺与鲸鲨同游；UWPG 写只能浮潜、每组有 BIO（Butanding Interaction Officer）陪同、先看简报视频，4 月最后一周有鲸鲨节。能见度：UWPG 写常被浮游生物限制；DivePhotoGuide（2013）写最差不到 3 m。Manta Bowl：DivePhotoGuide 写最浅约 13 m、流强不适合新手、用流钩，4–5 月偶见鲸鲨，有锤头鲨和长尾鲨报告；liveaboard.com 东索页写最深约 20 m、流强，来自圣贝纳迪诺海峡的浮游生物吸引蝠鲼；DTW 阿波礁页列的 Manta Bowl 写大洋蝠鲼 11–5 月，据此用 oceanic-manta（种类请复核）。圣米格尔岛：UWPG 写 Bobby's Wall 等有软珊瑚坡和微距；DivePhotoGuide 写离度假村船程一小时以上。等级按 Manta Bowl 定 AOW。水温没找到本地来源，按菲律宾通常值 26–30 估；能见度 3–20 为估计值。中文名'东索'是按读音的常见写法，'蒂考岛'同，都没能用中文来源核实（中文维基无条目）。坐标为东索镇（约 12.91N, 123.60E），±2 km；Manta Bowl 在蒂考海峡，没取坐标。

summary.zh: 巴拉望北端巴奎特湾，石灰岩岛之间的礁坡多在 10–30 米。South Miniloc 等点常见绿海龟和玳瑁；Dilumacad（直升机岛）有约 35 米长的水下隧道，适合进阶。3–5 月能见度通常较好。
summary.en: Reefs among the limestone islands of Bacuit Bay, northern Palawan, mostly 10–30 m. Green and hawksbill turtles are common at sites such as South Miniloc; Dilumacad (Helicopter Island) has an underwater tunnel about 35 m long for advanced divers. March–May usually has the best visibility; December–February is murkier and cooler.

highlights.zh: 海龟常见
highlights.en: Turtles common

highlights.zh: Dilumacad 水下隧道
highlights.en: Dilumacad tunnel

highlights.zh: 石灰岩岛群
highlights.en: Limestone-island scenery

notes: Season sources disagree (Mar–May vs May & Nov shoulder months). Tunnel length (35–40 m) from search snippets only; zublu/dive.site pages returned 403.

summary.zh: 班达海南部的偏远火山岛链，只能船宿前往，航程受天气影响。尼拉、塞鲁阿等岛周边每年 10–11 月常见路氏双髻鲨群，规模从十几条到上百条。
summary.en: Remote volcanic islands in the southern Banda Sea, reached only by liveaboard; open-ocean crossings depend on weather. Around Nila, Nil Desperandum and Serua, scalloped hammerheads gather each year, typically October–November, in groups of ten to over a hundred.

highlights.zh: 双髻鲨群
highlights.en: Hammerhead aggregations

highlights.zh: 火山岛
highlights.en: Volcanic islands

highlights.zh: 仅限船宿
highlights.en: Liveaboard only

notes: Only ISRA Nila-Serua page read (aggregations Oct–Nov since 2015, Serua >200). Operators also cite Sep and a Mar–Apr crossing window; not confirmed. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 龙目岛西北的三座小岛，不通机动车。周边多是缓坡礁，海龟几乎每潜都见，Shark Point、Manta Point 一带常有礁鲨，偶有蝠鲼。潜店多，考证方便；从巴厘岛坐快船 1.5–2.5 小时。
summary.en: Three small islands off northwest Lombok with no motor traffic. The reefs are mostly gentle slopes where turtles appear on almost every dive, reef sharks are regular around Shark Point and Manta Point, and mantas turn up now and then. Dive centres are plentiful and courses easy to arrange. Fast boats from Bali take about 1.5–2.5 hours.

highlights.zh: Turtle Heaven 一潜常见多只海龟
highlights.en: Several turtles per dive at Turtle Heaven

highlights.zh: Shark Point 的放流，Manta Point 常见白顶礁鲨
highlights.en: Drift dives at Shark Point; whitetip reef sharks at Manta Point

highlights.zh: Gili Air 的浅礁适合新手和考证
highlights.en: Shallow, beginner-friendly reefs off Gili Air

highlights.zh: 从八丹拜或萨努尔坐快船，或从龙目岛 Bangsal 码头坐船 15–30 分钟
highlights.en: Fast boats from Padang Bai or Sanur, or 15–30 minutes by boat from Bangsal on Lombok

notes: 新增潜点。季节：PADI 写 4–11 月旱季最好、12–3 月雨季仍可潜但可能下雨、能见度降低；本地潜店 Manta Dive 写 4–10 月最好、全年可潜且基本不受季节影响；liveaboard.com 没写月份。取两者重叠的 4–10 月，11 月为肩季。搜索摘要里 Scuba Diving 杂志写 5–6 月与 10–11 月，原文 403 打不开，没采用。水温：liveaboard 26–30、Manta Dive 26–30、PADI 27–30，取 26–30。能见度：liveaboard 写可达 20 m 以上，PADI 写旱季常超 25 m，都没有下限，取 10–25（下限为估计，待补）。海龟：PADI 写绿海龟与玳瑁全年可见；维基写 Gili Meno 有海龟保育点。礁鲨：Manta Dive 写 Manta Point 常见白顶礁鲨、Shark Point 多为放流且常见鲨鱼；liveaboard 写白顶、黑鳍礁鲨多在有流的坡上。等级 OW：liveaboard 写多数潜点新手可潜，但 Shark Point 最深 35 m、不太适合新手，外侧潜点有季节性温跃层和较强的流；Manta Dive 写 Deep Turbo 流强、适合有经验者。access：liveaboard 写巴厘快船 1.5–2.5 小时（八丹拜或萨努尔）、Bangsal 15–30 分钟，龙目国际机场航班较少；PADI 写快船从八丹拜和 Serangan 每天开、岛上只有自行车和马车、最近的减压舱在马塔兰；维基写也有从 Amed 出发的快船。Manta Dive 提醒低潮时离船可能要走一段，选直接临海的潜店。坐标取维基百科群岛坐标（-8.35, 116.06），三岛彼此相距几公里。

summary.zh: 苏拉威西北部，美娜多飞约 1 小时。城东 Botubarani 村离岸百米常有幼年鲸鲨，水深 3–15 米，3–8 月较多；托米尼湾礁墙有扭曲的“达利海绵”。
summary.en: North Sulawesi, about an hour's flight from Manado. At Botubarani village, 20 minutes east of town, juvenile whale sharks (3.5–6 m) gather about 100 m offshore in 3–15 m of water, most often March–August. Tomini Bay walls drop steeply and host contorted 'Salvador Dali' sponges deeper down.

highlights.zh: 近岸幼年鲸鲨
highlights.en: Inshore juvenile whale sharks

highlights.zh: 托米尼湾礁墙
highlights.en: Tomini Bay walls

highlights.zh: 达利海绵
highlights.en: 'Salvador Dali' sponges

notes: Study (2016–2024, 59 individuals) gives near year-round presence, peak Mar–Aug; dive-the-world says June. Locals fed shrimp heads to the sharks (2018 reports) and tourism injuries are recorded; check current rules.

summary.zh: 北马鲁古最大的岛，夹在苏拉威西与四王群岛之间，潜水员很少。蒂福雷岛海山的梭鱼群号称上千条，Weda 湾的 Shark Mountain 鲨鱼很常见，夜潜可找特有的哈马黑拉肩章鲨。多从特尔纳特登船。
summary.en: The largest island of North Maluku, between Sulawesi and Raja Ampat, and still lightly dived. The Tifore seamount holds a barracuda school often put at a thousand fish, Shark Mountain in Weda Bay is reliable for sharks, and night dives turn up the endemic Halmahera walking shark. Most trips are liveaboards boarding at Ternate.

highlights.zh: 蒂福雷岛海山的梭鱼群与大眼鲹
highlights.en: Barracuda and bigeye trevally on the Tifore seamount

highlights.zh: Weda 湾 Shark Mountain 的灰礁鲨
highlights.en: Grey reef sharks at Shark Mountain in Weda Bay

highlights.zh: 夜潜找会用鳍'走路'的哈马黑拉肩章鲨
highlights.en: Night dives for the endemic Halmahera walking shark

highlights.zh: 帕廷蒂海峡与巴占一带 40 多个潜点，离岸都在 15 分钟内
highlights.en: More than 40 sites within 15 minutes of shore around the Patinti Strait and Bacan

notes: 新增潜点；中文名取中文维基'哈马黑拉岛'。季节：DTW 写 4–10 月旱季（东南季风期海面较平）最佳，12–2 月雨多、5–6 月雨最大最频、7–8 月海峡风大流急，8–9 月雨量明显下降；liveaboard.com 正文写 3–11 月、7–8 月有强信风，FAQ 写约 4–10 月；Bluewater 写 3–11 月最佳、12–2 月雨季。取 DTW 与 liveaboard FAQ 一致的 4–10 月，3 月、11 月为肩季。水温：DTW 季内 27–28（总表 27–30），liveaboard 约 29（FAQ 26–30），Bluewater 28–30，取 27–30。能见度：DTW 季内 20–30（总表 12–30），Bluewater 20–30，取 12–30。等级 AOW：DTW 总表中级到进阶（Weda 湾各级都可、流很少强），liveaboard 写更适合有经验、能自理的潜水员。access：DTW 与 liveaboard 都写经特尔纳特苏丹巴布拉机场（雅加达、美娜多每天有航班），北马鲁古航线 7–12 晚，也有比通（蓝碧）与索龙之间的过境航线 10–14 晚；Bluewater 写特尔纳特坐船 30–45 分钟到哈马黑拉。Weda 湾：DTW 写 35 km 范围内 40 多个潜点、Shark Mountain 离岸约 11 km。蒂福雷岛在哈马黑拉与苏拉威西之间的海山上（DTW），季节性上升流时还有双髻鲨。蝠鲼：DTW 写 Goraici 一带 Lilai 以西的红树林小岛常有；Bluewater 写全年可见、3–5 月最多。肩章鲨学名 Hemiscyllium halmahera，DTW 写在 Weda 湾发现、在帕廷蒂海峡、特尔纳特、Weda 湾夜潜常见。坐标为特尔纳特（维基百科 0.780, 127.382），船宿出发港；Weda 湾在哈马黑拉东岸，没找到可靠坐标。

summary.zh: 新爱尔兰岛北端，从莫尔兹比港飞约 1.5 小时。信天翁水道等海峡涨潮时放流，常见灰礁鲨、鹰鳐、梭鱼和金枪鱼；港内有二战水上飞机残骸。水流强，需有经验。
summary.en: Town at the northern tip of New Ireland, about 1.5 hours by air from Port Moresby. Tidal channels such as Albatross Passage are drift dives with grey reef sharks, eagle rays, barracuda and tuna on an incoming tide; WWII floatplanes lie in the harbour. Currents are often strong.

highlights.zh: 信天翁水道放流
highlights.en: Albatross Passage drift

highlights.zh: 灰礁鲨与鹰鳐
highlights.en: Grey reef sharks and eagle rays

highlights.zh: 二战水上飞机残骸
highlights.en: WWII floatplane wrecks

notes: Seasons: May–Dec (underwaterasia) vs Apr–Jul and Sep–Nov (diveadventures); Jan–Mar has more bad weather. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 新不列颠岛北岸的大海湾，从 Hoskins 机场开车约 1 小时到度假村。40 多处潜点多是深水中升起的海山和礁墙，海扇、软珊瑚密布，常有梭鱼和鲹鱼群；海豚常跟船，偶见虎鲸。还有一架二战零式战机残骸。
summary.en: A wide bay on the north coast of New Britain, with its dive base about an hour's drive from Hoskins airport. Its 40-plus sites are mostly seamounts and walls rising from deep water, draped in sea fans and soft coral and patrolled by barracuda and trevally. Dolphins often ride the bow, orcas appear occasionally, and a WWII Zero fighter lies at 17 m.

highlights.zh: 海山顶上的梭鱼与杰克鱼群
highlights.en: Barracuda and trevally schools over the seamounts

highlights.zh: 17 米深的二战零式战机
highlights.en: A WWII Zero fighter at 17 m

highlights.zh: 海扇和软珊瑚覆盖的礁墙
highlights.en: Walls hung with sea fans and soft coral

highlights.zh: 偶遇虎鲸与领航鲸
highlights.en: Occasional orcas and pilot whales

notes: 新增潜点。季节 5–10 月：巴新旅游局西新不列颠省页写 5–10 月旱季、金贝湾能见度更好；liveaboard.com 巴新总页写 5–11 月是最热门的潜水月份、全年没有不好的时候；Walindi 度假村 FAQ 写传统雨季 1–3 月、旱季 6–8 月；Walindi 首页写两条船宿全年都跑。取旅游局的 5–10 月。潜点与生物：Walindi 写 40 多处潜点、海山、峭壁、常驻梭鱼和杰克鱼群，是 Mission Blue 的 Hope Spot（'全球一半以上珊瑚种类'属宣传语，未用）；巴新旅游局写 400 多种珊瑚、900 种鱼，有海豚和领航鲸；liveaboard 金贝湾页写 350 多种造礁珊瑚、900 多种鱼，有路氏双髻鲨、灰礁鲨、白顶礁鲨，偶有虎鲸、抹香鲸、领航鲸，飞旋 / 宽吻海豚常跟船，零式战机在 17 m，Bradford Shoals 顶部约 20 m、South Emma 顶部约 12 m，有评论说大风后湾内能见度变差。交通：Walindi FAQ 写从莫尔兹比港飞 Hoskins（Air Niugini、PNG Air 每天有航班），度假村接驳约 1 小时；liveaboard 写船宿从 Walindi 出发。水温：巴新旅游局潜水页 25–29（全国）、liveaboard 24–29，取 25–29；能见度没有金贝湾专属数字，15–45 取 liveaboard 巴新总页的全国说法。等级 OW：海山顶 12–20 m，深处宜 AOW。species 里虎鲸是偶遇，排最后。中文名'金贝'与中文维基（西新不列颠省首府）一致。坐标为 Walindi 度假村一带（约 5.45S, 150.08E，地图常识，±10 km），金贝镇约 [150.14, -5.55]。

summary.zh: 潮汐强流塑造的国家公园。北部 Batu Bolong、Castle Rock 鱼群密集、礁鲨常见；南部水温可低至 20°C，Manta Alley 等清洁站常有多条蝠鲼。大多是放流，流况听潜导判断。
summary.en: A national park shaped by tidal currents. In the north, Batu Bolong and Castle Rock are thick with fish and reef sharks; in the south the water can drop to around 20°C, and cleaning stations such as Manta Alley often hold several mantas at once. Most dives are drifts, so follow your guide's read of the current.

highlights.zh: Manta Alley、Manta Point 的蝠鲼清洁站
highlights.en: Manta cleaning stations at Manta Alley and Manta Point

highlights.zh: Batu Bolong 的鱼群与礁鲨
highlights.en: Fish-packed walls and reef sharks at Batu Bolong

highlights.zh: 豆丁海马、躄鱼、鬼龙等微距也很多
highlights.en: Plenty of macro too: pygmy seahorses, frogfish, ghost pipefish

highlights.zh: 可顺路上岸看科莫多巨蜥
highlights.en: Shore visits to see Komodo dragons

notes: 季节：DTW 与 liveaboard.com 一致写 4–11 月旱季（北部 / 中部海况最好、能见度最高），保留种子的 4–11 月。分歧：Divernet（2025-10，FAQ）写 5–9 月；liveaboard.com 写南部 10–4 月更好（冷水上涌但海面较乱）；DTW 写全年都有船宿、4 月常被认为最好、11–1 月能见度最好（常超 30 m）、蝠鲼 12–2 月最多、翻车鲀 8 月；1–3 月北部、7–8 月南部海面较乱。水温：DTW 20–28（北 25–28、南 20–25），liveaboard 北 27–29、南 22–24，合并 20–29。能见度 5–30 取 DTW。等级：liveaboard.com 写强烈建议 AOW、不少行程要求 30–50 潜、流可达 8 节。liveaboard.com 写入园须带日期的电子票，并称 2026 年 9–12 月在每日 1,000 人基础上至少再加 500 个名额、2027 年配额未公布，未见官方原文，待核实。坐标由种子的科莫多岛陆地改为 Batu Bolong（Dive Against Debris 记录 -8.536, 119.614，单一来源），北部 / 中部潜区中心；纳闽巴焦码头约在 [119.88, -8.49]。types 把种子的 muck 换成 pelagic（大货是招牌，泥底不是）；species 加白顶礁鲨（DTW、liveaboard 都列出）。

summary.zh: 山打根东北约 50 公里的苏禄海小岛，船程约 2 小时，属沙巴首个私营海洋保护区。潜点都很近：沙底找躄鱼、剃刀鱼和后颌鱼，礁上有豹纹鲨和小沉船；3–5 月可能遇到鲸鲨。1–2 月度假村关闭。
summary.en: A small Sulu Sea island about 50 km northeast of Sandakan, 1.5–2 hours by boat, inside Sabah's first privately managed marine protected area. More than 30 sites lie within 15 minutes: sand patches with frogfish, ghost pipefish and jawfish, reefs with leopard sharks, and a few small wrecks. Whale sharks pass from March to May. The island's only resort closes in January and February.

highlights.zh: 3–5 月的鲸鲨
highlights.en: Whale sharks from March to May

highlights.zh: Jawfish Lair 约 28 米处的黄后颌鱼
highlights.en: Yellow jawfish at about 28 m at Jawfish Lair

highlights.zh: Lost Reef 的豹纹鲨
highlights.en: Leopard sharks at Lost Reef

highlights.zh: 岛上的海龟孵化放流（6–9 月为主）
highlights.en: Turtle hatchling releases, mainly June–September

notes: 替补潜点：任务清单里的阿尼洛、墨宝、马布与卡帕莱已在库，拉央拉央没收录（见总备注），补一个同在沙巴的兰卡央；若与别的 agent 重复可删。季节 3–10 月：DTW 兰卡央潜点页写度假村只在 1–2 月关闭、北婆罗洲雨季约 11–2 月（大雨后能见度下降）、鲸鲨 4–5 月最可能、海龟全年都有（孵化放流主要 6–9 月）；DTW 度假村页写 3–12 月开放、1–2 月因天气关闭、鲸鲨约 3–5 月；沙巴旅游局写鲸鲨 3–5 月。取开放且非雨季的 3–10 月，11–12 月为肩季。DTW 两页是同一来源，季节交叉靠沙巴旅游局的鲸鲨月份。保护区：DTW 写 SIMCA（Sugud Islands Marine Conservation Area）是沙巴第一个私营管理的海洋保护区，46,317 公顷，含 Lankayan、Billean、Tegapil 三岛；沙巴旅游局写全岛严格禁捕、Reef Guardian 管理孵化场。交通：DTW 写山打根东北约 50 km、船程 1.5–2 小时、没有船宿来；沙巴旅游局写约 2 小时、船通常 10:30 从山打根 PSR 码头出发、7:00 从岛上返回，30 多个潜点都在 15 分钟船程内、最深约 24 m（DTW 写 5–30 m）。生物：DTW 写躄鱼、剃刀鱼、海蛞蝓、乌贼、拟态章鱼，Jawfish Lair 约 28 m 有黄后颌鱼，Lost Reef 有豹纹鲨和竹鲨，Turtle Patch 有绿海龟和玳瑁，Jetty / Lankayan / Mosquito 沉船；DTW 度假村页写可岸潜（不许单潜）。水温 26–30、能见度 3–25 取 DTW。中文名'兰卡央岛'按国内旅行社常用写法，没能用中文来源核实。坐标为兰卡央岛（约 6.50N, 117.92E，地图常识），±2 km。

summary.zh: 火山黑沙铺底的狭窄海峡，几乎就是泥底微距潜水的代名词。拟态章鱼、毛躄鱼、火焰乌贼和豆丁海马，一潜里都可能遇到。水浅流缓，靠的是慢慢找和潜导的眼力，而不是游得远。
summary.en: A narrow strait floored with volcanic black sand and a byword for muck diving. Mimic octopus, hairy frogfish, flamboyant cuttlefish and pygmy seahorses can all turn up on a single dive. Sites are shallow with gentle current; success depends on slow searching and a sharp-eyed guide rather than distance covered.

highlights.zh: 黑沙上的拟态章鱼与毛躄鱼
highlights.en: Mimic octopus and hairy frogfish on black sand

highlights.zh: Police Pier 的火焰乌贼与躄鱼
highlights.en: Flamboyant cuttlefish and frogfish at Police Pier

highlights.zh: TK1 的麒麟鱼
highlights.en: Mandarinfish at TK1

highlights.zh: 7–8 月小生物最多，水温降到 25–26°C
highlights.en: Peak critter season in July–August, with water down to 25–26°C

notes: 新增潜点。季节：liveaboard.com 写全年可潜、11–2 月为雨季、约 4–11 月较干、海况和能见度更好；DTW FAQ 写北苏拉威西 3–10 月最佳、7–8 月是蓝碧看小生物的高峰；DTW 潜点页写 10–12 月能见度最好、1–2 月最差且北端外露潜点可能停潜、6–9 月东南季风海面会起浪。按'优先运营商'取 liveaboard.com 的 4–11 月；3 月按 DTW FAQ 算肩季。水温 25–29 取 DTW（liveaboard 正文 25–29、FAQ 26–30）；能见度 10–25 取 DTW（liveaboard：通常约 20 m，大雨后可降到 4 m）。access：住蓝碧岛 / 比通一侧的度假村坐船潜为主，DTW 写 Lembeh Resort 有岸潜，也有船宿经过。DTW 写入境需缴一年一次的潜水许可费（金额未写）。距美娜多约 45 km、车程 1.5–2 小时（DTW、liveaboard）。wreck 来自 DTW 列出的 Mawali Wreck。招牌拟态章鱼 / 火焰乌贼在 species.json 里没有对应 id，贴纸先用躄鱼。坐标为海峡中段，按地图常识取，±2 km。

summary.zh: 诗巴丹北边的两处浅礁：马布岛的沙坡与旧钻井平台、卡帕莱高脚屋下的礁坡，藏着躄鱼、火焰乌贼、海蛞蝓和麒麟鱼。水浅流缓，适合慢慢找微距，也是等诗巴丹许可时的落脚点。
summary.en: Two shallow reefs north of Sipadan. Mabul's sandy slopes and old oil-rig platform, and the reef around Kapalai's stilt resort, hide frogfish, flamboyant cuttlefish, nudibranchs and mandarinfish. Gentle current and modest depths make for unhurried macro diving, and most divers base here while waiting for a Sipadan permit.

highlights.zh: 旧钻井平台下的彩色躄鱼与夜潜
highlights.en: Colourful frogfish and night dives under the old oil-rig platform

highlights.zh: 卡帕莱 Mandarin Valley 的麒麟鱼
highlights.en: Mandarinfish at Kapalai's Mandarin Valley

highlights.zh: Lobster Wall 的海龟与火焰乌贼
highlights.en: Turtles and flamboyant cuttlefish at Lobster Wall

highlights.zh: 多数潜点 5–20 米，新手也能潜
highlights.en: Most sites sit at 5–20 m and suit beginners

notes: 新增潜点（种子里没有），马布与卡帕莱合并为一条，因为两者相距约 5 km、行程总是捆绑。季节：DTW 写全年可潜、12–2 月雨季，3–9 月旱季能见度最好；liveaboard.com 马布页与卡帕莱页都写 3–10 月最佳。取 3–10 月，10 月按 DTW 算肩季。11 月诗巴丹闭岛但马布 / 卡帕莱照常（Sabah Parks 公告只针对诗巴丹）。水温：DTW / liveaboard 马布 27–29，liveaboard 卡帕莱 26–30，合并 26–30。能见度 5–15 取 DTW（liveaboard 只说'常见能见度有限'）。麒麟鱼：liveaboard 马布页写 Paradise 鹿角珊瑚里、卡帕莱页写 Mandarin Valley；DTW 马布页未提。Sabah Tourism：Semporna 码头约 45 分钟船程。DTW：马布在诗巴丹以北 12 km（约 25 分钟船程）、卡帕莱以西 5 km。钻井平台潜点原名 Seaventure Platform（度假村名），页面文案里改写成'旧钻井平台'以避开品牌。可考虑以后加 flamboyant-cuttlefish（火焰乌贼）物种，马布 / 蓝碧 / 阿尼洛都能用。坐标为马布岛（约 4.25N, 118.63E），按地图常识取，精度约 ±2 km。

summary.zh: 宿务国际机场所在的岛。东岸度假村的礁坡可岸潜、夜潜，坐船不远就到两处小岛保护区，看海龟、燕鱼和石斑。Marigondon 洞穴（37 米）和渡轮沉船较深，适合有经验的潜水员；Olango 海峡流较强。
summary.en: The island that holds Cebu's international airport. Resort house reefs on the east coast are dived from shore and at night, and short boat rides reach the Hilutungan and Nalusuan sanctuaries for turtles, batfish and groupers. Marigondon Cave (37 m) and the San Juan ferry wreck suit experienced divers, and the Olango channel brings stronger currents.

highlights.zh: Hilutungan 保护区的海龟与燕鱼
highlights.en: Turtles and batfish in the Hilutungan sanctuary

highlights.zh: Kontiki 礁的夜潜
highlights.en: Night dives on the Kontiki house reef

highlights.zh: Marigondon 洞穴里的灯眼鱼
highlights.en: Flashlight fish inside Marigondon Cave

highlights.zh: Tambuli 飞机残骸上的躄鱼
highlights.en: Frogfish on the Tambuli plane wreck

notes: 新增潜点。全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 宿务页写 2–5 月旱季、11–1 月晴但多雨可能有台风、6–10 月雨季约一半日子下雨，宿务全年可潜；liveaboard.com 宿务页写全年可潜，避开 11 月下旬–1 月台风多发期，区域雨季 7–12 月。潜点：DTW 写 Hilutungan 保护区（燕鱼、海龟、鹦嘴鱼、胡椒鲷）、Nalusuan 保护区（蓝点魟、大石斑、桌面珊瑚）、Kontiki 礁夜潜（虾蟹、海蛇）、Shangri-La 保护区（2007 年起，海蛞蝓、躄鱼）、Tambuli 飞机残骸（离岸约 1.6 km、最深 20 m，躄鱼）、Marigondon 洞（最深 37 m、入口 10 m 宽、穿行约 40 m、有灯眼鱼，不适合新手，建议高氧）、San Juan 渡轮沉船（180 m 长，37–48 m，仅限有资质者）、Olango 另一侧的 Kansantik 尖峰（流强）；liveaboard 写 Olango 有白鳍礁鲨、梭鱼甚至锤头鲨、流可强，新手也有珊瑚园、沉船、礁墙可选。PADI 博客写麦克坦岛有岸潜、礁墙和漂流，宿务机场就在岛上。等级 OW（多数礁坡与保护区）；洞穴和深沉船需更高资质。水温：DTW 26.5–29.5、liveaboard 多在 27–30（冬季深处约 24），取 26–30；能见度 DTW 15–20、旱季可超 30，取 15–30。中文名'麦克坦岛'与中文维基一致。坐标为东岸 Maribago 一带（约 10.29N, 124.00E），±2 km。

summary.zh: 从莫尔兹比港飞约 1 小时。潟湖内有 B-25 轰炸机等沉船，魔法水道放流常见梭鱼、杰克鱼和礁鲨；夜潜可找当地特有的肩章鲨。外海离岛和海山有鱼群和鲨鱼。
summary.en: About an hour by air from Port Moresby. Inside the lagoon lie a WWII B-25 bomber and several shipwrecks; Magic Passage is a drift dive with barracuda, trevally and reef sharks. Night dives can find the locally endemic hooded epaulette (walking) shark. Outer islands and seamounts draw schooling fish and sharks.

highlights.zh: 魔法水道放流
highlights.en: Magic Passage drift

highlights.zh: 二战 B-25 残骸
highlights.en: WWII B-25 bomber

highlights.zh: 肩章鲨夜潜
highlights.en: Walking-shark night dives

notes: Season unclear: underwaterasia says diveable year-round with May–Oct rain lowering nearshore visibility; generic PNG guides say dry season late Apr–mid Dec. Walking shark here is Hemiscyllium strahani. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 宿务北端小岛。天亮前出海，到 Monad 或 Kimod 浅滩清洁站等长尾鲨上来；12–5 月 Kimod 还有锤头鲨群。黄昏在 Lighthouse 看麒麟鱼求偶，Gato 岛洞里常有白顶礁鲨休息。
summary.en: A small island off the northern tip of Cebu. Boats leave before dawn for the cleaning stations on Monad and Kimod shoals, where thresher sharks rise from deeper water; from December to May, Kimod also draws scalloped hammerheads. At dusk mandarinfish mate at Lighthouse, and whitetip reef sharks rest in the cave at Gato Island.

highlights.zh: 黎明的长尾鲨清洁站
highlights.en: Dawn thresher shark dives at the cleaning stations

highlights.zh: 12–5 月 Kimod 的锤头鲨群
highlights.en: Scalloped hammerheads at Kimod, December–May

highlights.zh: Lighthouse 黄昏的麒麟鱼
highlights.en: Mandarinfish courtship at Lighthouse at dusk

highlights.zh: Gato 岛洞穴里的白顶礁鲨
highlights.en: Whitetip reef sharks in Gato Island's cave

notes: 全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 与 liveaboard.com 都写长尾鲨全年都在，保留种子。海况：DTW 写 2 月下旬–5 月最平静（能见度 15–25 m、水温 27–29），6–9 月有水母、建议全身防寒衣，10–12 月台风季、能见度可降到 5–10 m；DTW 菲律宾总页写米沙鄢全年可潜、1–5 月为旺季；liveaboard 写 7–12 月为雨季但比宿务少雨。分歧：DTW 写长尾鲨因锤头鲨出现（尤其 1–4 月）已大多离开 Monad，现在 Kimod（平台 12–14 m）更可靠；liveaboard.com 与 Divernet（2025-10）仍写 Monad 每天可见、约 5 点出发、距岛约 20 分钟。所以摘要两个浅滩都写。锤头鲨：liveaboard 写 12–5 月、4 月前后可见多达 200 条一群；DTW 写 2 月下旬–5 月最好、12 月起可见。等级 AOW 沿用种子（Monad 清洁站约 25 m）；liveaboard 写 OW + 10–20 潜即可，Kimod 平台较浅。水温：DTW 26–29（冬季深处 25），liveaboard 24–30，取 25–29；能见度 5–25 取 DTW。交通：宿务市巴士约 5 小时、打车约一半（liveaboard）；DTW 写距宿务市约 140 km。Divernet 列出 55 m 的二战 Pioneer 沉船（技术潜）。坐标沿用种子（岛上，潜店所在）。

summary.zh: 仙本那约 40–45 分钟船程的度假岛，连同邦邦岛、汀巴汀巴周边有 30 多个潜点。水流通常较缓，适合新手；常见躄鱼、魟鱼、海龟和麒麟鱼等微距，岛旁有一处小沉船。
summary.en: Resort island 40–45 min by speedboat from Semporna; with nearby Pom Pom and Timba Timba there are 30+ sites. Currents are usually mild and suit beginners. Frogfish, stingrays, turtles and macro such as mandarinfish are common, and there is a small wreck off the island.

highlights.zh: 躄鱼与微距
highlights.en: Frogfish and macro

highlights.zh: 跳岛邦邦岛、汀巴汀巴
highlights.en: Hop to Pom Pom and Timba Timba

highlights.zh: 浅水小沉船
highlights.en: Small shallow wreck

highlights.zh: 5–8 月海龟上岸产卵
highlights.en: Turtles nest May–Aug

notes: Location agreed by both sources; season only from wonderfulmalaysia (Apr–Jun best vis) and a travel page (Apr–Oct). Pom Pom is a separate island ~10 km away, kept as alias. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 巴厘岛西北角外、西巴厘国家公园里的小岛，名字在印尼语里就是'鹿'。南侧和东侧的峭壁挂满柳珊瑚和软珊瑚，分别下探到 30 米和 60 米；有岛遮挡，海面多半平静。从佩姆德兰坐快艇约 30 分钟。
summary.en: A small island in West Bali National Park, off Bali's northwest coast; its name means 'deer'. Walls on the south and east sides, hung with sea fans and soft coral, drop to 30 m and 60 m, and the sheltered setting keeps the surface mostly calm. Speedboats from Pemuteran take about 30 minutes.

highlights.zh: 峭壁上的柳珊瑚和软珊瑚，25 米左右可找豆丁海马
highlights.en: Sea fans and soft coral on the walls, with pygmy seahorses around 25 m

highlights.zh: 19 世纪木船 Anker Wreck，船尾在 50 米
highlights.en: Anker Wreck, a 19th-century wooden ship whose stern lies at 50 m

highlights.zh: 10–11 月能见度最好，可超 50 米
highlights.en: Best visibility in October–November, sometimes beyond 50 m

highlights.zh: 船从佩姆德兰或国家公园的 Labuhan Lalang 码头出发
highlights.en: Boats leave from Pemuteran or the park jetty at Labuhan Lalang

notes: 新增潜点（替补：任务列表里的蓝碧、布纳肯、图兰奔、佩尼达已在库）。中文名：Menjangan 在印尼语 / 巴厘语里意为'鹿'（维基），国内多称'鹿岛'；为免与别处的'鹿岛'混淆写作'巴厘岛鹿岛'，仿'三亚蜈支洲岛'。搜索额度用完，'鹿岛'的通行程度没再核实；音译'门姜岸'等没有统一写法。季节：PADI 写 4–11 月（东南季风期）最好、全年可潜；DTW 巴厘页写巴厘全年可潜、12–3 月雨季北部和西部能见度有时下降，没有单写鹿岛季节。取 4–11 月。能见度：PADI 15–30 m，10–11 月水平能见度可超 50 m；DTW 写能见度'偶尔惊人'、位置隐蔽很少有浪。水温：两源都没有鹿岛专门数据，取 PADI Amed 页（巴厘北岸）的 26–29°C；DTW 巴厘总表 19–26 主要受佩尼达冷水影响，不适用，待补。峭壁：DTW 写南岸到 30 m、东侧到 60 m，有洞穴和悬垂。Anker Wreck：DTW 写约 25 m 长、运过瓷器和铜、5 m 处有锚、船头在峭壁底、船尾 50 m、有白顶礁鲨；PADI 写在 40 m、适合有经验者，Eel Garden、Pos II、Coral Garden、Bat Cave 最热门，常见海龟、梭鱼、大眼鲹。access：PADI 写从佩姆德兰出发、快艇约 30 分钟，佩姆德兰距巴厘机场约 3 小时车程；DTW 写全部从 Labuhan Lalang 码头出发、须用 8 m 国家公园船；维基写所有潜店都有每日行程。坐标取维基百科（-8.083, 114.517）。

summary.zh: 巴新东南端，从阿洛陶出发。Dinah's Beach 一带的黑沙坡被视为“泥底潜”（muck diving）的发源地，常见躄鱼、剃刀鱼、拟态章鱼和大量海蛞蝓。外海还有礁墙、二战沉船和蝠鲼清洁站。
summary.en: At the southeastern tip of Papua New Guinea, reached via Alotau. The black-sand slopes at Dinah's Beach and Lauadi are often called the birthplace of muck diving, with frogfish, ghost pipefish, mimic octopus and a long list of nudibranchs. Further out there are walls, WWII wrecks including the B-17 'Black Jack', and a manta cleaning station at Gonu Bara Bara.

highlights.zh: 泥底潜发源地的黑沙坡
highlights.en: The black-sand slopes where muck diving began

highlights.zh: 2026 年一次 6 天调查记到 167 种海蛞蝓
highlights.en: 167 nudibranch species logged in six days on a 2026 survey

highlights.zh: Gonu Bara Bara 的蝠鲼清洁站
highlights.en: Manta cleaning station at Gonu Bara Bara

highlights.zh: B-17“Black Jack”轰炸机残骸（深潜）
highlights.en: The deep B-17 'Black Jack' bomber wreck

notes: 新增潜点。verified 设为 false：最佳季节两个来源说法相反。全年（bestMonths 为空），来源有冲突：liveaboard.com 米尔恩湾页写 1–4 月是黄金期（与巴新其他地区的雨季相反），但'一年中任何时候都适合'；巴新旅游局米尔恩湾省页写 5–10 月旱季最好、海况平静能见度高；liveaboard 巴新总页写米尔恩湾 7–8 月（冬季）跑较短的航次；巴新旅游局潜水页写全国全年可潜、5–11 月为旺季。两边各说一段、又都写全年可潜，暂取全年；请用户考虑改成 1–4 月（船宿平台说法）还是 5–10 月（旅游局说法，疑为全省通用文案）。泥底潜起源：liveaboard 写 Dinah's Beach 被认为是 'muck diving' 开始的地方；Tawali 度假村写 Lauadi 是'泥底潜的诞生地'、1980 年代开始；巴新旅游局写米尔恩湾与泥底潜早期发展密切相关。生物：Tawali 写 2026 年 Great Tawali Nudibranch Expedition 6 天记录 167 种海蛞蝓，还有躄鱼、剃刀鱼、拟态章鱼；liveaboard 写柳珊瑚上的豆丁海马、拟态章鱼、Wunderpus、须鲨、躄鱼、路氏双髻鲨、蝠鲼，偶有鲸鲨和小须鲸；Gonu Bara Bara（Giants@Home）是单个礁丘上的蝠鲼清洁站；B-17 'Black Jack' 在礁墙底部深水处；1888 年的 Muscoota 帆船残骸在 Discovery Bay。蝠鲼种类没核实（旅游局图注写 giant manta），所以 species 没放蝠鲼。水温 24–29（liveaboard）。能见度没有本地数字（Tawali 页的数值是占位符），10–30 为估计值。交通：巴新旅游局写莫尔兹比港每天有航班飞阿洛陶 Gurney 机场（距镇约 12 km）；Tawali 只能从阿洛陶坐船到，潜点 10–40 分钟船程，60 多个潜点在 1 小时内。中文名'米尔恩湾''阿洛陶'与中文维基一致；摘要里用简称'巴新'省字数。坐标为阿洛陶（10°18′S 150°27′E），±2 km。

summary.zh: 四王群岛最南端，度假村巡护着约 1,220 平方公里的保护区。挂满软珊瑚的石灰岩小岛和水下石窗是招牌，Magic Mountain 有蝠鲼清洁站。离索龙快艇 4–5 小时，6 月中到 9 月中停业。
summary.en: The southern end of Raja Ampat, inside a reserve of about 1,220 km² set up and patrolled by the local resort. Limestone islets and underwater arches draped in soft coral are the signature, and the Magic Mountain seamount is a manta cleaning station. The speedboat from Sorong takes 4–5 hours, and the resort closes from mid-June to mid-September for the monsoon.

highlights.zh: Magic Mountain 的礁蝠鲼与大洋蝠鲼
highlights.en: Reef and oceanic mantas at Magic Mountain

highlights.zh: Boo Windows 的两扇水下石窗
highlights.en: The two swim-through windows at Boo

highlights.zh: Fiabacet 小岛群的柳珊瑚上可找豆丁海马
highlights.en: Pygmy seahorses on the sea fans of the Fiabacet islets

highlights.zh: 9–12 月常有成群的小型蝠鲼追食鳀鱼
highlights.en: Squadrons of mobula rays chasing anchovy shoals, September–December

notes: 新增潜点；库里已有 raja-ampat（丹皮尔海峡一带），米苏尔距离远、有自己的度假村和船宿航段，单列。中文名取中文维基'米苏尔岛'。季节：度假村博客（The seasons of Misool，2022-04）写南季风 6 月中到 9 月初，风 30–40 节、浪 3–4 m、水浑，度假村每年停业、9 月中重开；DTW 度假村页价目表的营业期为 1 月初–5 月下旬与 9 月下旬–12 月底（淡季价 5 月底–6 月中、9 月 19–29 日）；liveaboard.com 季节页写四王 10–5 月为旺季、6–9 月风浪大部分区域去不了。取 10–5 月，9 月下旬与 6 月上旬为肩季。蝠鲼：度假村写全年都有、礁蝠鲼与大洋蝠鲼都见；liveaboard 季节页写 12–4 月丹皮尔与米苏尔清洁站概率最高；DTW 写 9–10 月饵球与 mobula 多、5–6 月鲨鱼和大货多。保护区：DTW 写度假村设立并巡护 1,220 km² 禁渔区（2005 年设立）；Bluewater 写 1,220 km² 海洋保护区，其中 828 km² 禁渔，两者不一致，摘要只写保护区面积。快艇：度假村 getting-here 页写约 5 小时，DTW 同页写 4 小时和约 5 小时。水温：liveaboard 写 28–30。能见度：liveaboard 写可达 30 m 以上，评论里 4、7、12 月都有人嫌浑，取 10–30。等级 AOW：liveaboard 写流比四王其他区温和，但仍更适合有经验者。软珊瑚是招牌这一点：DTW 特里顿湾页拿米苏尔的软珊瑚作比较基准，liveaboard 写 Boo 为旗舰潜点。肩章鲨：度假村博客写夜潜可见四王肩章鲨，liveaboard 也列出 epaulette 'walking' shark。坐标取维基百科米苏尔岛坐标（-1.895, 130.084，岛中心）；主要潜区和度假村所在的 Batbitim 在岛东南的保护区里，没找到可靠坐标，±40 km，有条件时改到度假村位置。

summary.zh: 宿务西岸的小镇，Panagsama 海滩外不远就是数以百万计的沙丁鱼群，浅水就能看到，而且全年都在。坐船到 Pescador 岛可潜峭壁和洞穴，Tongo Point 的海龟常在礁洞里睡觉。
summary.en: A town on Cebu's west coast where millions of sardines swirl just off Panagsama Beach, in shallow water and all year round. A boat ride away, Pescador Island offers a steep wall and a cavern, and turtles often sleep in reef holes at Tongo Point.

highlights.zh: 岸边就能潜的沙丁鱼风暴
highlights.en: A sardine swarm you can reach from the beach

highlights.zh: Pescador 岛的峭壁与 Cathedral 洞穴
highlights.en: Pescador Island's wall and the Cathedral cavern

highlights.zh: Tongo Point 的绿海龟与玳瑁
highlights.en: Green and hawksbill turtles at Tongo Point

highlights.zh: Panagsama 礁上的躄鱼、豆丁海马等微距
highlights.en: Macro on Panagsama reef: frogfish and pygmy seahorses

notes: 新增潜点。全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 宿务页写沙丁鱼'全年'都在 Panagsama 礁；liveaboard.com 写全年可潜、总有避风的潜点。季节背景：DTW 写 2–5 月旱季、6–10 月雨季（约一半日子下雨）；liveaboard 写区域雨季 7–12 月；DTW 菲律宾总页写米沙鄢 1–5 月为旺季。沙丁鱼：liveaboard 写几年前鱼群迁到 Panagsama 海滩、就在岸边、浮潜也能看到，入水轻松；没有来源明说'岸潜'，但这是潜店的常规做法，access 写 shore + boat（Pescador 必须坐船）。DTW：Pescador 是海洋保护区、峭壁深可达 600 m，Cathedral 洞 15–37 m；Sunken Island 22 m 起、不适合新手；Tongo Point 有绿海龟、玳瑁。水温：DTW 区域 26.5–29.5（6 月最暖、2 月最冷），liveaboard 27–30，取 26–30；能见度：DTW 区域旱季可超 30 m、雨季 15–20 m，取 15–30。等级 OW：liveaboard 写 OW + 10–20 潜。DTW 提到的鲸鲨（2–4 月）指 Oslob 喂食点，不在本条。坐标为 Panagsama 海滩（约 9.95, 123.37），按地图常识取，±1 km；Pescador 岛约在 [123.34, 9.92]。

summary.zh: 哈马黑拉岛以北的偏远岛屿，1944 年盟军登陆后在此修建机场，沿岸海底留有二战飞机、吉普车和沉船。已记录潜点 28 个，珊瑚礁很少有人潜，浅水可见黑鳍礁鲨。岛南有机场。
summary.en: A remote island north of Halmahera where Allied forces landed in 1944 and built airfields. WWII aircraft, a jeep and a shipwreck lie off the coast, and 28 dive sites have been recorded on reefs that see very few divers, with blacktip reef sharks in the shallows. The island has its own airport on the south coast.

highlights.zh: Wawama、Totodaku 的二战盟军飞机与吉普车
highlights.en: WWII Allied aircraft and a jeep at Wawama and Totodaku

highlights.zh: 约 40 米深的飞机残骸，据信是一架 Bristol Beaufort
highlights.en: An aircraft at about 40 m, believed to be a Bristol Beaufort

highlights.zh: Mitita Shark Point 浅水的黑鳍礁鲨
highlights.en: Blacktip reef sharks in the shallows at Mitita Shark Point

highlights.zh: Galo-Galo 洞 15–20 米的水下隧道
highlights.en: An underwater tunnel at 15–20 m in Galo-Galo Cave

notes: 新增潜点，verified 设为 false：找到的潜水资料只有 DTW 哈马黑拉页里的摩罗泰段落（28 个已记录潜点；Wawama、Totodaku 有盟军飞机和吉普车，Mira 有沉船；Gorago Point 东北岸 8–30 m 缓坡，Harbour Point 6–18 m，Galo-Galo 洞 15–20 m 隧道；约 40 m 的飞机残骸据信是 Bristol Beaufort；Buho Buho 和 Dodola 附近有战斗机残骸；Mitita Shark Point 浅水黑鳍礁鲨；飞机残骸上有海鳝）和 Bluewater 哈马黑拉页的两句（飞 Leo Wattimena 机场 OTI 最直接；摩罗泰附近有 Metita Beach & Dive Resort，与 DTW 的 Mitita 应为同一处）。两者都没有摩罗泰本身的季节：bestMonths 暂用北马鲁古区域季节 4–10 月（DTW 哈马黑拉 4–10 月、Bluewater 3–11 月），水温 27–30、能见度 12–30 也是哈马黑拉的区域值，待补摩罗泰专门来源（旅游局或当地潜店）。DTW 写摩罗泰在哈马黑拉以北 300 km，与地图不符（两岛隔一条窄海峡），没采用；DTW 写船宿只是'偶尔'经过。历史取维基百科：1942 年初日军占领，1944 年 9 月美军登陆南部平原、修建港口和两条跑道，1945-09-09 日军第 2 军在此正式投降。中文名取中文维基'摩罗泰岛'。坐标为岛南岸的 Leo Wattimena 机场（维基百科 2.046, 128.325），港口 Daruba 在南岸，±10 km。等级给 AOW，因为飞机和沉船多在 20–40 m，浅礁 OW 即可。species 只有两种：DTW 写的鱼群是黄鳍笛鲷和梅鲷、另有帝王神仙等，species.json 里没有对应 id。

summary.zh: 巴厘岛东南的离岛，处在龙目海峡的强流里。Manta Point 几乎全年有蝠鲼清洁；7–10 月翻车鲀上浮到 Crystal Bay 等潜点，水温随之降到 20°C 出头。流向多变，适合有经验者。
summary.en: An island off southeast Bali sitting in the strong currents of the Lombok Strait. Mantas visit the cleaning stations at Manta Point almost year-round, and from July to October sunfish rise to sites such as Crystal Bay while the water drops into the low 20s °C. Currents shift quickly, so it suits experienced divers.

highlights.zh: 7–10 月 Crystal Bay 的翻车鲀
highlights.en: Sunfish at Crystal Bay, July–October

highlights.zh: Manta Point 清洁站的蝠鲼
highlights.en: Mantas at the Manta Point cleaning stations

highlights.zh: Toyapakeh 沿峭壁放流
highlights.en: Wall drift dives at Toyapakeh

highlights.zh: 从萨努尔坐快艇约 30–45 分钟
highlights.en: 30–45 minutes by fast boat from Sanur

notes: 新增潜点。bestMonths 取翻车鲀季 7–10 月：DTW 巴厘页（Crystal Bay 翻车鲀季 7–10 月）、liveaboard.com（7–10 月最佳）、Divernet 双中心文（最佳 7–10 月）三源一致；DTW FAQ 另写 6–9 月 / 8–10 月，自相矛盾。全年都能潜：DTW 写 Manta Point 清洁站全年有蝠鲼（4–6 月最多），liveaboard 写'几乎全年'，Divernet 写几乎必见、礁蝠鲼和大洋蝠鲼都见过。水温：DTW 写通常 25–26°C、翻车鲀季降到 20 出头，liveaboard 写翻车鲀季'低 20 几度'；19–26 取 DTW 巴厘总表（19–26）。当地常说的更冷温跃层（< 18°C）没找到来源，没写。能见度：DTW 一般 20–30 m，liveaboard 写 Manta Point 有涌、更浑，Crystal Bay 好天可超 45 m，取 15–30。等级 AOW：三源都写流强且多变；liveaboard 写 Crystal Bay 相对避流、各级都可。access：liveaboard 写萨努尔快艇 30–45 分钟，船宿从 Benoa / 萨努尔出发约 2 小时；DTW 列蓝梦岛（Lembongan）日潜。翻车鲀在 Penida 实为 Mola alexandrini 为主，贴纸用通用翻车鲀。DTW 没有单独的 Penida / Tulamben 潜点页，用的是巴厘总页。坐标为西北岸 Crystal Bay（约 -8.71, 115.46），按地图常识取，±1 km；Manta Point 在南岸。

summary.zh: 宿务南部的鲸鲨观赏点：渔民每天早上在离岸 50–100 米处喂小虾，全年几乎天天有鲸鲨。多数人浮潜，少数持证潜店可带水肺。研究发现喂食延长了部分鲸鲨的停留，这种做法一直有争议。附近苏米隆岛可潜礁墙。
summary.en: A whale shark watching site in southern Cebu. Fishermen hand-feed small shrimp 50–100 m offshore each morning, so sharks are present almost daily all year. Most visitors snorkel; a few accredited centres take divers. Research shows the feeding has lengthened some sharks' stays, and the practice is controversial. Nearby Sumilon Island offers walls and sandy slopes.

highlights.zh: 早上 6 点到午后的喂食时段
highlights.en: Feeding from about 6 am to early afternoon

highlights.zh: 保持距离，禁用闪光灯和防晒霜
highlights.en: Keep your distance; no flash or sunscreen

highlights.zh: 苏米隆岛保护区（1974 年起）的礁墙
highlights.en: Walls at Sumilon Island, protected since 1974

notes: 新增潜点，伦理争议需要关注。全年（bestMonths 为空）：DTW 宿务页写 2 月和 4 月最好，但因为喂食全年都有；PeerJ 论文（Araujo 等，2014）在 2012-03 至 2013-12 的 621 个调查日里每天都有鲸鲨，日均 12.7 头（2–26 头），共识别 158 头、82% 为雄性。喂食：PeerJ 写每天 6:00–13:00，渔民划无动力小船在离岸 50–100 m、约 6.5 万 m² 的浮标区里手喂，每天 50–150 kg 饵料，只许认证的无动力船进入。争议：DTW 直接称其'有争议'，认为会打乱自然洄游，但比捕杀伤害小、保护费用于保护；PeerJ 作者认为喂食改变了行为、延长了停留（被喂个体平均约 45 天、未被喂约 22 天，最长一头 572 天），47% 有螺旋桨伤痕，呼吁管理计划和螺旋桨护罩；Scubaverse（2018）作者实地体验后认为'不是马戏团，但也不是野生遭遇'，记录每场 30 分钟、禁用闪光灯和防晒霜、靠太近会被红牌罚出水、只有少数认证潜店可带水肺、LAMAVE 每天记录个体。保留这个点是因为很多中国游客会去；摘要里写了一句争议，若要在 UI 上另加提示需要新的 i18n 文案。搜索摘要里关于距离（4–6 m 不等）、每头鲸鲨限 6 人等规则说法不一，未写入。苏米隆岛：DTW 与 liveaboard 都写 1974 年起为保护区；DTW 写有黑鳍、白鳍礁鲨，偶有锤头鲨和鲸鲨，海龟常见，有一面贯穿全岛的礁墙；liveaboard 写 Nikki's Wall 可到 35 m、Sumilon North 为进阶漂流。水温 26–30、能见度 15–30 按 DTW 宿务总体。坐标取 PeerJ 给出的 Tan-awan 浮标位置（约 9.46N, 123.38E），±0.5 km。

summary.zh: 巴厘岛东岸渡口小镇。Blue Lagoon 浅湾适合新手和夜潜；外海 Biaha 的洞里常有白顶礁鲨休息，Tepekong 有峡谷陡壁，7–10 月偶见翻车鲀。外海小岛流强水冷，限进阶。
summary.en: Ferry town on Bali's east coast. The sheltered Blue Lagoon suits beginners and night dives; offshore, whitetip reef sharks often rest in Gili Biaha's cave and Gili Tepekong has a canyon and steep walls, with occasional sunfish July–October. The offshore islets have strong currents and cool water and suit advanced divers only.

highlights.zh: Blue Lagoon 夜潜
highlights.en: Blue Lagoon night dives

highlights.zh: Biaha 鲨鱼洞
highlights.en: Biaha shark cave

highlights.zh: Tepekong 峡谷
highlights.en: Tepekong canyon

highlights.zh: 7–10 月翻车鲀
highlights.en: Sunfish Jul–Oct

notes: Sites diveable year-round; bestMonths = dry season (vis >30 m), sunfish Jul–Oct, water drops to ~21°C then. Blue Lagoon details from search snippets only. Operators avoid Gili Mimpang around full/new moon.

summary.zh: 民都洛岛北端，隔维德岛海峡与阿尼洛相望，从八打雁坐船约 1 小时。沙邦一带 40 多个潜点：内湾找躄鱼、海马和海蛞蝓，Canyons 等外侧潜点流急鱼多。流随月相变化，新手和技术潜水员都有合适的点。
summary.en: On Mindoro's northern tip, facing Anilao across the Verde Island Passage and about an hour by boat from Batangas. Sabang and the neighbouring bays offer more than 40 sites: sheltered bays with frogfish, seahorses and nudibranchs, and current-swept outer sites such as the Canyons with trevally and snapper. Current strength follows the moon, so there are dives for beginners and technical divers alike.

highlights.zh: Canyons 的漂流与鲹鱼、笛鲷群
highlights.en: Drift dives through the Canyons with trevally and snapper

highlights.zh: 沙邦几艘小沉船上的微距
highlights.en: Macro on the small Sabang wrecks

highlights.zh: 维德岛 Drop-off 礁墙与大鱼
highlights.en: Pelagics along the Verde Island drop-off

highlights.zh: 无流的内湾适合开放水域课程
highlights.en: Current-free inner bays for open water courses
