summary.zh: 南大堡礁珊瑚岛，从格拉德斯通乘船约 2 小时或直升机约 30 分钟。30 多个潜点约一半离岸不到 15 分钟船程，招牌是苍鹭礁丘；5–10 月常见礁蝠鲼，12–4 月海龟产卵。
summary.en: A coral cay on the southern Great Barrier Reef, about two hours by boat or 30 minutes by helicopter from Gladstone. About half of its 30-plus sites are under 15 minutes from the beach, and Heron Bommie is the best known. Reef mantas and humpbacks are common May–October; turtles nest December–April.

highlights.zh: 苍鹭礁丘
highlights.en: Heron Bommie

highlights.zh: 潜点多在 15 分钟船程内
highlights.en: Most sites within 15 minutes by boat

highlights.zh: 岸边即可浮潜下水
highlights.en: Snorkel straight off the beach

highlights.zh: 12–4 月海龟上岸产卵
highlights.en: Turtle nesting December–April

notes: Diving is good year-round; bestMonths reflects the May–Oct manta and whale season. Only the resort dive operation is open to the public (per search results).

summary.zh: 拜伦角外 2.5 公里的一块礁岩，船程十分钟，深度 5–25 米。夏季（12–5 月）豹纹鲨成群趴在沙地上，冬季换成沙虎鲨聚集；海龟全年都在。
summary.en: A rocky outcrop 2.5 km off Cape Byron, ten minutes by boat, with sites from 5 to 25 m. In summer (December–May) leopard sharks gather on the sand in numbers; in winter grey nurse sharks take their place. Turtles are there all year.

highlights.zh: 夏季的豹纹鲨聚集，The Needles 一带最多
highlights.en: Summer leopard shark aggregation around The Needles

highlights.zh: 冬季在 Cod Hole、Split Bommie 看沙虎鲨
highlights.en: Winter grey nurse sharks at Cod Hole and Split Bommie

highlights.zh: 绿海龟、玳瑁、蠵龟三种海龟常驻
highlights.en: Three resident turtle species

notes: 全年可潜，季节按物种分：豹纹鲨 12–5 月（夏），沙虎鲨约 6–11 月（冬，不同来源写 5–11 或 6–12），座头鲸 5–11 月经过（Sundive）。蝠鲼在 The Needles 偶见，无固定月份。水温冬季约 18–20°C、夏季 26–27°C，能见度 8–15 米常见、好天 20 米以上，这些数字来自搜索摘要而非已打开页面，为参考值。Lord Howe 未做（有访客上限、价格高），选了更易到达的 Julian Rocks。

summary.zh: 大堡礁最南端的珊瑚岛，从布里斯班、黄金海岸、赫维湾或班达伯格乘小飞机上岛。每天两次船潜，多在 20 米以内；5–8 月礁蝠鲼常聚在灯塔礁丘清洁站。
summary.en: A coral cay at the southern tip of the Great Barrier Reef, reached by light aircraft from Brisbane, the Gold Coast, Hervey Bay or Bundaberg. Boat dives run twice daily, mostly shallower than 20 m. From May to August reef mantas gather at cleaning stations such as Lighthouse Bommies; turtles and leopard sharks are common.

highlights.zh: 灯塔礁丘蝠鲼清洁站
highlights.en: Manta cleaning station at Lighthouse Bommies

highlights.zh: 岸边浮潜即可见海龟
highlights.en: Turtles while snorkelling from shore

highlights.zh: 冬季有座头鲸经过
highlights.en: Humpback whales pass in winter

highlights.zh: 11–4 月海龟上岸产卵
highlights.en: Turtle nesting November–April

notes: Dives cannot be pre-booked; book on the island the day before. Mantas are present most of the year, peak May–Aug.

summary.zh: 世界最南的珊瑚礁，从悉尼或布里斯班乘小飞机上岛。潜水季约 9 月至次年 5 月，夏季水温约 26°C；约 20 公里外的鲍尔金字塔看天气出船，常见加拉帕戈斯鲨和大群黄尾鰤。
summary.en: The world's southernmost coral reefs (31°33'S), a short flight from Sydney or Brisbane. The dive season runs roughly September to May, with water about 26°C in summer and 17°C in winter. Ball's Pyramid, about 20 km south, is dived only in good weather and is known for Galapagos sharks, large kingfish schools and Ballina angelfish at about 25 m.

highlights.zh: 世界最南的珊瑚礁
highlights.en: Southernmost coral reefs in the world

highlights.zh: 鲍尔金字塔的加拉帕戈斯鲨
highlights.en: Galapagos sharks at Ball's Pyramid

highlights.zh: 约 25 米可见巴利纳神仙鱼
highlights.en: Ballina angelfish at about 25 m

highlights.zh: 潟湖里浮潜看海龟
highlights.en: Turtles while snorkelling in the lagoon

notes: Season from the tourism board only (Sep–Jun; other sources say Sep–May, one says Dive Lord Howe closes Jun–Aug). Visitor cap ~400 tourists at a time. Ball's Pyramid is ~50 min by boat and depends on weather and diver numbers. jack-school stands in for kingfish (Seriola lalandi, also a carangid).

summary.zh: 峡湾表层有 2–6 m 茶色淡水，挡住光线，黑珊瑚在约 10 m 就能见到。潜季通常 10–3 月，海水约 12–14°C；从蒂阿瑙驾车约 1.5 小时，常见海蛞蝓、龙虾和海豹。
summary.en: A tannin-stained freshwater layer 2–6 m thick blocks the light, so black coral, normally a deep-water species, grows from about 10 m. The season usually runs October to March, with water around 12–14 °C. Most divers stay in Te Anau, 90+ minutes' drive away. Nudibranchs, crayfish and fur seals are common.

highlights.zh: 浅水黑珊瑚
highlights.en: Black coral in shallow water

highlights.zh: 穿过淡水层下潜
highlights.en: Diving through the freshwater layer

highlights.zh: 峡湾峭壁
highlights.en: Fiord walls

highlights.zh: 新西兰海豹
highlights.en: New Zealand fur seals

notes: Only one source read; the second (firstlighttravel) returned 403. UWPG puts black coral from about 10 m, while other snippets say 5 m. A Dive Magazine snippet says local operator Descend Diving was on a break from diving, so check whether any operator still runs trips. The nearest decompression chamber is far away, and operators may limit dive times.

name.zh: 莫宁顿半岛栈桥（墨尔本）

summary.zh: 菲利普港湾南岸的老栈桥都从岸边下水，水深多不到 6 米，全年可潜。Portsea 常年能找到草海龙，Rye 栈桥下海马常见；入冬前后（多在 5–6 月），成千上万只巨型蜘蛛蟹会聚到 Rye 一带蜕壳。
summary.en: Old piers on the southern shore of Port Phillip, all shore entries and mostly under 6 m deep, dived year-round. Weedy seadragons live at Portsea Pier all year and seahorses are common under Rye Pier. Around the start of winter, usually May to June, thousands of giant spider crabs pile up under the piers near Rye to moult.

highlights.zh: 入冬前后的巨型蜘蛛蟹聚集，日期每年浮动
highlights.en: Early-winter spider crab gathering; dates shift each year

highlights.zh: Portsea 栈桥全年可找草海龙
highlights.en: Weedy seadragons at Portsea Pier all year

highlights.zh: Rye 栈桥水深不到 5 米，大肚海马常见
highlights.en: Big-belly seahorses under Rye Pier, less than 5 m deep

highlights.zh: 半岛东侧的 Flinders 栈桥也以草海龙出名
highlights.en: Flinders Pier on the eastern side is another seadragon site

notes: 新增潜点（用户清单里的'Rye Pier Melbourne'），一条覆盖 Rye / Blairgowrie / Portsea 三座相距 5–11 km 的栈桥（另提半岛东侧 Western Port 的 Flinders，约 22 km），坐标放在 Rye 栈桥（Rye 镇区 Wikipedia 坐标 38.377S, 144.838E，栈桥在镇区西北的海边，按地图常识取，±2 km）。季节：Divernet（Pier pleasures）写栈桥全年、多数天气都能潜，夏秋水暖生物多；Divephotoguide 写 Portsea 一年 365 天都能见草海龙，晚春初夏最好（9 月下旬–10 月初开始求偶）；Divernet（Flinders，2026-01）写 Flinders 草海龙 8–3 月最好、9 月起见雄性抱卵。bestMonths 留空（全年）。蜘蛛蟹（Leptomithrax gaimardii）时间分歧：Divernet 写 3–7 月从巴斯海峡进湾；uwphotographyguide 写 4–6 月、只在一座栈桥、约一周内来去且'越来越不准时'；DAN Alert Diver 写 Blairgowrie 6 月初、水温约 12°C、蟹在 3–6 m、腿展约 38 cm；搜索摘要里潜店写 5 月下旬–6 月中旬。文案写'多在 5–6 月'。草海龙：Divernet 写 Portsea 是招牌，Rye 只是'运气好才见'（搜索摘要）。水温 8–20、能见度 6–10（偶尔 >15）来自 Divernet；北风大浪时 Rye / Blairgowrie / Portsea 能见度差、有涌（搜索摘要），可改去 Flinders。Flinders 栈桥最初 180 m 木结构已封闭多年，Parks Victoria 确认 2025 年底开始修复（Divernet 2026-01），混凝土段仍可下水；Rye 栈桥 2022 年曾因重建关闭（搜索摘要）。维州栈桥 400 m 内的魟受保护（Divernet）。types 里的 muck 指栈桥下沙地 / 海草床的小生物潜。新增物种：weedy-seadragon（本条贴纸）与 giant-spider-crab。

summary.zh: 林肯港出发约两三小时船程，澳大利亚唯一能在笼中看大白鲨的地方。水面笼不需要潜水证，海底笼需持证。鲨鱼全年都在，但哪几个月最多每年都不一样。
summary.en: Two to three hours by boat from Port Lincoln, and the only place in Australia to meet great white sharks from a cage. The surface cage needs no certification; the ocean-floor cage does. Sharks are around all year, but the busiest months shift from season to season.

highlights.zh: 海底笼：坐在海床上看大白鲨游过
highlights.en: Ocean-floor cage: watch white sharks pass from the seabed

highlights.zh: 顺路到 Hopkins Island 与澳洲海狮共游
highlights.en: Add-on swim with Australian sea lions at Hopkins Island

highlights.zh: 一日游或多日船宿都有
highlights.en: Day trips or multi-night liveaboards

notes: 最佳月份分歧大：Rodney Fox FAQ 说 12–2 月、4 月中–7 月初、9 月中–10 月最稳定（>90%），3 月和 11 月不稳；Bluewater 说 5–10 月最佳；Calypso 相关报道说 10–1 月海豹产仔季最好。两家运营商全年出团，故 bestMonths 留空。sea-lion 指澳洲海狮（Hopkins/Grindal Island 共游项目），海王星群岛本身是海狗群落。Rapid Bay 叶海龙未做，选了大白鲨。水温（Bluewater：冬季低至 18°C）、能见度为参考值。

summary.zh: 西澳的裙礁紧贴海岸，从沙滩下水就能浮潜。每年 3 到 7 月鲸鲨随珊瑚产卵聚集在埃克斯茅斯和珊瑚湾外海，由侦察飞机引导的持证船带小组下水共游（仅浮潜，不是水肺）。
summary.en: A fringing reef hugging the Western Australian coast, close enough to snorkel from the beach. From March to July whale sharks gather off Exmouth and Coral Bay after the coral spawn; licensed boats guided by spotter planes put small groups in the water with them, snorkel only.

highlights.zh: 鲸鲨共游：侦察机找鱼，每次下水最多 10 人
highlights.en: Whale shark swims: spotter plane finds the fish, 10 swimmers at a time

highlights.zh: 9–10 月改为座头鲸共游
highlights.en: Humpback whale swims take over in September–October

highlights.zh: 从沙滩直接下水浮潜珊瑚礁
highlights.en: Snorkel the reef straight off the beach

notes: 鲸鲨季：Tourism Australia 3 月下旬–7 月下旬；Journey Beyond（Exmouth Dive & Whalesharks）3 月–8 月初、6–8 月为高峰、9–10 月仍可能遇到；Exmouth Diving 旺季团 4–7 月；西澳旅游局（westernaustralia.com，页面只抓到导航，季节来自搜索摘要）称 3–8 月。取 3–7 月，8 月初埃克斯茅斯仍有机会。鲸鲨共游是持证浮潜活动。水温、能见度为参考值，所打开来源未给数字。坐标指向埃克斯茅斯 Tantabiddi 码头一带。

summary.zh: 距凯恩斯 300 多公里的孤立海山礁，只能坐船宿前往。礁壁从礁顶直落约千米，北端 North Horn 的天然礁台上常有灰礁鲨、白顶礁鲨聚拢，凉季礁壁外还会出现路氏双髻鲨群。
summary.en: Reached only by liveaboard, this lone Coral Sea seamount lies about 350 km from Cairns, and its walls plunge to around 1,000 m. At North Horn on the northern tip, grey reef and whitetip sharks gather around a natural ledge, and in the cooler months scalloped hammerheads school off the walls.

highlights.zh: North Horn：在约 12 米礁台上看鲨鱼围拢
highlights.en: North Horn: sharks gather around a ledge at about 12 m

highlights.zh: 凉季礁壁外的路氏双髻鲨
highlights.en: Scalloped hammerheads off the walls in the cooler months

highlights.zh: Round the Bend 的蝠鲼清洁站
highlights.en: Manta cleaning station at Round the Bend

highlights.zh: 能见度常在 30 米以上
highlights.en: Visibility often beyond 30 m

notes: 新增潜点。季节：澳大利亚海洋公园（AMP，官方）写多数潜点全年可潜、路氏双髻鲨在凉季聚集；liveaboard.com 写全年、6–11 月凉季有座头鲸且双髻鲨更常见；Dive The World 潜点页写全年、9–11 月能见度最好、12–2 月雨季风向多变；DTW 船宿月份文章写 8 月下旬–12 月初最佳、9–11 月鲨鱼最活跃、1–5 月雨季泥沙使能见度降到 9–15 m。取 6–11 月（与 great-barrier-reef 条目一致），9–11 月为高峰。North Horn 是否喂鲨有分歧：DTW 潜点页、liveaboard.com、Divernet 都写有喂鲨（DTW：最多 26 人坐在约 12 m，按昆州政府规范放鱼头桶），DTW 船宿文章写 2025 年起为不喂食的'吸引潜'——页面文案只写'鲨鱼潜'。物种：AMP 写灰礁鲨、白顶礁鲨全年常见，North Horn 常见银鳍鲨（species.json 无对应 id，未加），另有土豆石斑；AMP 还提到鹦鹉螺栖息于此，但潜水时难见，未写进文案。蝠鲼种类来源未写明，按清洁站常见的礁蝠鲼标。水温：DTW 潜点页 25–30（冬季不低于 22），DTW 文章冬季 24–26、夏季 28–30，取 24–30。能见度：AMP 30–60，DTW 10–60，liveaboard 常超 40，取 20–60 参考。level：AMP '适合有经验的潜水员'、DTW '中级'，标 AOW。坐标：OZCAM 博物馆标本记录里的 North Horn（13.883S, 146.55E，仅精确到分）；Spirit of Freedom 给的 Silver City GPS 为 13.843S, 146.563E，两者相距约 4 km。Ribbon Reefs / Cod Hole 已在 great-barrier-reef 条目（坐标即 Cod Hole），未重复。

summary.zh: 北岛图图卡卡外 23 公里的海洋保护区，火山岩拱门、海蚀洞和海藻林里混着亚热带鱼群。夏季短尾魟在 Northern Arch 层层叠叠，冬季水冷但能见度最好。
summary.en: A marine reserve 23 km off Tutukaka on the North Island: volcanic archways, sea caves and kelp with a mix of subtropical fish. In summer short-tail stingrays stack up in Northern Arch; winter water is cold but the clearest of the year.

highlights.zh: Blue Maomao Arch 的光柱与蓝鱼群
highlights.en: Light shafts and blue maomao schools in Blue Maomao Arch

highlights.zh: Rikoriko 洞：南半球体积最大的海蚀洞
highlights.en: Rikoriko Cave, the largest sea cave by volume in the southern hemisphere

highlights.zh: 夏季 Northern Arch 的短尾魟聚集
highlights.en: Summer stingray aggregation at Northern Arch

notes: 全年可潜。Divernet：1–4 月 20–22°C、能见度约 20 米，5–9 月 14–16°C、能见度可达 30 米；Dive! Tutukaka：12–3 月最暖 20–23°C，冬季能见度最好；DOC：魟鱼在较暖月份聚集于拱门。面向习惯暖水的读者取 1–4 月，冬季更清但要半干/干衣。1981 年设保护区，禁渔禁登岛。

summary.zh: 环保组织船只，1985 年在奥克兰被炸沉，1987 年凿沉于卡瓦利群岛旁。水深 18–27 m，覆满宝石海葵，常见黄尾鰤鱼群；从马陶里湾坐小艇约 8 分钟，需进阶证。
summary.en: An environmental group's ship, bombed in Auckland in 1985 and scuttled off the Cavalli Islands in 1987. It lies in 18–27 m and is covered in jewel anemones; kingfish and snapper school around it. Inflatables launch from Matauri Bay beach, about 8 minutes away. Advanced certification needed.

highlights.zh: 满船宝石海葵
highlights.en: Wreck covered in jewel anemones

highlights.zh: 著名历史沉船
highlights.en: Famous historic wreck

highlights.zh: 黄尾鰤鱼群
highlights.en: Kingfish schools

notes: Both sources agree on the location and the 1987 scuttling. The season does not agree. Scubadiverlife says best Jan–May (15–20 m vis). Bay of Islands says 15–20 m vis year-round, blue water in late summer, warmest Dec–Mar, and often the best vis Jun–Aug. A Zubludiving snippet says best vis Jun–Sep. Jan–May taken. Kingfish (Seriola lalandi) mapped to jack-school. The owner organisation's name is deliberately left out of the copy under the no-third-party-brand rule.

summary.zh: 阿德莱德以南约 1.5 小时车程的岸潜点，从新栈桥下水游约 50 米到旧栈桥，水深约 10 米。旧桩柱间全年可见叶海龙，10–2 月繁殖季雄性可能背卵；不易找，建议请向导。
summary.en: A shore dive about 1.5 hours' drive south of Adelaide. Divers enter from the new jetty and swim about 50 m to the pylons of the old jetty, around 10 m deep, where leafy seadragons live year-round. October–February is mating season, when males may carry eggs. They are hard to spot, so a local guide helps; over 50 fish species are recorded.

highlights.zh: 全年可见叶海龙
highlights.en: Leafy seadragons all year

highlights.zh: 10–2 月雄性可能背卵
highlights.en: Males may carry eggs October–February

highlights.zh: 浅水岸潜，潜时长
highlights.en: Shallow shore dive with long bottom times

highlights.zh: 记录到 50 多种鱼
highlights.en: Over 50 fish species recorded

notes: Old jetty closed after 2004 storm damage and one source calls it unsafe; check current access. Weedy seadragons not confirmed here by sources read. One divemaster estimates ~14 resident leafies, fewer than before. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 布鲁姆以西约 260–300 公里的三座环礁，只在 9–11 月前后海况平稳时有少数船宿前往，每年来潜的不到 200 人。潮差大，可顺着礁盘水道漂流；礁壁外有土豆石斑、苏眉和灰礁鲨，礁上还有大砗磲。
summary.en: Three atolls roughly 260–300 km west of Broome, visited by a handful of liveaboards only around September to November, when seas settle; fewer than 200 divers come each year. Big tides drive drift dives through the reef channels. Potato cod, Maori wrasse and grey reef sharks patrol the outer walls, and giant clams dot the reefs.

highlights.zh: Clerke 礁主水道的潮汐漂流
highlights.en: Tidal drift through the main channel at Clerke Reef

highlights.zh: 会凑近的土豆石斑和苏眉
highlights.en: Potato cod and Maori wrasse that come in close

highlights.zh: Clerke 礁长达 1.5 米的大砗磲
highlights.en: Giant clams up to 1.5 m long at Clerke Reef

highlights.zh: 季节短，常需提前约一年订位
highlights.en: Short season; berths often book out a year ahead

notes: 新增潜点。季节：Diveplanit 写 9–11 月、建议提前约一年订；Scuba Diver Life 写 9–12 月；True North 官网转载的 Dive Log Australasia 2016 年文章写'只在春季风小浪平时有少数包船前往'（作者 9 月出行）；搜索摘要里 liveaboard.com 写 9–12 月、Undercurrent 读者报告写 10 月–11 月初。取 9–11 月。距离：DBCA（西澳生物多样性部）260 km、AMP 280 km、DTW / Dive Log 300 km，文案写 260–300。三座环礁：Imperieuse、Clerke（WA 州立海洋公园）与 Mermaid（联邦 Mermaid Reef Marine Park，国家公园区）；Clerke 与 Mermaid 有可过夜的避风潟湖，船宿多以 Clerke 为基地（Dive Log）。物种：DTW 写土豆石斑、苏眉、大砗磲；Scuba Diver Life 写 Cod Hole 的友好土豆石斑、灰礁鲨、白顶 / 黑鳍 / 银鳍礁鲨，偶见双髻鲨和虎鲨，Clerke 礁大砗磲长达 1.5 m；Dive Log 写 Blue Lagoon 有土豆石斑、白顶礁鲨，水面常见蝠鲼和座头鲸。水温：Dive Log 实测 26°C，搜索摘要 50 Great Dives 25–29，取 25–29。能见度：Scuba Diver Life 外墙常达 50 m，Dive Log 40–60 m，退潮时潟湖内较浑，取 15–50 参考。level：Scuba Diver Life 写新手与有经验者都适合、通常要求 10–20 次记录，标 OW；漂流和外墙有流。坐标为 Clerke 礁（Wikipedia 17°19′S 119°21′E）。DBCA 提到 2016、2020 年有中度白化，影响轻微。

summary.zh: 1911 年在气旋中沉没的客轮侧卧在 28 米沙底，船体本身已成一座孤立的礁。龙趸、鹰鳐、海蛇和成群鲹鱼围着船身转。流常常很大，不许进舱，要求 AOW。
summary.en: A passenger steamer lost in a 1911 cyclone, lying on its side on sand at about 28 m and now a reef in its own right. Giant groupers, eagle rays, sea snakes and schooling trevally circle the hull. Currents are often strong, penetration is banned, and Advanced Open Water is required.

highlights.zh: 一辆小车大小的龙趸
highlights.en: Giant groupers the size of a small car

highlights.zh: 鹰鳐与大理石魟贴着沙底巡游
highlights.en: Eagle rays and marble rays cruising the sand

highlights.zh: 从艾尔镇 Alva Beach 出发约半小时船程
highlights.en: About half an hour by boat from Alva Beach near Ayr

notes: Spirit of Freedom：4–11 月最稳定、6–8 月能见度与大货最佳、12–2 月因热带天气不可靠；islands.com：9 月能见度最好、6–8 月稍逊；Divernet：全年可潜。取交集 6–9 月。水温来自 Yongala Dive FAQ：6–9 月 22–25°C，10–5 月 25–29°C。Yongala Dive 要求 AOW（或在读）+10 次以上非培训潜水，每日限 12 人；也可从汤斯维尔出发。

summary.zh: 悉尼岸潜、船潜都方便。马鲁布拉外的 Magic Point 洞口全年有沙虎鲨休息，3–5 月最多；曼利的 Shelly Beach 和植物学湾的 Kurnell 入水容易，海藻间能找到草海龙。
summary.en: Sydney has plenty of easy shore dives as well as boat sites. Off Maroubra, grey nurse sharks rest around the two caves at Magic Point all year, in the largest numbers from March to May. Shelly Beach in Manly and Kurnell on Botany Bay are easy entries where weedy seadragons hide in the kelp.

highlights.zh: Magic Point：一潜常见数条到二三十条沙虎鲨
highlights.en: Magic Point: from a couple to about 30 grey nurse sharks per dive

highlights.zh: Kurnell 和 Shelly Beach 岸潜找草海龙
highlights.en: Weedy seadragons on shore dives at Kurnell and Shelly Beach

highlights.zh: Shelly Beach 在海洋保护区内，水浅浪小，适合入门
highlights.en: Shelly Beach sits in an aquatic reserve, shallow and sheltered for beginners

highlights.zh: Bare Island 的海蛞蝓与侏儒海龙
highlights.en: Nudibranchs and pygmy pipehorses at Bare Island

notes: 新增潜点，一条覆盖悉尼的岸潜与 Magic Point 船潜，坐标放在 Magic Point（马鲁布拉湾南岬外，按 ISRA 描述取，±1 km）；Shelly Beach（曼利）在其北约 18 km，Kurnell / Bare Island 在南约 5 km。季节：IUCN 鲨鱼专家组 ISRA 资料页（引用 NSW 渔业部门声学标记与 Spot a Shark 2000–2025 年 4419 条目击）写 Magic Point 全年可见沙虎鲨、3–5 月为高峰、每潜 2–33 条、成年雄性在每年北迁昆州期间缺席；50 Great Dives 写全年可去。bestMonths 留空（全年）。Magic Point：50 Great Dives 写船程约 25 分钟、不建议岸潜、深 8–24 m、主洞底约 16 m、OW 即可、水温 17–23、能见度 10–25；Deeper Blue（2016）写两个洞相距约 30 m、能见度常 <10 m、潜点为保护栖息地、禁止日出日落时潜、不得堵洞口或喂摸追。能见度取 5–20 参考。草海龙：旅游局 australia.com 写 Cabbage Tree Bay 海藻中有、Kurnell 的 The Steps 以草海龙出名；50 Great Dives 写 Magic Point 礁墙底部海藻中常驻。sydney.com 中文页把 weedy seadragon 译作'杂草海龙'，按潜水员习惯写'草海龙'；pygmy pipehorse 沿用该页的'侏儒海龙'。Shelly Beach 属 Cabbage Tree Bay Aquatic Reserve，有巨型乌贼（冬季聚集繁殖，Diveplanit）、杰克逊港鲨、须鲨、东部蓝石斑；这些在 species.json 无对应 id。沙虎鲨在澳洲东海岸为极危（Diveplanit / ISRA）。

name.zh: 塔斯曼半岛（塔斯马尼亚）

summary.zh: 霍巴特以东约一小时车程，从 Eaglehawk Neck 出船。砂岩海岸被掏成洞穴和峡谷，洞壁布满彩色海绵；浅水海藻里有好奇的海狗，全年能找到草海龙。冬季水温约 12°C，能见度最好。
summary.en: An hour east of Hobart, with boats leaving from Eaglehawk Neck. Around Waterfall Bay the sea has carved the sandstone into caves and canyons lined with bright sponges and anemones. Curious fur seals play in the shallow kelp, and weedy seadragons can be found all year. Winter water drops to about 12 °C, but that is when visibility is best.

highlights.zh: Cathedral Cave：澳洲最大的海蚀洞系统
highlights.en: Cathedral Cave, Australia's largest sea-cave system

highlights.zh: 水深 5 米内与澳洲海狗共游，新手也能参加
highlights.en: Australian fur seals within 5 m of the surface, open to beginners

highlights.zh: 夏季可见抱卵的雄性草海龙
highlights.en: Male weedy seadragons carry eggs in summer

highlights.zh: Sisters 礁墙的海绵花园（适合有经验者）
highlights.en: Sponge gardens on the Sisters wall for experienced divers

notes: 新增潜点，用户清单里的'Tasmania kelp / Eaglehawk Neck'。季节：鹰颈当地潜店 FAQ 写'全年都能舒适地潜'、仲冬最低水温 12°C，草海龙页写全年都有、夏季可见雄性抱卵；塔斯马尼亚旅游局写能见度可超 30 m、冬季最好，建议 7 mm 湿衣或干衣；Divernet 写潜点按当天天气选（咆哮西风带，锋面多）。bestMonths 留空（全年）；严格说'全年'只有潜店明说，旅游局与 Divernet 是不矛盾的佐证，若要更严可改 verified=false。水温上限 18 来自搜索摘要里的 surf-forecast 卫星海温（3 月峰值 14–18），未打开页面核实，为参考；能见度下限 10 来自搜索摘要中的德国潜水员点评，为参考。物种映射：贴纸用 sea-lion（海狮泛称）代表澳洲海狗（Arctocephalus pusillus，潜店写在浅水海藻 0–5 m、Beginner 级）；Divernet 另写 North Wall 可遇新西兰海狗。巨型海藻林：潜店在做 Reviving Giants 复育项目，原生巨藻林已大幅减少，文案只写'浅水海藻'。Cathedral Cave'澳大利亚最大海蚀洞系统'出自旅游局与 Divernet（主通道最深约 21 m）；潜店把 Cathedral Cave、SS Nord（1915 年沉没，约 42 m，旅游局）、海绵花园列为'Go Deeper'经验潜水员项目，Divernet 写洞内深处需潜导或洞穴潜水资格，Sisters 30 m 以下最精彩、常因天气关闭。PADI 博客写 Waterfall Bay 礁墙至 18 m、各级别都适合。中文名用'塔斯曼半岛'；'鹰颈地峡'是 Eaglehawk Neck 的常见译名，但未能在中文来源核对，文案保留英文。坐标为 Eaglehawk Neck（Wikipedia -43.017, 147.926）。

summary.zh: 从艾尔利海滩乘船到胡克岛北岸的尖塔（Pinnacles）、蝠鲼湾等岛礁潜点，水深约 3–25 米。5–9 月较凉季节常见礁蝠鲼，也有苏眉和白顶礁鲨。
summary.en: Boats from Airlie Beach reach fringing-reef sites on northern Hook Island such as The Pinnacles and Manta Ray Bay, 3–25 m deep. Reef mantas are common in the cooler months, May–September, along with Maori wrasse and black- and whitetip reef sharks. Blue Pearl Bay on Hayman Island suits beginners.

highlights.zh: 尖塔珊瑚丘从 20 米升到近水面
highlights.en: Coral bommies rising from 20 m to near the surface

highlights.zh: 冬季蝠鲼湾常见礁蝠鲼
highlights.en: Mantas at Manta Ray Bay in winter

highlights.zh: 蓝珍珠湾适合初学者
highlights.en: Blue Pearl Bay suits beginners

notes: Source article dates from 2016. Heart Reef is on Hardy Reef (outer reef, usually seen by scenic flight), not at these island sites; island-site visibility is lower than on the outer reef. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 怀阿拉东北约 30 分钟车程的洛利角浅礁，通常 5–8 月有数万只澳洲巨型乌贼聚集繁殖，可岸潜或浮潜，水冷。2026 年数量创新低并禁潜 90 天，出行前先确认。
summary.en: An 8 km shallow rocky reef at Point Lowly, about 30 minutes' drive north-east of Whyalla, where giant Australian cuttlefish usually gather to breed from May to August, from tens of thousands to over 200,000 in past years. Shore dive or snorkel in cold water. In 2026 numbers hit a record low and swimming, snorkelling and diving were banned for 90 days from 1 July; check before going.

highlights.zh: 全球唯一的巨型乌贼大规模聚集
highlights.en: The world's only mass giant cuttlefish aggregation

highlights.zh: 浅水岸潜即可见
highlights.en: Seen in shallow water from shore

highlights.zh: 2026 年数量骤降
highlights.en: Record low numbers in 2026

notes: 2026 aggregation collapsed (SARDI estimate 1,811, record low; Karenia algal bloom suspected). 90-day ban from 1 Jul 2026 on swimming/snorkelling/diving/anchoring in the Black Point–Stony Point sanctuary zone, fines up to A$100,000. Next survey May 2027; recheck before the 2027 season. Only one species fits; no second signature animal.

summary.zh: 巴伊亚州外海的国家海洋公园，从卡拉韦拉斯坐船 2.5–5 小时，可当天往返或船宿。水下是高达 30 米的蘑菇状珊瑚柱，长着只在这一带才有的脑珊瑚。12–4 月水暖水清；6–11 月座头鲸季只能船上看。
summary.en: A national marine park off Bahia, created in 1983 and reached from Caravelas by a 2.5 to 5-hour boat ride, as a day trip or a liveaboard. Underwater, mushroom-shaped coral pillars up to 30 m tall carry a brain coral found only in this region. December to April brings warmer, clearer water; humpbacks visit from June to November and are watched only from boats.

highlights.zh: 高达 30 米的蘑菇状珊瑚柱（chapeirões）
highlights.en: Mushroom-shaped coral pillars (chapeirões) up to 30 m tall

highlights.zh: 6–11 月船上看座头鲸，禁止下水同游
highlights.en: Humpbacks from boats, June to November; swimming with them is banned

highlights.zh: Mau-Mau 珊瑚柱旁有导引绳的夜潜步道
highlights.en: A night-dive trail with a guideline at the Mau-Mau pillar

notes: 只有公园管理方 ICMBio 一个直接来源（WebSearch 配额用完）；PADI 巴伊亚页没提阿布罗柳斯，只给出北边约 200 km 的塞古罗港 11–4 月最佳，作为区域旁证，所以 verified 留 false。季节：ICMBio 写全年开放，12–4 月水暖、能见度好、是最佳潜水期；座头鲸季 6–11 月（同页一处写 7–10 月为峰，另一处写 8–9 月最多）。按庆良间群岛条目的做法，船上看鲸的季节不放进 bestMonths，取 12–4 月，座头鲸排第二；若要突出看鲸，可改为 7–10 月并把座头鲸放第一。规则（ICMBio）：只能跟公园授权的 11 家运营商，从卡拉韦拉斯出发，约 70 km、2.5–5 小时；当天往返约 7:00–18:00，或船宿 2–4 天；水肺潜水只能跟授权水下向导、在指定潜点，须带潜水证；3 处沉船开放参观；Santa Bárbara 附近的 Chapeirão Mau-Mau 有带导引绳的夜潜步道；与鲸豚保持 50 m、禁止同游；风力超过 20 节不建议出海；门票 R$20（周边市镇居民免费）。公园 1983 年 4 月 6 日设立（第 88218 号联邦令）、87,943 公顷、约 1,300 种生物；chapeirões 是高达 30 m 的蘑菇状礁体，页面称脑珊瑚 Mussismilia braziliensis 只在这一区域能见到；海龟有蠵龟、绿海龟、玳瑁和棱皮龟，Redonda 岛 9–3 月有蠵龟产卵。水温、能见度为参考值，ICMBio 只写「水温温和、12–4 月更清」。hard-coral 贴纸画的是桌面状鹿角珊瑚，与这里的脑珊瑚柱不同，只作泛指。坐标为圣巴巴拉岛一带。

summary.zh: 东岸约 190 km 堡礁，礁外从约 20 m 直降入 2000 m 深的“大洋之舌”，可潜峭壁；海洋蓝洞需平潮时随向导进入。基地在弗雷什克里克的小希望湾。
summary.en: Andros has a barrier reef about 190 km long on its east coast, dropping from about 20 m into the 2 km-deep Tongue of the Ocean. Dive the wall for Caribbean reef sharks, eagle rays and Nassau grouper, and enter ocean blue holes at slack tide with a guide. The main base is Small Hope Bay at Fresh Creek.

highlights.zh: 大洋之舌峭壁
highlights.en: Tongue of the Ocean wall

highlights.zh: 海洋蓝洞
highlights.en: Ocean blue holes

highlights.zh: 约 190 km 堡礁
highlights.en: About 190 km of barrier reef

highlights.zh: 加勒比礁鲨
highlights.en: Caribbean reef sharks

notes: Season disagrees across sources (Mar–Jun & Oct–Nov vs Dec–Apr). Nearest chamber is Nassau (~220 km). Cave blue holes need full cave certification. 'Third-largest barrier reef' claim not checked.

summary.zh: 阿鲁巴在飓风带以南，沉船潜点密集。招牌是 1940 年自沉的德国货轮安提拉号：长约 122 米，侧卧在 18 米深的海底，离岸约 10 分钟船程，船身长满管状海绵，货舱可以穿越。南岸风浪小，适合新手。
summary.en: Aruba lies south of the hurricane belt, and its diving centres on wrecks. The headline is the Antilla, a German freighter scuttled in 1940: about 122 m long, lying on its side in 18 m some ten minutes from shore, coated in tube sponges, with holds you can swim through. The sheltered south coast suits beginners.

highlights.zh: 安提拉号：122 米长的二战货轮，可穿越货舱
highlights.en: The Antilla: a 122 m WWII freighter with holds to swim through

highlights.zh: 10 米深的 Pedernales 油轮残骸，适合新手
highlights.en: The Pedernales tanker wreck at 10 m, good for novices

highlights.zh: 两架沉放作人工礁的飞机
highlights.en: Two aircraft sunk as artificial reefs

notes: 季节：PADI 写任何时候都合适、海洋生物不分季节，4–11 月旱季平静、12–3 月雨季有短阵雨、水温降到约 26°C；Bluewater 写全年都好、4–6 月最平静，旺季 12 月–4 月中，岛在飓风带以南。两者都说全年，取空数组。安提拉号（Bluewater）：二战德国货轮，1940 年故意自沉，约 400 ft（122 m），左舷着底侧卧于 45 ft（18 m），离岸约 10 分钟，长满大珊瑚和管状海绵，可穿越货舱。其他：Pedernales 二战油轮在 10 m，适合新手；Jane Sea 水泥货船近 30 m、流强、偶有蝠鲼；两架飞机残骸适合看微距。北岸流强适合进阶，南岸受庇护适合新手。物种：Bluewater 写西北岸海草床有海马、蠵龟和绿海龟，外礁偶见蝠鲼、魟和鲨鱼；据此列绿海龟与魟（魟未分种，按加勒比常见的美洲魟列）。PADI 页面的常见生物栏为空。水温 PADI 26–29°C、Bluewater 年均 29°C；能见度 Bluewater 20–30 m。坐标为安提拉号所在的 Malmok 外海（西北岸）。

summary.zh: 灯塔礁环礁中央的圆形深洞，下到约 40 米处是冰期形成的巨型钟乳石，加勒比礁鲨在昏暗的洞壁边游弋。洞里鱼不多，日潜或船宿通常搭配半月礁的峭壁与鹰鳐。
summary.en: A circular sinkhole in the middle of Lighthouse Reef atoll. At about 40 m the wall opens into a gallery of ice-age stalactites, with Caribbean reef sharks cruising the dim edge. Fish life inside is sparse, so day trips and liveaboards pair it with the walls and eagle rays off Half Moon Caye.

highlights.zh: 40 米处的巨型钟乳石
highlights.en: Giant stalactites at 40 m

highlights.zh: 洞壁边巡游的加勒比礁鲨
highlights.en: Caribbean reef sharks along the rim

highlights.zh: 半月礁峭壁的鹰鳐与海龟
highlights.en: Eagle rays and turtles on the Half Moon Caye wall

notes: 季节：liveaboard.com 4–6 月，Dive The World 3–6 月干季（整体 3–12 月都可潜）；取 3–6 月。8–10 月飓风季。蓝洞本身是地质景观、鱼少、深度约 40 米，建议 AOW；从圣佩德罗出发日潜单程 2–3 小时，船宿从伯利兹城出发连潜 Turneffe 与灯塔礁。南部 Gladden Spit 的鲸鲨季 3–6 月满月前后（DIVE Magazine），不在本潜点范围。

summary.zh: 百慕大礁盘上有 300 多艘 17 世纪至 1997 年的沉船，多在 9–21 米：南岸有 1864 年南北战争的封锁突破船，北礁上是 1936 年触礁的西班牙邮轮。5–10 月为主季，冬季多穿干衣。
summary.en: Coral reefs ring this North Atlantic island group, and more than 300 wrecks from the 1600s to 1997 lie scattered across them. Most dives are 9 to 21 m: an 1864 Civil War blockade runner off the South Shore, a Spanish liner that struck the northern reefs in 1936, ships scuttled as artificial reefs. May to October is the main season; winter calls for a drysuit or thick wetsuit.

highlights.zh: Mary Celestia：1864 年的封锁突破船，约 17 米
highlights.en: Mary Celestia, an 1864 blockade runner at about 17 m

highlights.zh: Cristóbal Colón：百慕大水域最大的沉船
highlights.en: Cristóbal Colón, the largest wreck in Bermuda waters

highlights.zh: 并排躺在 9 米深处的 Constellation 与 Montana
highlights.en: Constellation and Montana lying side by side in 9 m

notes: 季节：PADI 写主季 5–10 月，春秋人少水凉，冬季穿干衣也能潜；百慕大旅游局写旺季平均水温 28°C、夏季能见度可达 80 ft，未给月份；DIVE Magazine（2026-09）写作者 4 月下水 21°C、晚夏可到 28°C，冬季能见度可达 60 m、夏季 30 m 以上；Divernet（2025-07）写冬季水温 14–17°C、很多人穿干衣或 7 mm。PADI 明写、旅游局暗示夏季为主季，取 5–10 月；冬季能见度反而更好，适合穿干衣的人。水温字段取主季 21–28°C。沉船（旅游局）：300 多艘、从 1600 年代到 1997 年；Mary Celestia 1864 年沉、约 55 ft、南岸；Cristóbal Colón 1936 年触礁、499 ft、百慕大水域已知最大沉船、残骸铺在北岸礁上（Divernet 写 5–18 m）；Hermes 1943 年造、1985 年沉放、70–75 ft；Montana 在 30 ft，Constellation 沉在其 50 ft 之内；King George 为最大的完整沉船；多数潜水在 30–70 ft（9–21 m）。物种：旅游局写海龟与鹰鳐，DIVE 写绿海龟、14 种鹦嘴鱼自 1993 年起受法律保护。坐标为西端皇家海军船坞一带（Fantasea 等潜店所在），沉船环岛分布。

summary.zh: 离迈阿密约 80 公里的小岛。12–3 月，无沟双髻鲨（大锤头）来到南比米尼近岸的浅水，潜点约 6 米深、离岸不到 20 米，光线足、底时长。同一季节常有公牛鲨；夏季改看大西洋斑点海豚，浮潜即可。
summary.en: A small island about 80 km east of Miami. From December to March great hammerheads come into the shallows off South Bimini, at a site about 6 m deep and less than 20 m from shore, with good light and long bottom times. Bull sharks are frequent in the same season, and in summer the focus shifts to snorkelling with Atlantic spotted dolphins.

highlights.zh: 12–3 月约 6 米浅水里的大锤头鲨
highlights.en: Great hammerheads in about 6 m of water, December to March

highlights.zh: 冬季也常见公牛鲨
highlights.en: Bull sharks are common in winter too

highlights.zh: 夏季浮潜看大西洋斑点海豚
highlights.en: Snorkel with Atlantic spotted dolphins in summer

highlights.zh: Sapona 号沉船，最深约 6 米，浮潜可见
highlights.en: The Sapona wreck, no deeper than 6 m and visible to snorkellers

notes: 季节：liveaboard.com 写 12–3 月大锤头鲨来到比米尼；DTW 页面一处写 12–3 月在南比米尼浅水大量聚集、另一处写 1–3 月；巴哈马旅游局写 12–4 月为季节常客。取 12–3 月，与虎鲨滩条目「12–3 月可搭配比米尼」一致。潜点：巴哈马旅游局写离岸不超过 20 码、深约 20 ft，同场有时有公牛鲨和虎鲨，并说比米尼有些鲨鱼潜不是投喂潜；所开两页都没写这里是否投喂（搜索摘要里运营商用金属饵箱引鲨，未核实，文案未提）。DTW：公牛鲨 12–3 月较多；大西洋斑点海豚和宽吻海豚夏季最好（旅游局写全年都有海豚、所有浮潜者都能参加）；Sapona 沉船最深 6 m；离迈阿密 80 km，船宿从大巴哈马自由港出发，也有从美国港口出发的船；水温 24–29°C，能见度 25–30 m。新增物种 great-hammerhead（无沟双髻鲨 Sphyrna mokarran）：现有 hammerhead 是路氏双髻鲨，不是同一种；兰吉罗阿条目的 notes 已预留这个 id。坐标为南比米尼。

summary.zh: 沿海公路边立着黄色石头，写着潜点名字——租辆皮卡，装上气瓶，想在哪下水就在哪下水。海面全年平静，80 多个潜点大半可以岸潜，海龟、鹰鳐和夜潜时的大海鲢是常客。
summary.en: Yellow stones along the coast road mark each dive site by name: rent a pickup, load tanks and dive wherever you pull over. The sea stays calm year-round and most of the 80-plus sites are shore entries, with turtles, eagle rays and tarpon on night dives.

highlights.zh: 自己开车、自己安排的岸潜
highlights.en: Self-guided shore diving from your own truck

highlights.zh: Salt Pier 盐码头下的鹰鳐与海龟
highlights.en: Eagle rays and turtles under Salt Pier

highlights.zh: Hilma Hooker 沉船
highlights.en: The Hilma Hooker wreck

notes: 两个来源均称全年可潜、海面常年平静，取空数组；Bluewater 建议 2–7 月与 11 月人少，8–9 月水最暖。PADI：85 个潜点中 54 个岸潜；水温 26–29°C。下水前需购买 STINAPA 自然费（按年计）。2023 年起部分北部潜点因珊瑚病（SCTLD）阶段性关闭，出行前查最新公告。

summary.zh: 巴西南马托格罗索州的清水河区。普拉塔河顺流浮潜约 2 公里，常见黄金河虎等鱼群；安胡马斯深渊需垂降 72 米到地下湖潜水，需潜水经验。5–9 月旱季水最清，须提前预约。
summary.en: Clear-water limestone rivers in Mato Grosso do Sul. Drift-snorkel about 2 km down the Rio da Prata among dourado and other fish schools; at Abismo Anhumas you are lowered 72 m into a cavern to dive an underground lake (scuba experience required). The dry season, May–September, is usually clearest; all tours are booked through local agencies.

highlights.zh: 普拉塔河顺流浮潜
highlights.en: Rio da Prata drift snorkel

highlights.zh: 垂降 72 米入安胡马斯深渊
highlights.en: 72 m descent into Abismo Anhumas

highlights.zh: 地下湖能见度约 60 米
highlights.en: Underground lake, ~60 m visibility

highlights.zh: 每日限额，需预约
highlights.en: Daily caps, book ahead

notes: Inland freshwater site filed under caribbean region. May–Sep dry-season clarity comes from search snippets, not from the cited pages; both attractions run year-round. Rio da Prata is in Jardim, ~47 km from Bonito town; Anhumas at [-56.60, -21.145].

name.zh: 英属维尔京群岛（罗讷号沉船）

summary.zh: 1867 年 10 月飓风中沉没的英国皇家邮船，位于盐岛黑石角，残骸分段散落在浮潜深度至 26 米。属国家公园，从托尔托拉岛乘船前往。
summary.en: Royal Mail steamer sunk off Salt Island in the October 1867 hurricane. The wreck lies in sections from snorkelling depth to 26 m, the bow deepest, inside RMS Rhone National Park; it was used in the 1977 film The Deep. Day boats run from Tortola. Turtles, stingrays and octopus are common.

highlights.zh: 1867 年邮船沉船
highlights.en: 1867 mail-steamer wreck

highlights.zh: 9–26 米分段残骸
highlights.en: Sections at 9–26 m

highlights.zh: 罗讷号国家公园
highlights.en: RMS Rhone National Park

highlights.zh: 电影取景地
highlights.en: Film location

notes: Both sources agree on location/depth but neither states a season; year-round given (BVI hurricane season Jun–Nov).

summary.zh: 卡特岛南端外海，4–5 月远洋白鳍鲨最多，常延续到 6–7 月。船程约 10 分钟，船尾放诱饵箱，鲨鱼常在水面 10 米内绕游，偶见丝鲨与旗鱼。
summary.en: Off the south end of Cat Island, oceanic whitetip sharks follow the spring tuna run, peaking in April–May with sightings often into July. Small boats go about 10 minutes offshore and hang a bait box, so sharks usually circle within 10 m of the surface; silky sharks, tuna and marlin appear at times. Suits confident divers.

highlights.zh: 远洋白鳍鲨
highlights.en: Oceanic whitetip sharks

highlights.zh: 水面附近近距离
highlights.en: Close encounters near the surface

highlights.zh: 小船少人
highlights.en: Small boats, few divers

highlights.zh: 偶见丝鲨
highlights.en: Occasional silky sharks

notes: Selection 'why' said Mar–May; sources say Apr–May peak, Apr–Jul range, so bestMonths 4–6. Trips based at Greenwood Beach Resort; Hawks Nest appears only in older reports. Species is Critically Endangered. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 布拉克岛西北岸，1996 年击沉的苏制护卫舰，长约 100 m，深 6–26 m，船艏外即峭壁。常见梭鱼、石斑与常驻巨石斑，能见度常达 30 m。
summary.en: A Soviet-built Cuban-navy frigate about 100 m long, scuttled in 1996 off the northwest coast of Cayman Brac. It lies in 6–26 m, broken in two by Hurricane Ivan, with a wall just off the bow. Barracuda, grouper and a resident goliath grouper are common; visibility is often around 30 m.

highlights.zh: 苏制护卫舰沉船
highlights.en: Soviet-built frigate wreck

highlights.zh: 船艏外即峭壁
highlights.en: Wall just off the bow

highlights.zh: 常驻巨石斑
highlights.en: Resident goliath grouper

highlights.zh: 浅，各级别可潜
highlights.en: Shallow, all levels

notes: Wreck = MV Captain Keith Tibbetts (Koni II class). Season from one source (Mar–Apr most popular; hurricane season Jul–Nov). Turtle species unspecified in sources.

summary.zh: 海流自南向北沿着西岸推着你走，几乎每一潜都是放流：Palancar 的珊瑚塔、Santa Rosa 的峭壁、Columbia 的穿越。冬季鹰鳐成群出现，特有的花斑蟾鱼藏在礁底。
summary.en: The current runs south to north along the west coast, so nearly every dive is a drift: coral pinnacles at Palancar, the Santa Rosa wall, swim-throughs at Columbia. Eagle rays gather in winter, and the endemic splendid toadfish hides under ledges.

highlights.zh: Santa Rosa Wall 的放流
highlights.en: Drifting along Santa Rosa Wall

highlights.zh: 12–3 月的鹰鳐群
highlights.en: Eagle ray gatherings, December to March

highlights.zh: 只在科苏梅尔才有的花斑蟾鱼
highlights.en: The splendid toadfish, found only around Cozumel

notes: 季节：PADI 把 11–3 月定为大货季（鹰鳐、公牛鲨），5–9 月海况平、人少；Bluewater 称鹰鳐冬季出现、12–4 月为旺季，但推荐 5–7 月避开人潮。按'看点优先'取 12–4 月。8–10 月飓风季。Devil's Throat 等深点需 AOW。坐标指向 Palancar 礁区。

summary.zh: 佛州西岸国王湾由泉水补给，水温常年约 22°C，冬季数百头海牛进湾避寒。11–3 月跟持证向导浮潜，只能在水面静观、不可触摸，标记的保护区季内禁入。
summary.en: Spring-fed Kings Bay on Florida's Gulf coast stays about 22°C all year, and hundreds of West Indian manatees shelter here in winter. Snorkel with a licensed guide, mainly mid-November to March; the rules allow only passive observation from the surface, and marked sanctuaries are closed in season.

highlights.zh: 冬季海牛聚集
highlights.en: Winter manatee gathering

highlights.zh: 美国少数可合法共游之地
highlights.en: One of few legal manatee swims in the US

highlights.zh: 三姐妹泉
highlights.en: Three Sisters Springs

highlights.zh: 浅水浮潜，无需潜水证
highlights.en: Shallow snorkel, no certification needed

notes: Three Sisters Springs closed to kayaks Nov 15–Mar 31 and roped off when water < 17°C; scuba there only Apr 1–Nov 14. Uses new species id 'manatee' (only signature animal, so one species). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 博奈尔的邻岛，在飓风带之外，全年可潜。岛上六十多个潜点大多能自驾岸潜。浅水的拖船沉船适合新手，蘑菇森林满是蘑菇状的珊瑚头，30 米深的 Superior Producer 沉船留给进阶潜水员。
summary.en: Bonaire's neighbour lies outside the hurricane belt and is dived all year. Most of its 60-plus sites are shore entries you can drive to. The shallow Tugboat wreck suits beginners, the Mushroom Forest is a field of mushroom-shaped coral heads, and the Superior Producer wreck at 30 m is for advanced divers.

highlights.zh: 自驾岸潜，几十个潜点随到随下
highlights.en: Self-drive shore diving at dozens of sites

highlights.zh: 蘑菇森林的蘑菇状珊瑚头
highlights.en: Mushroom-shaped coral heads at Mushroom Forest

highlights.zh: 浅水拖船沉船与 30 米的 Superior Producer
highlights.en: The shallow Tugboat wreck and the Superior Producer at 30 m

notes: 季节：PADI 写全年能见度都好、5–11 月淡季最适合，12–4 月游客最多，并说库拉索在飓风带之外；Bluewater 写几乎全年都好，雨季 10–12 月，12 月中–4 月中为旺季，珊瑚产卵在 9–10 月满月后约 7 天。两者都说全年，取空数组。潜点数：PADI 写 70 多个可从岸边下水，Bluewater 写 60 多个、大多可岸潜，文案取六十多个。Bluewater：拖船沉船浅、适合新手，旁边码头有海马、章鱼和大海鲢；蘑菇森林是招牌潜点，从西端坐船 20–30 分钟；Superior Producer 在 30 m、适合进阶；小库拉索（Klein Curaçao）船程长，偶见翻车鲀和双髻鲨；Bluewater 称库拉索是「微距岛」，鲨鱼和蝠鲼少见，常见躄鱼、侏儒神仙鱼、海蛞蝓，大型动物有梭鱼、海龟、魟和鹰鳐。PADI 列海龟、鹰鳐、海鳝。海龟未分种，按玳瑁列。DIVE Magazine 的库拉索指南只抓到导言，未列入来源。水温：Bluewater 写夏季华氏 80 多度中段、冬季华氏 70 多度高段，取 26–29°C；能见度 Bluewater 15–30 m。坐标为 Caracasbaai 拖船沉船一带，潜点沿全岛背风岸分布。

name.zh: 迪恩斯蓝洞（巴哈马长岛）

summary.zh: 长岛克拉伦斯镇以西海湾里的海洋蓝洞，深约 202 米，入口约 30 米宽、下方扩成百米大厅。洞内少流少浪，是自由潜训练与比赛地，浅缘可浮潜。
summary.en: Ocean blue hole in a bay west of Clarence Town, Long Island, about 202 m deep; a roughly 30 m opening widens into a cavern about 100 m across. Sheltered from current and swell, it is used for freediving training and an annual competition; snorkellers stay on the shallow rim. Reached by road from Clarence Town.

highlights.zh: 深约 202 米的蓝洞
highlights.en: Blue hole about 202 m deep

highlights.zh: 自由潜训练与比赛地
highlights.en: Freediving training and competition venue

highlights.zh: 洞内少流少浪
highlights.en: Sheltered, little current or swell

highlights.zh: 浅缘可浮潜
highlights.en: Snorkelling on the shallow rim

notes: Neither source states a season; all 12 months given because the hole is sheltered, but Jun–Nov is hurricane season. Wikipedia ranks it third-deepest blue hole (after Taam Ja' and Dragon Hole); older sources say second, so the summary avoids a ranking. Species are generic (operator page lists turtles, rays, a resident tarpon school).

summary.zh: 西岸外海住着三五十个抹香鲸家族群，最多约 250 头。2023 年政府宣布设立约 780 平方公里的保护区，下水同游只有限开放。潜水集中在西南岸：香槟礁的地热口冒出串串气泡，海马、躄鱼等微距生物常见。
summary.en: Some 35 to 50 sperm whale family groups, up to about 250 animals, live off Dominica's west coast. In 2023 the government announced a sperm whale reserve of roughly 780 km², where in-water encounters are allowed only on a limited basis. Diving centres on the southwest coast, where geothermal vents send bubbles up through Champagne Reef and seahorses and frogfish are regular finds.

highlights.zh: 1–3 月出海看抹香鲸
highlights.en: Boat trips to find sperm whales, January to March

highlights.zh: 香槟礁：地热气泡从海底冒出
highlights.en: Champagne Reef: geothermal bubbles rising from the seabed

highlights.zh: 海马、躄鱼等微距生物
highlights.en: Seahorses, frogfish and other macro life

notes: 季节：PADI 写全年适合潜水、12–5 月最干最平，1–3 月可在外海见到洄游的抹香鲸和座头鲸；Bluewater 写全年可潜、雨季 7–10 月，看抹香鲸推荐 11–3 月。两者重叠为 1–3 月，取 1–3 月，按 Bluewater 11–12 月也可。保护区：Divernet（2023-11-14）写总理 11 月 13 日宣布，西岸外约 300 平方英里（约 780 km²），18 m 以上船只限走窄通道、只许小规模传统渔业，游客可下水接触但「有限度」，当时立法尚未完成；约 35–50 个家族群、最多约 250 头，活动范围小、在此觅食育幼。下水许可的名额和价格所开来源未写，出行前向运营商确认。Dominica Sperm Whale Project 网站写东加勒比群体估计不到 500 头、每年约减少 3%，并推动规范商业同游（未列入来源）。level 取 OW 指礁区潜水，与鲸同游是浮潜。香槟礁：Bluewater 写流缓、有海马、躄鱼、飞角鱼和乌贼，地热口让水变暖冒泡；PADI 写有地热气泡。水温 PADI 26–29°C；能见度 Bluewater 18–30 m。海龟依据 PADI 的 turtles，未分种。坐标为苏弗里耶尔湾（Soufrière / Scotts Head 一带），潜店集中在罗索到苏弗里耶尔的西岸。

summary.zh: 以斯坦尼尔岛为基地：霹雳弹洞低潮时可浮潜入洞，罗盘岛浅水与温顺的护士鲨同游，附近有游泳的猪；北侧是禁渔的陆海公园。11–4 月海况通常较稳，需向导船。
summary.en: Based on Staniel Cay in the central Exumas: snorkel into Thunderball Grotto at low or slack tide, swim with docile nurse sharks in the shallows at Compass Cay, and see the swimming pigs nearby. The no-take Exuma Cays Land and Sea Park lies just north. November–April is usually calmest; trips are by guided boat.

highlights.zh: 霹雳弹洞
highlights.en: Thunderball Grotto

highlights.zh: 浅水护士鲨
highlights.en: Shallow-water nurse sharks

highlights.zh: 游泳的猪
highlights.en: Swimming pigs

highlights.zh: 禁渔陆海公园
highlights.en: No-take land and sea park

notes: Mostly a snorkel destination; pigs are on Big Major Cay. Season from one operator blog only. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 巴西东北外海约 350 公里的火山群岛，七成属国家海洋公园，也是世界遗产。海豚每天清晨在海豚湾休息，只能在崖上看。潜水须跟公园授权的潜店，能见度常有 25–40 米，玳瑁和护士鲨常见。
summary.en: A volcanic archipelago about 350 km off northeast Brazil, 70 percent of it a national marine park and a World Heritage site. Spinner dolphins rest in Baía dos Golfinhos each morning and are watched from the cliffs. Dives go only with park-authorised operators, visibility is often 25 to 40 m, and hawksbills and nurse sharks are common.

highlights.zh: 清晨在崖上看海豚湾里休息的海豚
highlights.en: Watching spinner dolphins rest in the bay from the cliffs at dawn

highlights.zh: 能见度常有 25–40 米，玳瑁常见
highlights.en: Visibility often 25 to 40 m, with frequent hawksbills

highlights.zh: Ilha do Meio 浅水的洞穴与穿越
highlights.en: Shallow caves and swim-throughs at Ilha do Meio

notes: 季节未能用两个来源核实（WebSearch 配额用完，只能抓已知的官方页面）：ICMBio 公园官网写 3–7 月雨季、步道泥泞；Divernet（2025-01）写北侧「内海」4–11 月平静，其余时间东北信风控制，南侧「外海」常年浪大但更清，潜店按季节挑点，作者 12 月下水。两者都不直接给最佳月份；取干季与内海平静的重叠段 8–11 月，补到一个直接写季节的来源后再改 verified。规则：ICMBio 写公园内水肺潜水只能跟 ICMBio 授权的潜店，水温约 26°C，推荐点 Pedras Secas、Ilha do Meio、Cagarras、Ressurreta，禁止采集、触摸、投喂；海豚湾 6:30–18:30 开放，清晨看海豚，禁止下到湾里、游泳或行船；Praia do Leão 是绿海龟主要产卵海滩（约 12–5 月）。诺罗尼亚行政区官网写 20 个潜点、能见度可达 50 m、约 26°C，跟持牌向导潜水须出示 OW 或以上证书，体验潜最深 12 m；另一页写海洋国家公园 1988 年设立、占群岛 70%。费用：ICMBio 两页的公园门票分别写 R$373 和 R$384（巴西人半价），10 天有效；Divernet 写外国人 R$222 与每晚 76 雷亚尔的环境保护税（TPA，越住越贵），金额已过时，文案未写费用。Divernet：能见度 25–40 m、28°C；常见玳瑁、偶见绿海龟，Caverna da Sapata 有美洲魟，多处见护士鲨，Trinta Reis 见过加勒比礁鲨；Ilha do Meio 有浅水洞穴与穿越；离累西腓 525 km、纳塔尔 350 km，从累西腓飞约 1 小时，岛上有三家潜店。世界遗产依据 PADI 巴西页（UNESCO 官网 403 未能打开）。海豚是飞旋海豚（行政区官网写 Stenella longirostris），按命名规则用泛称；能在船上和崖上看，下潜时偶遇，排第一是因为它是这里最出名的动物。Corveta Ipiranga 沉船（约 60 m、技术潜）未查证，未写入。坐标为圣安东尼奥港（Porto de Santo Antônio），潜店集中在这里。

summary.zh: 佛州盖恩斯维尔西北约 1 小时的私营泉区，水温常年约 22°C，水极清。开放水域潜水员可带灯进约 15 米深的舞厅洞穴；恶魔之眼禁灯，深入洞穴需洞潜资质。
summary.en: Privately run spring park on the Santa Fe River, about an hour northwest of Gainesville. Water is about 22°C and very clear all year. Open-water divers may take a light into the Ballroom cavern (about 15 m, ends at a grate); at Devil's Eye no lights, and the cave beyond needs cave certification. Summer weekends get crowded.

highlights.zh: 舞厅洞穴（开放水域可进）
highlights.en: Ballroom cavern open to OW divers

highlights.zh: 恶魔之眼泉眼
highlights.en: Devil's Eye spring vent

highlights.zh: 常年约 22°C
highlights.en: About 22°C all year

highlights.zh: 洞潜系统入口（需资质）
highlights.en: Cave system entry (cave-certified only)

notes: Freshwater Florida site filed under caribbean region. No signature species; left empty like yucatan-cenotes. Min age 12, bring cert card; rules come from older articles, confirm with the park.

summary.zh: 普拉森西亚以东约 40 公里的礁盘突角。3–6 月满月前后笛鲷集群产卵，鲸鲨常来吞食鱼卵；蓝水中层漂流，限深 18 米，适合进阶潜水员，船程约 1.5 小时。
summary.en: Reef promontory about 40 km east of Placencia. From March to June, around the full moon, cubera, mutton and dog snapper spawn here and whale sharks often arrive to feed on the eggs. Mid-water blue-water drifts, max 18 m, advanced level; about 1.5 h by boat, with caps on boats and divers.

highlights.zh: 满月前后笛鲷产卵
highlights.en: Snapper spawning around the full moon

highlights.zh: 鲸鲨吞食鱼卵
highlights.en: Whale sharks feeding on spawn

highlights.zh: 蓝水漂流，限深 18 米
highlights.en: Blue-water drift, 18 m limit

highlights.zh: 银礁岛浮潜
highlights.en: Snorkeling at the Silk Cayes

notes: Peak usually Apr–May; window roughly 2–3 days before full moon to ~10 days after (sources differ). Reserve caps boats (6) and group size (12 divers + DM). Turtles are from Silk Cayes snorkeling (species not named in source). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 北湾里一片三四米深的白沙地，几十年的投喂让魟鱼习惯了围着人打转。岛的西岸有 Kittiwake 沉船，北岸是从十几米直落下去的峭壁；石灰岩岛没有河流入海，能见度常年很好。
summary.en: A patch of white sand 3 to 4 m deep in the North Sound where decades of feeding have taught southern stingrays to crowd around people. The Kittiwake wreck sits off the west coast and the North Wall drops away from about 13 m. With no rivers on the limestone island, visibility stays high year-round.

highlights.zh: 魟鱼城沙洲上围着人转的魟鱼
highlights.en: Stingrays crowding the Stingray City sandbar

highlights.zh: 浅到可以浮潜的 Kittiwake 沉船
highlights.en: The Kittiwake wreck, shallow enough to snorkel

highlights.zh: 北墙的悬垂与鹰鳐
highlights.en: Overhangs and eagle rays on the North Wall

notes: 季节：Dive The World 与 liveaboard.com 均称全年可潜（4–6 月礁鱼与海龟最活跃、5–6 月海况最佳），Red Sail（当地运营商）把 12–4 月干季称为旺季；取全年。8–10 月飓风季。Dive The World 写魟鱼城 12 m 应为 12 ft 之误，潜点约 3.7 米、沙洲处仅及腰；邮轮客上午中段最多，早晚去人少。开曼旅游局页面抓取被拒，未计入来源。

name.zh: 格林纳达（水下雕塑公园）
name.en: Grenada – Underwater Sculpture Park & Bianca C

summary.zh: 莫利纳尔湾雕塑公园 2006 年开放，60 余件雕塑在 12 米以内，可浮潜；大安斯海滩外约 2 公里有比安卡C号邮轮残骸，顶部约 30 米、海底 50 米。
summary.en: Molinere Bay, north of St George's, holds the first underwater sculpture park (opened 2006): over 65 concrete figures within 12 m, open to snorkellers. About 2 km off Grand Anse lies the 180 m liner Bianca C, sunk in 1961; her top is near 30 m on a 50 m seabed, a dive for experienced deep divers.

highlights.zh: 水下雕塑公园
highlights.en: Underwater sculpture park

highlights.zh: 雕塑区可浮潜
highlights.en: Sculptures at snorkel depth

highlights.zh: 比安卡C号邮轮沉船
highlights.en: Bianca C liner wreck

highlights.zh: 30–50 米深潜沉船
highlights.en: Deep wreck at 30–50 m

notes: Neither source states a season; year-round given (Grenada lies at the southern edge of the hurricane belt). Bianca C is at about [-61.759, 12.053], ~4 km south of the site point. Search snippets mention frequent strong current on the wreck. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

name.zh: 霍尔灿保护区（安伯格里斯岛）

summary.zh: 圣佩德罗以南约 6 公里的礁盘水道，深 2–9 米；南侧鲨鱼魟鱼巷常见护士鲨与魟鱼聚集。适合浮潜与初级潜水，春末能见度通常最好，潮流有时较强。
summary.en: Reef channel about 6 km south of San Pedro, Ambergris Caye, 2–9 m deep. A mile further south, Shark Ray Alley usually has nurse sharks and southern stingrays gathering. Suits snorkellers and new divers; late spring usually brings the best visibility, and tidal currents can be strong. Day boats run from San Pedro.

highlights.zh: 鲨鱼魟鱼巷
highlights.en: Shark Ray Alley

highlights.zh: 护士鲨与魟鱼
highlights.en: Nurse sharks and southern stingrays

highlights.zh: 浅水浮潜
highlights.en: Shallow snorkelling

highlights.zh: 保护区内勿喂食、勿触摸
highlights.en: No feeding or touching in the reserve

notes: Only one source read. Guides at Shark Ray Alley have historically fed the animals; belize.com advises visitors not to feed or touch. 'Northers' in late fall/early winter can cancel boats. Caye Caulker departures common but not in the cited page. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 坎昆对岸的小岛。每年 6–9 月，鲸鲨在岛东北外海聚集，吞食小金枪鱼产下的鱼卵，7–8 月最多。出海约一小时，与鲸鲨同游只许浮潜，不能背气瓶。近岸还可以潜坎昆与女人岛之间的水下雕塑博物馆和浅礁。
summary.en: A small island across the water from Cancún. From June to September whale sharks gather in open water to the northeast to feed on the eggs of spawning little tunny, in the largest numbers in July and August. The ride out takes about an hour and encounters are snorkel-only. Closer in, the underwater sculpture museum and shallow reefs between Cancún and the island make easy dives.

highlights.zh: 6–9 月浮潜看鲸鲨聚食，7–8 月最多
highlights.en: Snorkel with feeding whale sharks June to September, most in July and August

highlights.zh: 鲸鲨季偶有大型蝠鲼和宽吻海豚出现
highlights.en: Mantas and bottlenose dolphins sometimes appear in whale shark season

highlights.zh: 水下雕塑博物馆（MUSA）的 500 多座雕塑
highlights.en: More than 500 sculptures in the underwater museum (MUSA)

notes: 季节：PADI 按月清单把墨西哥加勒比（女人岛、霍尔博克斯）列在 6–9 月、7 月为高峰；Bluewater 写 6–9 月；DIVE Magazine 墨西哥指南写 6–9 月；X-Ray Mag 写 Afuera 聚集在 7–8 月，小金枪鱼产卵期约 4 月中到 9 月中、7–8 月为峰；金塔纳罗奥州旅游局写 5–9 月；运营商页面（搜索摘要）有 5/15–9/17 与 6/1–9/15 两种官方季说法。取 6–9 月。规则：DIVE Magazine 明确写不许水肺、只许浮潜，须用持牌运营商；搜索摘要里运营商规则为每次两人加一名向导下水、不得触碰、离头部 2 m 尾部 5 m，未在已开页面核实，未写进文案。地点：Afuera 在女人岛东北外海的开放水域，不在鲸鲨生物圈保护区内（X-Ray、DIVE）；DIVE 作者日出时从女人岛码头出发、向东北偏东约 1 小时，同场常有 45–55 条船；近岸绿水能见度 5–8 m，Afuera 蓝水 15–25 m；Bluewater 写礁区 24–30 m，故 visibilityM 取 5–30。蝠鲼：DIVE 写偶有 manta rays、Bluewater 写蝠鲼也吃这批鱼卵，来源未分种，按大西洋常见的大洋蝠鲼列；鹰鳐来自 Bluewater 页面上的潜水员点评（春季沉船上成群），可信度一般。旗鱼季：Bluewater 写 12 月中–3 月中，DivePlanit 12–2 月，DIVE 12–6 月，未写进文案。霍尔博克斯（Holbox）是同一鲸鲨群的另一出发港，未单列。水温 25–28°C 来自 Bluewater。坐标为女人岛北端市区码头。

summary.zh: 古巴南岸外几乎无人居住的群岛保护区，只能从胡卡罗港坐船进去，每年潜水员人数有严格限额。几乎没有流，加勒比礁鲨和丝鲨会贴着潜水员转圈；红树林里还能和美洲鳄一起浮潜。
summary.en: An almost uninhabited archipelago reserve off Cuba's south coast, reached only by boat from the port of Jucaro, with a strict annual cap on diver numbers. There is hardly any current, and Caribbean reef sharks and silky sharks circle within touching distance. In the mangroves you can snorkel with American crocodiles.

highlights.zh: 一潜几十条礁鲨与丝鲨围绕
highlights.en: Dozens of reef and silky sharks on a single dive

highlights.zh: 红树林浅水里的美洲鳄浮潜
highlights.en: Snorkelling with American crocodiles in the mangrove shallows

highlights.zh: 巨型石斑与健康的珊瑚墙
highlights.en: Goliath grouper and healthy coral walls

notes: 季节：PADI 与 DIVE Magazine 均取 12–4 月干季，Dive The World 称全年可潜、12–4 月较凉（23–25°C）、8 月最暖（约 28°C），7–11 月有鲸鲨经过；6–11 月飓风季。从哈瓦那到胡卡罗约 5–6 小时车程，再航行约 3 小时。运营商 Avalon 为主，另有 Aggressor 船；每年 3000 人限额来自 Dive The World 与 Avalon 官网。

summary.zh: 墨西哥湾流从近海流过，放流是常态，潜点多在 18–27 米。7–9 月大西洋巨石斑聚在沉船产卵，最长 2.5 米；12–3 月换成柠檬鲨在沉船和礁台边成群。南边的蓝鹭桥是涨潮前后下水的微距岸潜点。
summary.en: With the Gulf Stream running close by, drift dives are the norm and most sites are 18 to 27 m deep. From July to September goliath groupers gather on the wrecks to spawn, the largest up to 2.5 m long; from December to March lemon sharks school around the same wrecks and ledges. To the south, Blue Heron Bridge is a shallow shore macro dive timed around high tide.

highlights.zh: 7–9 月沉船上的巨石斑产卵群
highlights.en: Spawning goliath groupers on the wrecks, July to September

highlights.zh: 12–3 月的柠檬鲨群
highlights.en: Lemon shark aggregations, December to March

highlights.zh: 蓝鹭桥：涨潮前后的浅水微距岸潜
highlights.en: Blue Heron Bridge: shallow macro shore diving around high tide

notes: 两个看点各自成季，bestMonths 合并两段。巨石斑：PADI 朱庇特页写 7–10 月条件最好、是遇到巨石斑夏季聚集的主季；佛罗里达自然史博物馆写产卵在 7–9 月、受月相影响；NOAA 写自 1994 年起每年夏秋产卵期都有调查。取 7–9 月。柠檬鲨：DIVE Magazine 写每年 12 月到 3 月下旬在朱庇特到棕榈滩的沉船与深礁台聚集、难度初级；Bluewater 写冬季有柠檬鲨年度洄游、常在沉船边、一直到西棕榈滩。取 12–3 月。PADI 佛州总页写夏季在浅礁能见到柠檬鲨，与上两者不同，未采用；PADI 西棕榈滩页另写 12–2 月水清海况平、3–5 月最理想、6–8 月雨季、9–11 月飓风季。条件：PADI 朱庇特写湾流带来中到强流、放流为主，多数潜点 60–90 ft（18–27 m），适合中级和进阶；水温冬 74°F 到夏 86°F，西棕榈滩冬 70–75°F；能见度 40–80 ft、夏秋更好。DIVE 另写全年都能遇到鲨鱼，包括公牛鲨。蓝鹭桥（Bluewater 点评）：涨潮前 1 小时到后 1 小时、白天下水，平均 14 ft、涨潮最深约 18 ft，其他时段能见度差；Bluewater 也写这里某些季节有石斑聚集。level 取 AOW 指外海沉船放流，蓝鹭桥 OW 即可。新增物种 goliath-grouper（Epinephelus itajara）：现有 giant-grouper（龙趸）是印太种，不是同一种；博物馆写最长 2.5 m、最重约 363 kg；美国联邦水域 1990 年起禁捕（NOAA）。中文名取「大西洋巨石斑」，正式中文名为伊氏石斑鱼。海龟依据 PADI 西棕榈滩页的 turtles，未分种。棕榈滩旅游局与 FWC 页面均 403，未能打开。坐标为朱庇特入海口，蓝鹭桥在其南约 18 km 的 Riviera Beach。

summary.zh: 美国本土唯一的活珊瑚堡礁从这里经过，礁潜多在 6–11 米，彭尼坎普的浅礁上有青铜基督像。外海约 10 公里是 155 米长的军舰斯皮格尔格罗夫号，船顶约 18 米、沙底约 40 米，一般要进阶证。
summary.en: The only living barrier reef in the continental US runs past Key Largo, with most reef dives at 6 to 11 m and a bronze Christ statue on a shallow reef in Pennekamp state park. About 10 km offshore lies the Spiegel Grove, a 155 m retired navy ship sunk in 2002, its top near 18 m and the sand near 40 m; Advanced Open Water is normally required.

highlights.zh: 浅礁上的青铜基督像，浮潜也能看到
highlights.en: The bronze Christ statue on a shallow reef, within snorkelling reach

highlights.zh: 斯皮格尔格罗夫号：2005 年被飓风扶正的军舰（一般要进阶证）
highlights.en: Spiegel Grove: a navy ship set upright by a 2005 hurricane (normally Advanced Open Water)

highlights.zh: 4–8 月海况最平、能见度最好
highlights.en: Calmest seas and clearest water from April to August

notes: 季节：PADI 写全年可潜、4–8 月海况平静能见度最好，12–3 月较凉，9–10 月适合有经验者；Bluewater（佛州总页）写春到秋最好、晚夏到秋为飓风季、冬季要厚防寒衣，斯皮格尔格罗夫号全年可潜。取 4–8 月。佛罗里达群岛旅游局（Monroe County TDC）：能见度 25–100 ft、平均 50 ft，水温冬 70°F 到夏 85°F，礁潜多在 20–35 ft 的外侧堤礁；彭尼坎普是美国第一座水下公园，「Christ of the Deep」铜像高 9 ft、在 25 ft 水深（Bluewater 写 8 ft）；基拉戈国家海洋保护区 1975 年设立，佛州群岛国家海洋保护区约 2,800 平方英里。斯皮格尔格罗夫号（旅游局）：510 ft，2002 年 5 月沉放时提前意外翻沉、6 月 10 日侧躺完成沉放，2005 年 7 月飓风丹尼斯把它扶正；离岸 6 英里（另一页写 7 英里）、沙底约 130 ft；不穿舱潜水要求 AOW 或以上，只有 OW 者需查日志；Bluewater 写船顶 60 ft、底 134 ft、8 月偶有公牛鲨、常有大海鲢。另有 Duane（120 ft 直立）与 Bibb（130 ft 侧躺）两艘 327 ft 海警船。level 取 OW 指礁区，沉船须 AOW。物种：PADI 列鹰鳐、海鳝、礁鲨、海龟；旅游局只写海龟与「large groupers」（未点名巨石斑，所以没列 goliath-grouper）。海龟未分种，按绿海龟列。NOAA 保护区官网的斯皮格尔格罗夫号页已 404，未列入来源。坐标在斯皮格尔格罗夫号与 Dry Rocks 礁之间的外海，码头在基拉戈岛上。

summary.zh: 2009 年击沉于西礁岛以南约 11 km 的 159 m 导弹追踪舰，坐直于约 43 m 沙底，上层建筑约 12 m 起、甲板约 30 m。湾流过境常有流，适合进阶潜水员。
summary.en: A 159 m former missile-tracking ship scuttled in 2009 about 11 km south of Key West. It sits upright on sand at about 43 m; the superstructure starts near 12 m and the main deck is around 30 m. The Gulf Stream brings current and passing pelagics; suited to advanced divers.

highlights.zh: 坐直完整的大型沉船
highlights.en: Large wreck sitting upright

highlights.zh: 佛州礁岛链沉船之路
highlights.en: Florida Keys Shipwreck Trail

highlights.zh: 湾流带来洄游鱼
highlights.en: Gulf Stream pelagics

notes: Season mixed in sources (spring/fall vs May–July); Keys diving runs year-round, winter fronts make seas rough. Goliath grouper/barracuda from general knowledge, not the cited page. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 小开曼北岸的血湾峭壁顶部只有约 7 米深，随即直落深海，墙面长满瓶状和管状海绵，属海洋公园。相邻的 Jackson's Bight 多裂缝和隧道，沙地上常见鹰鳐和魟。全年可潜，能见度常超 30 米。
summary.en: On Little Cayman's north shore, Bloody Bay Wall starts about 7 m down and plunges into the deep, its face covered in vase and tube sponges inside a marine park. Neighbouring Jackson's Bight is cut with cracks and tunnels, with eagle rays and stingrays over the sand. It is dived year-round, visibility is often beyond 30 m, and Cayman liveaboards reach it from Grand Cayman.

highlights.zh: 血湾峭壁：约 7 米起的垂直墙
highlights.en: Bloody Bay Wall: a vertical face from about 7 m

highlights.zh: Jackson's Bight 的裂缝、隧道与鹰鳐
highlights.en: Cracks, tunnels and eagle rays at Jackson's Bight

highlights.zh: 可坐开曼船宿从大开曼一并潜到
highlights.en: Reachable on Cayman liveaboards from Grand Cayman

notes: 季节：DTW 与 liveaboard.com 都说开曼全年可潜（DTW：4–6 月鱼最活跃、初夏绿海龟多、9 月珊瑚产卵；liveaboard.com：5–6 月条件最好），与大开曼条目一致取全年。8–10 月飓风季。墙顶：DTW 写从 7 m 起；搜索摘要里开曼旅游局潜水手册写 18 ft 起、底约 6,000 ft（页面 403 未能打开）。DTW：北岸 15 个以上潜点；Jackson's Bight 在西北，经 Mixing Bowl（3 Fathom Wall）与血湾相连；Randy's Gazebo 有鹰鳐和海龟，Paul's Anchor 有礁鲨和海龟，Lea Lea's Look 的 Great Room 有护士鲨，Blacktip Boulevard（15 m 沙地）常有「blacktip reef sharks」——加勒比没有印太的黑鳍礁鲨，应是黑边鳍真鲨或加勒比礁鲨，所以文案没写这个名字。liveaboard.com：受保护的海洋公园，瓶状与管状海绵，船宿从乔治敦出发、天气允许时三岛都去。水温 DTW 26.5–30°C；能见度 DTW 平均 30 m、小开曼常更好，liveaboard.com 至少 30 m、常超 45 m。海龟来源未分种，按以海绵为食、墙潜常见的玳瑁列。小开曼冬季满月前后另有拿骚石斑产卵聚集（Grouper Moon 研究项目），未查证，未写入。坐标为血湾中段。

name.zh: 马提尼克（圣皮埃尔沉船）

summary.zh: 1902 年培雷火山爆发，圣皮埃尔港十余艘船沉没。沉船深 12–85 m，多在 20–40 m；保存最好的罗赖马号 40–60 m，需技术潜水。12–5 月旱季能见度较好。
summary.en: The 1902 eruption of Mount Pelée sank more than a dozen ships in Saint-Pierre harbour. Wrecks lie from about 12 m, reachable by snorkel, to 85 m; most are at 20–40 m, and the best-preserved Roraima at 40–60 m needs technical training. The December–May dry season usually gives the best visibility.

highlights.zh: 1902 年火山沉船群
highlights.en: Wrecks of the 1902 eruption

highlights.zh: 罗赖马号
highlights.en: The Roraima

highlights.zh: 2012 年起受保护
highlights.en: Protected since 2012

notes: Tamaya (~85 m) is off-limits to scuba. Season from one source only. check-sites-geo warns country 'Martinique' not in base map (it is France in NE data) — needs an alias. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 新普罗维登斯岛西南岸。礁鲨投喂潜在约 12 米沙地，常见数十条加勒比礁鲨；附近有 007 电影用过的飞机与货船残骸，也在 12 米左右。全年可潜。
summary.en: Southwest New Providence. On the shark-feed dive, divers kneel on sand at about 12 m while dozens of Caribbean reef sharks circle. Nearby, a bomber prop and the Tears of Allah freighter used in Bond films lie at about 12 m. Diveable year-round; September is the wettest month and summer storms bring swell.

highlights.zh: 礁鲨投喂潜
highlights.en: Reef shark feed dive

highlights.zh: 007 电影沉船
highlights.en: Bond-film wrecks

highlights.zh: 多处浅水沉船
highlights.en: Several shallow wrecks

notes: Only one page read (zubludiving 403). Feed dives are operator-run baited dives. Silky sharks at Shark Buoy in summer (best June) come from a search snippet, not the cited page.

summary.zh: “大西洋坟场”二战沉船，帕普斯号（约 37 m）、加勒比海号（约 27 m）常聚沙虎鲨，数量不定。6–10 月为季，水温 21–25°C，多深于 27 m，需进阶证。
summary.en: WWII-era wrecks in the 'Graveyard of the Atlantic' off North Carolina, where sand tiger sharks often gather; the Papoose (about 37 m) and Caribsea (about 27 m) are known for them, though numbers vary. Season June–October, water 21–25°C. Most wrecks are deeper than 27 m and boat rides can take up to two hours.

highlights.zh: 沙虎鲨聚集
highlights.en: Sand tiger shark gatherings

highlights.zh: 二战沉船
highlights.en: WWII wrecks

highlights.zh: U-352 德国潜艇
highlights.en: U-352 U-boat

highlights.zh: 进阶深度
highlights.en: Advanced depths

notes: Sand tiger = grey-nurse-shark id (Carcharias taurus). Coords are the Morehead City / Cape Lookout offshore area, not the northern Outer Banks. Sharks present year-round; peak Jun–Oct.

name.zh: 瓦尔德斯半岛（马德林港）

summary.zh: 马德林港外的新湾，可在蓬塔洛马海狮栖息地与好奇的南美海狮同游（8–15 米，水温约 7–18°C）。6–12 月南露脊鲸入湾，9–10 月最多，只能乘船观赏。
summary.en: Golfo Nuevo off Puerto Madryn: dive or snorkel with curious South American sea lions at the Punta Loma colony (8–15 m, water about 7–18°C, visibility often 5–15 m), plus several wrecks. Southern right whales enter the gulfs June–December, peaking September–October; viewing is by boat only. UNESCO World Heritage site.

highlights.zh: 与好奇的南美海狮同游
highlights.en: Curious South American sea lions

highlights.zh: 南露脊鲸季（6–12 月）
highlights.en: Southern right whale season (Jun–Dec)

highlights.zh: 沉船潜水
highlights.en: Wreck dives

highlights.zh: 冷水潜水
highlights.en: Cold-water diving

notes: Region given as caribbean but site is South Atlantic; consider atlantic-med or polar. bestMonths = sea-lion dive operating season Oct–May (one source; others say sea lions year-round). Whales Jun–Dec (two sources agree); Oct–Nov overlaps both. Orcas hunt at Punta Norte Mar–Apr, seen from shore only; elephant seals at Punta Norte.

summary.zh: 每年冬天，怀孕的雌性公牛鲨回到卡门海滩外海。潜水员待在约 24 米深的沙底，看体长 1.2 到 2.5 米的公牛鲨在身边巡游，一潜常见十几条。从海滩出发船程约 10 分钟，运营商多要求进阶证。
summary.en: Every winter, pregnant female bull sharks return to the water off Playa del Carmen. Divers settle on sand at about 24 m while sharks of 1.2 to 2.5 m circle past, often a dozen or more on one dive. The boat ride from the beach is about ten minutes, and most operators ask for Advanced Open Water.

highlights.zh: 11–2 月在约 24 米沙底看公牛鲨
highlights.en: Bull sharks over sand at about 24 m, November to February

highlights.zh: 有投喂与不投喂两种做法，鲨鱼靠近的程度不同
highlights.en: Both fed and unfed dives are run, and how close the sharks come differs

highlights.zh: 附近有多处适合新手的浅礁
highlights.en: Several shallow, beginner-friendly reefs nearby

notes: 季节：X-Ray Mag 写每年 11 月到、待到 2 月或 3 月；TDI/SDI 写 11–3 月；DIVE Magazine 写 12–2 月；Pro Dive International（运营商）写 12–3 月。11–2 月至少两家支持，取 11–2 月，3 月为肩季，个别年份会提前离开或延后。潜点 Shark Point，系泊绳底端约 24 m（X-Ray、TDI），离海滩约 10 分钟船程（X-Ray）；X-Ray 写单瓶免减压、底时约 25 分钟、每条船在点上 30 分钟。数量：TDI 一潜 12–15 条、体长 1.2–2.5 m；X-Ray 投喂潜可达 20 条；DIVE 写一潜可达 30 条、约一半怀孕。投喂：部分运营商投喂（需投喂许可），也有不投喂的做法，不投喂不保证见到（X-Ray）。等级：Pro Dive 写这是给有经验 / 进阶潜水员的深潜，搜索摘要里其他运营商要求 AOW 或深潜专长、或 OW + 25 次以上，取 AOW。保护：Saving Our Sharks 基金会、CONANP 与潜店在 2011 年后制定操作手册，潜水员缴费补偿渔民不捕鲨（X-Ray）。水温、能见度为参考值（同片海域的女人岛 Bluewater 写 25–28°C），所开来源未给数字。物种：海龟依据 Pro Dive 列的 Tortugas 礁（以海龟出名），未分种；Pro Dive 列的新手浅礁有 Jardines、Shangri-la、Chun-Zumbul（6–13 m）。坐标为卡门海滩市区海滩。中文名：常见译名「卡门海滩」，也写普拉亚德尔卡门；括号标明看点，同「狂野海岸（沙丁鱼风暴）」。

summary.zh: 中美洲堡礁南端的长条岛，出码头几分钟就是峭壁。Mary's Place 的裂缝、El Aguila 沉船和 Cara a Cara 的礁鲨潜是三张名片；雨季 10 月中到 2 月，3–9 月海况最好。
summary.en: A long island at the southern end of the Mesoamerican reef, with walls starting minutes from the dock. The volcanic crevice at Mary's Place, the El Aguila wreck and the Cara a Cara reef-shark dive are its three calling cards. Rain falls mostly from mid-October to February; March to September brings the calmest seas.

highlights.zh: Mary's Place 的垂直裂缝
highlights.en: The vertical crevice at Mary's Place

highlights.zh: Cara a Cara 沙地上的加勒比礁鲨
highlights.en: Caribbean reef sharks on the sand at Cara a Cara

highlights.zh: 邻岛乌提拉的鲸鲨（3–5 月、8–10 月）
highlights.en: Whale sharks off neighbouring Utila, March to May and August to October

notes: 季节：PADI 3–9 月干季最佳；Bluewater 称全年可潜、雨季 10 月中–2 月、5–9 月最干；取 3–9 月。水温 PADI 25–29°C、Bluewater 27–31°C。属海湾群岛国家海洋公园（2010 年设立），潜水需付公园费。坐标指向 West End。

summary.zh: 圣马丁西南约 45 公里的火山岛，1987 年起整圈海域划为海洋公园。海岸陡峭无法岸潜，只能跟持牌潜店出海。招牌是火山尖峰，顶部约 24–28 米，常见加勒比礁鲨和护士鲨；冬季水下有时能听到鲸歌。
summary.en: A volcanic island about 45 km southwest of St Maarten, surrounded since 1987 by a marine park. The coast is too steep for shore diving, so every dive goes out with a licensed shop. The signature dives are offshore volcanic pinnacles topping out around 24 to 28 m, where Caribbean reef and nurse sharks are common; in winter, whale song sometimes carries underwater.

highlights.zh: Third Encounter 与 Eye of the Needle 火山尖峰
highlights.en: The Third Encounter and Eye of the Needle pinnacles

highlights.zh: Ladder Bay 一带的沙底有地热温差
highlights.en: Geothermal warm spots in the sand around Ladder Bay

highlights.zh: 岛上设有减压舱
highlights.en: A recompression chamber on the island

notes: 季节：萨巴旅游局与 PADI 都写全年可潜、季节差别只在水温和海况（两页文字相同，PADI 应是转用旅游局文案）；DTW 写 12–5 月旱季最热门、冬季能见度最好，搜索摘要里还有 12 月中–4 月中为旺季的说法。按旅游局取全年。规则：旅游局写海岸太陡、岸潜基本不可能，所有潜水须经持牌潜店；PADI 写禁止岸潜。尖峰深度：DTW 写 Third Encounter 尖峰顶约 28 m、Twilight Zone 约 24 m，Eye of the Needle 在台地外、要游出去；萨巴保护基金会（sabapark）写尖峰从海底升到约 30 m、Eye of the Needle 升到 17 m（同句又写 90 ft，单位矛盾，未采用）。level 取 AOW，因为招牌尖峰都在 24 m 以下；近岸 Ladder Bay、Tent Reef 等适合 OW（DTW 总体写初级到中级）。物种：DTW 写 Third Encounter 最常见加勒比礁鲨、黑边鳍鲨和护士鲨，偶有双髻鲨、公牛鲨、虎鲨、鲸鲨；旅游局写绿海龟与玳瑁都多。sabapark 写的「Black-tip reef sharks, Grey reef sharks」是印太叫法，按加勒比礁鲨理解。sabapark 写 Ladder Bay 一带海底有温差（地热）。萨巴旅游局另有一份潜水宣传册 PDF，页内有「All text and images are fake」占位字样，未作为来源。交通：PADI 写离圣马丁 28 英里，飞机约 12 分钟、渡轮约 90 分钟；岛上有减压舱（PADI）。DTW：约 30 个潜点，全在近岸，海洋公园 1987 年设立。水温 DTW 26–29°C（9–10 月最高、1–3 月最低），旅游局 26–28°C；能见度旅游局至少 20 m，DTW 冬季 25–45 m、夏季 18–30 m。坐标为 Fort Bay 港（DTW：岛上唯一像样的港口）。

summary.zh: 多米尼加以北约 110 公里的海洋哺乳动物保护区，1–4 月座头鲸来此求偶产仔。仅持证船宿可入，禁止水肺，乘小艇浮潜接近母子鲸。
summary.en: Marine mammal sanctuary about 110 km north of the Dominican Republic, where humpback whales gather to mate and calve from January to April. Only licensed liveaboards may operate in season; scuba is banned, so encounters are on snorkel from small tenders, usually with mothers and calves.

highlights.zh: 座头鲸母子
highlights.en: Humpback mothers and calves

highlights.zh: 只能浮潜，禁止水肺
highlights.en: Snorkel only, no scuba

highlights.zh: 仅限持证船宿
highlights.en: Licensed liveaboards only

highlights.zh: 船上观看雄鲸追逐
highlights.en: Competitive male groups watched from the boat

notes: Season Jan–Apr per scubadiverlife and search snippets; some liveaboard pages advertise Jan–Mar only, April is shoulder. Wikipedia's point for the bank is [-69.70, 20.54]; given coords kept (still on the bank). hard-coral used as filler second species (the bank is a coral reef area). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 大巴哈马岛西端外海一片不到十米深的白沙浅滩，运营商在这里投饵几十年，虎鲨会慢悠悠地贴着沙底游到面前，周围是成群的柠檬鲨和礁鲨。10 月到次年 3 月虎鲨最多。
summary.en: A shallow white-sand flat off the west end of Grand Bahama, where operators have baited for decades. Tiger sharks glide in slowly over the sand to within arm's length, with lemon and reef sharks milling around. Tiger numbers peak from October to March.

highlights.zh: 沙地上近距离观察虎鲨
highlights.en: Tiger sharks at arm's length over the sand

highlights.zh: 成群的柠檬鲨与护士鲨
highlights.en: Packs of lemon and nurse sharks

highlights.zh: 12–3 月可搭配比米尼的大锤头鲨
highlights.en: Pair it with Bimini's great hammerheads, December to March

notes: 季节：DIVE Magazine 10–1 月（繁殖季），Dive The World 10–4 月 / 10–5 月，liveaboard.com 12–3 月；取 10–3 月，虎鲨全年都有。6–11 月飓风季。从西端或佛罗里达出发的日船与自由港出发的船宿均可到。DIVE Magazine 把难度定为初级（沙底、无流），故取 OW；Dive The World 认为北线整体偏进阶。types 里没有'沙地'一项，暂归 pelagic。

summary.zh: 浅滩边缘直落深海：普罗维登西亚莱斯西北角和西凯科斯的峭壁顶部只有十几米深，长满海绵，礁鲨和鹰鳐常见。船宿从普罗维登西亚莱斯出发，远至 French Cay；1–4 月在大特克岛一带可浮潜看座头鲸。
summary.en: Around the islands the shallow banks drop straight into the deep. Wall tops at Northwest Point on Providenciales and at West Caicos sit only 11 to 17 m down, covered in sponges and patrolled by reef sharks and eagle rays. Liveaboards leave from Providenciales and reach remote French Cay, and from January to April humpbacks pass Grand Turk and Salt Cay, where snorkel encounters are possible.

highlights.zh: 西凯科斯峭壁：十几米起，往下深逾 1800 米
highlights.en: West Caicos wall: starts at 11 to 17 m and drops past 1,800 m

highlights.zh: 偏远的 French Cay，鲨鱼和鳐常见
highlights.en: Sharks and rays at remote French Cay

highlights.zh: 1–4 月大特克岛与 Salt Cay 外的座头鲸
highlights.en: Humpbacks off Grand Turk and Salt Cay, January to April

notes: 季节：DTW 写全年能见度都好、冬季偶有涌浪；Bluewater 写全年可潜、11–5 月凉爽干燥；PADI 写全年可潜、12–5 月海况最平能见度最好；DAN Alert Diver（2023-08）写 6–11 月飓风季、12–4 月旅游旺季。主流是全年，bestMonths 留空，12–5 月最佳。座头鲸：DAN 写 1 月下旬–4 月上旬经过大特克岛与 Salt Cay 以西的水道、可浮潜同游；DTW 与 Bluewater 写 1–3 月；PADI 写 1–4 月。DTW 另写 2–3 月船宿船转去多米尼加共和国带客看座头鲸，期间本地不跑船宿。墙深：DAN 写西北角墙顶 35–40 ft（约 11–12 m），西凯科斯墙顶 35–55 ft（约 11–17 m）、落差超过 6,000 ft；French Cay 是无人小环礁，从普罗维登西亚莱斯单程 60–90 分钟或坐船宿去。物种：DAN 列加勒比礁鲨、鹰鳐、海龟、护士鲨，并说特克斯一侧礁鲨较少；DTW 写 French Cay 有双髻鲨、公牛鲨、虎鲨、柠檬鲨和交配的护士鲨；Bluewater 写 French Cay 有蝠鲼或鹰鳐。水温：DAN 冬 74–78°F、夏 82–84°F，DTW 26–29°C，取 24–29。能见度：Bluewater 15–45 m，DAN 常超 30 m，取 20–40。等级：DTW 说各级持证都适合。坐标为普罗维登西亚莱斯西北角（Northwest Point）墙区，码头多在 Turtle Cove。

summary.zh: 伯利兹最大、离本土最近的环礁，船程约 1.5 小时。南端 Elbow 墙潜深 18–30 米，多股流交汇，常见鹰鳐群、礁鲨与海龟，适合进阶潜水员。
summary.en: Belize's largest atoll and the closest to the mainland, about 1.5 hours by boat. At the southern tip, The Elbow is an 18–30 m wall where currents converge; eagle ray groups, reef sharks and turtles are common. Best for advanced divers; the dry season (about December–May) usually has the best visibility.

highlights.zh: Elbow 漂流墙潜
highlights.en: The Elbow drift wall

highlights.zh: 鹰鳐群
highlights.en: Eagle ray groups

highlights.zh: 大型柳珊瑚扇
highlights.en: Large gorgonian fans

highlights.zh: 偶见海豚
highlights.en: Occasional dolphins

notes: Cited pages agree on location but give no season; Dec–May (peak visibility Mar–May) comes from search snippets of dive-the-world.com. Coords are atoll centre; The Elbow itself is at the southern tip (~17.17N). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

name.zh: 奥里斯卡尼号航母沉船（彭萨科拉）

summary.zh: 2006 年击沉于彭萨科拉以南约 39 km 的航母，坐直于 64 m 海底。舰岛顶约 21 m，休闲潜水只探舰岛；飞行甲板约 44 m 需技术潜水。船程约 90 分钟。
summary.en: An aircraft carrier scuttled in 2006 about 39 km south of Pensacola, sitting upright in 64 m of water and nicknamed the Great Carrier Reef. The island tops out near 21 m and is the recreational part; the flight deck at about 44 m needs technical training. Boat ride about 90 minutes; summer usually has the calmest Gulf seas.

highlights.zh: 整艘航母人工鱼礁
highlights.en: Whole aircraft carrier as a reef

highlights.zh: 舰岛约 21 m 起
highlights.en: Island from about 21 m

highlights.zh: 深潜 / 技术潜水
highlights.en: Deep and technical diving

notes: Coords match Wikipedia wreck position (34 km offshore; geo check warns 'open sea', expected). Season inferred: summer is operators' high season, fall/winter Gulf seas often rough. Flight deck ~3 m deeper since Hurricane Gustav (2008). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 洪都拉斯海湾群岛最西边的小岛，以便宜的潜水套餐和考证出名。鲸鲨全年都可能遇到，3–4 月最多，常在北面外海出现饵球时现身。岛周有垂直峭壁、海丘和沉船人工礁，3–5 月旱季海况平稳、水最清。
summary.en: The westernmost of Honduras's Bay Islands, known for inexpensive dive packages and courses. Whale sharks can turn up in any month, most often in March and April, usually when bait balls form off the north side. Around the island are vertical walls, seamounts and a wreck sunk as an artificial reef; the March to May dry season brings calm seas and the clearest water.

highlights.zh: 3–4 月鲸鲨最常见
highlights.en: Whale sharks most often seen in March and April

highlights.zh: CJ's Drop-off 的垂直峭壁
highlights.en: The vertical wall at CJ's Drop-off

highlights.zh: Halliburton 沉船人工礁（1998 年沉放）
highlights.en: The Halliburton wreck, sunk as an artificial reef in 1998

notes: 季节：鲸鲨月份说法不一——PADI（洪都拉斯最佳季节文）写全年可见、3–4 月为峰，推荐 4 月；PADI 2019 客座文写 2 月中–4 月与 8–9 月；Dive The World 写 2–4 月与 10–12 月最稳、3–5 月旱季能见度最好且鲸鲨最可靠；搜索摘要里 Scuba Diving 与 Zublu 写 3–5 月（另有 8–10 月），页面未能打开。取 3–5 月（DTW 明写 3–5 月最佳，PADI 写 3–5 月海况平、能见度可达 36 m）；秋季窗口各家不一致，未放进 bestMonths。遇鲸方式：搜索摘要里 Zublu 写只许浮潜，未在已开页面核实，文案没写。DTW：饵球在岛北面形成时鲸鲨出现，北侧海丘 The Pinnacle 春秋常有鲸鲨经过，南侧 Black Hills（底在 40 m 以下）有时流强、限进阶；Halliburton 1998 年沉放作人工礁；CJ's Drop-off 为垂直墙；岛在拉塞瓦西北约 32 km（约 50 分钟）；以便宜的潜水套餐出名。水温：PADI 写 1–4 月 24–27°C、7–9 月最高 29°C，1 月可低到 22°C；DTW 26–29°C。能见度 PADI 18–30 m（旱季可达 36 m）。海龟来源未分种，按加勒比礁区常见的玳瑁列。邻岛罗阿坦已有条目。坐标为东港（Utila Town）。

summary.zh: 尤卡坦半岛的石灰岩下是绵延数百公里的水下溶洞，天坑是它们的天窗。跟有资质的导潜、不离开自然光的洞穴入口区潜水，开放水域证即可参加；看的是光柱、钟乳石和盐跃层，鱼很少。再往里走需要全洞潜训练。
summary.en: Beneath the Yucatán limestone run flooded cave systems hundreds of kilometres long, and the cenotes are their skylights. Guided cavern dives that stay within reach of daylight are open to Open Water divers. The draw is light beams, stalactites and the blurry halocline where fresh water meets salt, not fish; going further in needs full cave training.

highlights.zh: The Pit 与 Dos Ojos 洞口射下的光柱
highlights.en: Light beams through the openings at The Pit and Dos Ojos

highlights.zh: 淡水与咸水交界的盐跃层，像隔着一层晃动的玻璃
highlights.en: The halocline, where fresh water over salt blurs like moving glass

highlights.zh: Angelita 约 30 米处的硫化氢云（需进阶以上资质）
highlights.en: The hydrogen sulphide cloud at about 30 m in Angelita (Advanced Open Water or higher)

highlights.zh: 洞穴入口区限在自然光范围内，每位导潜最多带 4 人
highlights.en: Cavern tours stay in the daylight zone, with at most four divers per guide

notes: 季节：Bluewater 写全年可潜、不受恶劣天气和大雨影响；Mares 写全年可潜、11–4 月旱季最好、5–10 月雨季人少但能见度略降；搜索摘要里 PADI 称 5–9 月光线最好（页面未打开）。两个已开来源都说全年，bestMonths 留空。规则：洞穴入口区（cavern）在自然光可及范围内——Alert Diver（DAN Europe）写离水面直线距离 ≤60 m（部分机构 40 m）、深度 ≤20 m（部分 30 m）、每位导潜最多 4 人、导潜须是潜水长且持洞潜证；DIVE Magazine 写 60 m / 21 m / 4 人、无单人通道；PADI blog 写开放水域证可参加由洞潜机构认证向导带领、沿导引绳的 cavern 导览，超出光区或 60 m 需洞潜证。level 取 OW；The Pit（约 40 m）Mares 要求 AOW + 深潜专长，Angelita（约 30 m 处硫化氢层、底约 60 m）要求 AOW / 技术潜，进入 cave 段属 Tech。Bluewater 称 Gran Cenote 现在只对全洞潜持证者开放水肺（浮潜不受限），出行前确认。Dos Ojos 系统已测绘约 82 km（Alert Diver、DIVE）。水温：Bluewater 23–25°C，Mares 24–26°C。能见度：PADI blog 写 30 m 以上、Chikin Ha 45 m 以上，上限 50 m 为参考值。物种：天坑里鱼很少（Bluewater、DIVE），能看到的是钟乳石和化石，零星有淡水龟（Mares：Gran Cenote、Carwash；PADI：El Eden）和 Bat Cave 的蝙蝠（DIVE）。没有合适的明星动物，所以新增非生物贴纸 stalactite（钟乳石），伯利兹大蓝洞 40 m 处的钟乳石也能用；若不接受非生物条目，删掉后这里显示圆点即可。坐标为 Dos Ojos（Alert Diver 给出 20°19'28.88"N 87°23'31.16"W），在图卢姆与卡门海滩之间，潜店多从这两地出发。中文名：国内潜水圈多说「墨西哥天坑」或「图卢姆天坑」，这里用覆盖范围更准的「尤卡坦天坑群」。

summary.zh: 哥斯达黎加西北角的小岛群，属圣罗莎国家公园，从可可海滩坐船约 1 小时。5–11 月风小，船常去 Big Scare 礁石等公牛鲨。水深约 20–30 米，常有流和温跃层，能见度多变，适合有经验者。
summary.en: Small islands in Santa Rosa National Park, in Costa Rica's far northwest, about an hour by boat from Playas del Coco. Boats run mainly from May to November, when the wind eases, to look for bull sharks around the Big Scare pinnacle. Dives reach 20 to 30 m with current, thermoclines and changeable visibility, so they suit experienced divers.

highlights.zh: Big Scare 礁石边巡游的公牛鲨
highlights.en: Bull sharks cruising the Big Scare pinnacle

highlights.zh: 大洋蝠鲼，偶见成百上千的蝠鲼群
highlights.en: Giant mantas, and at times schools of devil rays in the hundreds

highlights.zh: 11–5 月可改去卡塔利娜群岛看蝠鲼
highlights.en: From November to May, the nearby Catalina Islands are the manta option

notes: 季节：Scuba Diver Life（2017）写公牛鲨 5–11 月到访蝙蝠群岛；当地潜店 scuba-dive-costa-rica 写 5–11 月风浪较小、能见度较好、水更暖，往返要横穿帕帕加约湾，每天出海前看海况；PADI 哥斯达黎加页写 5–11 月雨季营养盐吸引公牛鲨到蝙蝠群岛。三者一致取 5–11 月。搜索摘要里另有运营商说公牛鲨全年都有、6–10 月最多，12–3 月风大常改去卡塔利娜群岛（未打开）。深度：Scuba Diver Life 写 Big Scare 约 70 ft、Black Rock 约 80 ft；潜店写'有时超过 30 m'、属进阶潜水、不建议新手；level 取 AOW。能见度：潜店写 9–30 m、同一潜次内也会变，Scuba Diver Life 遇到的是浑浊；取 8–25。水温：来源只有'5–11 月较暖'的定性说法，另有强温跃层，20–28°C 为估计值。离可可海滩约 30 英里（潜店）、船程约 1 小时（Scuba Diver Life）。附近的卡塔利娜群岛（Islas Catalinas）11–5 月有大洋蝠鲼（Scuba Diver Life），季节与公牛鲨相反，所以没有合并成一条。蝠鲼群与大洋蝠鲼来自潜店页；白顶礁鲨、鹰鳐来自 Scuba Diver Life。群岛属圣罗莎国家公园，coords 来自西语维基。中文名'蝙蝠群岛'为意译；任务里列的卡尼奥岛（Isla del Caño，PADI 写 12–6 月为季）未做，见总备注。

summary.zh: 巴哈半岛东岸的国家公园，1995 年禁渔后鱼量回升数倍，守着加州湾沿岸少有的硬珊瑚礁。黑压压的杰克鱼墙与常驻的公牛鲨是招牌；每天入园船只有限额，要提前预订。
summary.en: A national park on Baja's east coast where fish biomass rebounded several-fold after fishing stopped in 1995, around one of the Gulf of California's few hard-coral reefs. Dense walls of jacks and resident bull sharks are the draw. Boat numbers are capped daily, so book ahead.

highlights.zh: 遮住阳光的杰克鱼风暴
highlights.en: Jack schools thick enough to shade the sun

highlights.zh: El Vencedor 沉船边的公牛鲨
highlights.en: Bull sharks around the El Vencedor wreck

highlights.zh: 12–4 月岸上就能看到座头鲸跃出水面
highlights.en: Humpbacks breaching offshore, December to April

notes: 季节：SSI 8–11 月，Bluewater 8–12 月（10–12 月能见度最佳），Dive The World 公牛鲨 8 月底–12 月最佳；取 8–11 月。1–3 月水温可降至 18°C、浮游生物多，但有座头鲸与蝠鲼。4–6 月能见度最差。距卡波圣卢卡斯约 100–130 公里，最后一段土路；小船从村里海滩出发。

name.zh: 卡波圣卢卡斯（洛斯卡沃斯）

summary.zh: 码头乘船约10分钟到天涯海角海洋公园，常见常驻海狮群与鱼群；戈多浅滩需乘船70–90分钟，尖峰顶约36米，通常只带进阶潜水员，夏秋可见双髻鲨，冬季常见座头鲸。
summary.en: Land's End marine park, about 10 minutes by boat from the marina, has a resident sea lion colony, rocky reefs and schooling fish. Gordo Banks is a deep pinnacle (top around 36 m) 70–90 minutes out, usually for advanced divers only, with scalloped hammerheads in summer–autumn and humpbacks around in winter.

highlights.zh: 天涯海角海狮群
highlights.en: Land's End sea lions

highlights.zh: 戈多浅滩双髻鲨（深潜）
highlights.en: Gordo Banks hammerheads (deep)

highlights.zh: 冬季座头鲸
highlights.en: Winter humpbacks

highlights.zh: 索科罗船宿出发港
highlights.en: Departure port for Socorro liveaboards

notes: Best-month window conflicts across guides (Oct–Nov vs Nov–May vs Sep/Jan); Aug–Nov chosen for warm water, best visibility and Gordo Banks hammerhead season (summer–early fall, not every trip). Los Cabos tourism-board PDF was unreadable (image-only). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 南加州外海的国家公园群岛，从文图拉或圣巴巴拉坐潜水船前往，多为一两天的行程，也有多日船宿。安纳卡帕岛、圣巴巴拉岛和圣克鲁斯岛东段条件较温和，巨藻林里有海狮与港海豹；西边的外岛更冷、风浪更大。
summary.en: A national park archipelago off Southern California, reached by dive boat from Ventura or Santa Barbara on one- or two-day trips, with some longer liveaboard runs. Anacapa, Santa Barbara and eastern Santa Cruz are the gentler islands, with kelp forests, sea lions and harbour seals; the western islands are colder and rougher.

highlights.zh: 离港口最近的安纳卡帕岛巨藻林
highlights.en: Kelp forests at Anacapa, the island closest to port

highlights.zh: 圣巴巴拉岛的海狮繁殖群
highlights.en: The sea lion rookery at Santa Barbara Island

highlights.zh: 安纳卡帕一带可遇到巨型黑鲈
highlights.en: Giant sea bass around Anacapa

highlights.zh: 10 月至次年 1 月常刮强东风，出海看天
highlights.en: Strong easterly Santa Ana winds are common from October to January

notes: 季节：UW Photography Guide 写能见度最好在 7–1 月、9–11 月达到高峰（南部岛屿可到约 24 m），4–6 月浮游生物多、北部岛屿降到约 6 m，7 月中–10 月底水最暖；运营商 Channel Islands Dive Adventures 写安纳卡帕与圣克鲁斯'夏末到冬末'最好、圣米格尔秋季好天气时最好。取两者重叠的 9–11 月。NPS（官网 2017 年更新）提醒 10–1 月常有强东风 / 圣安娜风，风浪通常从西北来、午后变大；岛上没有救生员，潜水须挂潜水旗；适合浮潜潜水的是圣巴巴拉岛、安纳卡帕和圣克鲁斯东段，圣罗莎、圣米格尔风大、不适合新手。水温：NPS 55–70°F（13–21°C），UWPG 称圣米格尔可低至 40 多°F；取 12–21。能见度：运营商写安纳卡帕平均约 12 m、很少低于 3 m、最好约 30 m；取 5–25。交通：除卡特琳娜外只能坐船（UWPG），北部岛屿从文图拉 / 圣巴巴拉出发、南部岛屿从圣佩德罗 / 长滩出发，多数为一两天的行程，部分船有多日航次（UWPG；运营商提到多日船去圣罗莎岛 Johnson Lee）。Painted Cave 禁止潜水（运营商）。物种：海狮、港海豹、巨型黑鲈、garibaldi 见运营商安纳卡帕段；巨型黑鲈、角鲨、蝙蝠鲼、海狮繁殖群见 UWPG。本条指国家公园五岛（安纳卡帕、圣克鲁斯、圣罗莎、圣米格尔、圣巴巴拉），卡特琳娜另列 santa-catalina-island。coords 为安纳卡帕岛（维基）。id 与中文名都加'加州'，以免和英吉利海峡群岛（中文同样叫海峡群岛）混淆。giant-kelp、giant-sea-bass 为新增物种。

summary.zh: 距哥斯达黎加本土 36–40 小时航程的孤岛，只能船宿前往。6–11 月雨季浮游生物多、能见度降低，但海山上的双髻鲨群最密；夜潜时成群白顶礁鲨在礁石间猎食。
summary.en: A lone island 36 to 40 hours' sail from mainland Costa Rica, reachable only by liveaboard. The June to November wet season brings plankton and lower visibility, but also the densest hammerhead schools over the seamounts. On night dives, whitetip reef sharks hunt in packs across the reef.

highlights.zh: Bajo Alcyone 海山上的双髻鲨群
highlights.en: Hammerhead schools over the Bajo Alcyone seamount

highlights.zh: 白顶礁鲨集体猎食的夜潜
highlights.en: Night dives with packs of hunting whitetip reef sharks

highlights.zh: 8–10 月有机会遇到鲸鲨
highlights.en: Whale sharks possible from August to October

notes: 季节：liveaboard.com 与 DIVE Magazine 均以 6–11 月为大货季；Bluewater 认为 5–8 月兼顾大货与海况。12–5 月干季海面平、能见度高但双髻鲨较少。从蓬塔雷纳斯出发 36–40 小时，雨季航程颠簸。多数船宿要求 AOW + 50 潜以上，推荐高氧。

summary.zh: 巴拿马太平洋岸的世界遗产国家公园，2004 年前是监狱岛。从圣卡塔利娜坐船约 1 小时。1–3 月水较清、鲸鲨较常见，3–8 月康特雷拉斯群岛有双髻鲨，7–10 月座头鲸来繁殖。流强、温跃层明显。
summary.en: A World Heritage national park off Panama's Pacific coast, closed to outsiders as a prison island from 1918 to 2004. Boats from Santa Catalina take about an hour. January to March brings clearer water and whale sharks; hammerheads frequent the Contreras Islands from March to August, and humpbacks breed here from July to October. Expect current and sharp thermoclines.

highlights.zh: 1–3 月的鲸鲨
highlights.en: Whale sharks from January to March

highlights.zh: 康特雷拉斯群岛的双髻鲨（3–8 月）
highlights.en: Hammerheads at the Contreras Islands, March to August

highlights.zh: 成群趴在海底休息的白顶礁鲨
highlights.en: Whitetip reef sharks resting in groups on the sea floor

highlights.zh: 7–10 月座头鲸来繁殖
highlights.en: Humpbacks arrive to breed from July to October

notes: 季节：PADI 博客（巴拿马最佳潜水时间）写 1–3 月水清、大货多，鲸鲨高峰 1–3 月，蝠鲼 3–5 月，双髻鲨 4–5 月最好，座头鲸 7–10 月，5–11 月雨季浮游生物多、能见度下降；The Globe and Mail（2024）写 1–3 月为鲨鱼旺季，作者 2 月在海底见到约 10 条白顶礁鲨；PADI 圣卡塔利娜页写全年可潜，干季 12 月中–5 月中，1 月底起上升流带来蝠鲼和鲸鲨，3–8 月康特雷拉斯群岛常见双髻鲨、4–6 月北部有小群。取 1–3 月。座头鲸 7–10 月（Scuba Diver Life、liveaboard.com、PADI 一致）。水温约 20–29°C（PADI），温跃层可降到 16°C（Scuba Diver Life、liveaboard.com），2–4 月温跃层最常见；能见度 10–30 m（PADI）。交通（巴拿马旅游局）：巴拿马城走泛美公路约 4 小时到圣地亚哥（贝拉瓜斯省），再到三个港口之一——圣卡塔利娜（潜店集中）、Pixvae（离岛最近，PADI 写约 20 分钟）、Puerto Mutis；PADI 写圣卡塔利娜坐船约 1 小时，搜索摘要另有约 1.5 小时的说法；liveaboard.com 有从戴维（David）附近出发的船宿。level 取 AOW：Scuba Diver Life 写'最适合有经验的潜水员'，有流、多为放流，个别点也适合新手。公园 1992 年设立、2005 年列入世界遗产、监狱 2004 年关闭（维基；UNESCO 页对 WebFetch 返回 403）；'1918–2004 年禁止外人进入'来自 The Globe and Mail。coords 为科伊巴岛中心（维基），出发港圣卡塔利娜约 [-81.26, 7.63]。中文名：UNESCO 中文名作'柯义巴国家公园'，这里用更常见的'科伊巴'。

summary.zh: 从德雷克湾乘船约45分钟，保护区日潜，常见白鳍礁鲨、海龟、鳐鱼与海鳗，多在18米内；魔鬼礁流强，常见大群鲹鱼。旱季1–4月能见度通常较好。
summary.en: A protected island about 45 minutes by boat from Drake Bay (also reached from Uvita). Two-tank day trips commonly see whitetip reef sharks, turtles, rays and morays at around 18 m; Bajo del Diablo has stronger current and big schools of jacks. Visibility is usually best in the dry season, January–April.

highlights.zh: 船锚点白鳍礁鲨群
highlights.en: Whitetip reef sharks at The Anchor

highlights.zh: 魔鬼礁鲹鱼群
highlights.en: Jack schools at Bajo del Diablo

highlights.zh: 季节性座头鲸
highlights.en: Seasonal humpbacks

notes: Season (dry season Dec/Jan–Apr best visibility, diving year-round) comes from search snippets, not a page read; Uvita departure not checked. Bajo del Diablo rendered as 魔鬼礁. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 达尔文岛与沃尔夫岛只能船宿抵达。6–11 月凉季水温低、流大，双髻鲨成群列队，鲸鲨不时从蓝水中经过；12–5 月水暖海平，蝠鲼更多，潜起来轻松些。
summary.en: Darwin and Wolf are liveaboard-only. In the cool season from June to November the water is cold and the current strong; hammerheads stack up in schools and whale sharks pass through the blue. December to May is warmer and calmer, with more mantas and easier dives.

highlights.zh: 达尔文拱门（现为石柱）下的双髻鲨群
highlights.en: Hammerhead schools below Darwin's Arch, now a pillar

highlights.zh: 7–10 月鲸鲨经过沃尔夫与达尔文
highlights.en: Whale sharks pass Wolf and Darwin from July to October

highlights.zh: 中部岛屿有海狮、企鹅与海鬣蜥同游
highlights.en: Sea lions, penguins and marine iguanas around the central islands

notes: 季节：四个来源一致 6–11 月为大货季（鲸鲨 7–10 月最稳，双髻鲨全年有、凉季群更大）；12–5 月暖季以蝠鲼为主、海况好。水温跨度大（16–28°C），西部岛屿更冷，带头套手套的 5–7 mm。厄尔尼诺年份鲨鱼出现率波动。中部岛屿可岸基日潜，本条以达尔文/沃尔夫船宿为准。

name.zh: 加拉帕戈斯中部跳岛（戈登岩·踢球者岩）
name.en: Galápagos Central Islands (Gordon Rocks & Kicker Rock)

summary.zh: 住圣克鲁斯或圣克里斯托瓦尔岛、每天出船的陆基潜水。戈登岩是火山口，深至约32米、流强，适合有经验者，常见双髻鲨与鹰鳐；踢球者岩常见白鳍礁鲨、海龟与鳐鱼。
summary.en: Land-based day diving from Santa Cruz or San Cristóbal. Gordon Rocks is an eroded crater to about 32 m with strong currents, for experienced divers, where hammerheads, eagle rays and Galápagos sharks are common; Kicker Rock off San Cristóbal has whitetip reef sharks, turtles and rays. December–June is usually warmer and clearer.

highlights.zh: 戈登岩“洗衣机”激流与双髻鲨
highlights.en: Gordon Rocks 'washing machine' current and hammerheads

highlights.zh: 踢球者岩白鳍礁鲨与海龟
highlights.en: Kicker Rock whitetips and turtles

highlights.zh: 北西摩岛适合各级潜水员
highlights.en: North Seymour suits mixed levels

highlights.zh: 无需船宿
highlights.en: No liveaboard needed

notes: Season conflicts: touringgalapagos says Dec–Jun best for hammerheads/mantas, other operators cite Jul–Oct upwelling; diving is year-round. Pin sits on Gordon Rocks; Kicker Rock is ~[-89.51,-0.77]. Zh name uses 踢球者岩 (more common than 踢球岩). · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 哥伦比亚太平洋上的国家公园岛，从布埃纳文图拉乘船约4小时。7–10月座头鲸来繁殖；水下常见白鳍礁鲨、海龟、石斑与章鱼，5–6月有机会见鲸鲨，水深12–33米。
