summary.en: A national-park island (a former prison) off Colombia's Pacific coast, about 4 hours by boat from Buenaventura or 2 hours from Guapi. Humpbacks come to breed from about July to October; dives at 12–33 m commonly show whitetip reef sharks, turtles, groupers and octopus, with whale sharks possible in May–June.

highlights.zh: 7–10月座头鲸
highlights.en: Humpbacks Jul–Oct

highlights.zh: 白鳍礁鲨与海龟
highlights.en: Whitetips and turtles

highlights.zh: 前监狱岛国家公园
highlights.en: Former prison island, now a national park

notes: Hammerheads appear in some guides but neither source read confirms them or gives a season, so not tagged. Pelecanus 2026 note says access is only via authorised liveaboards from Buenaventura (no land-based packages); park bans alcohol and checks bags. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 厄瓜多尔马查利亚国家公园的海岛，从洛佩斯港坐船约 1 小时。8–9 月大洋蝠鲼来此聚集，研究估计该种群超过 2.2 万条；6–9 月途中常见座头鲸。这时水温低至 16°C，能见度有时仅 3–5 米。
summary.en: An island in Ecuador's Machalilla National Park, about an hour by boat from Puerto López. Oceanic mantas gather around it each August and September, from a population researchers estimate at more than 22,000. Humpbacks breed offshore from June to September and are often seen on the crossing. In this season water can drop to 16°C and visibility to 3–5 m.

highlights.zh: 8–9 月的大洋蝠鲼，一天可记录 30–40 条
highlights.en: Oceanic mantas in August and September, sometimes 30–40 logged in a day

highlights.zh: 往返途中看座头鲸母子
highlights.en: Humpback mothers and calves on the boat ride

highlights.zh: 岛周围数量很多的绿海龟
highlights.en: A large population of green turtles

highlights.zh: 岛上的蓝脚鲣鸟
highlights.en: Blue-footed boobies on the island

notes: 季节：Divernet（2022 研究报道）写这一大洋蝠鲼种群每年 8–9 月聚集在拉普拉塔岛周围；Scuba Diver Life（2020）写 7 月底–10 月初最好、高峰期有 50–600 条，座头鲸同期。两者一致取 8–9 月。座头鲸：厄瓜多尔媒体 Vistazo（2025）写观鲸季 6–9 月（洛佩斯港 6 月下旬办观鲸节），Scuba Diver Life 写 7 月底–10 月初。种群：Divernet 报道 Fundación Megafauna Marina del Ecuador、Manta Trust 等 14 年的研究，2005–2018 年照片识别 2,800 多条、估计总数 2.2 万以上，是其他已知亚种群的 10 倍以上；厄瓜多尔 2010 年起禁捕蝠鲼。Divernet 另一篇（2022 旅行团）写'一天记录 30–40 条并不少见'，另有大量绿海龟、偶见翻车鲀。条件：Scuba Diver Life 写流可能很强、适合有放流经验的进阶潜水员（level 取 AOW），6–12 月水温 16–23°C、7–10 月风浪较大且能见度可低至 3–5 m，1–6 月 20–28°C、能见度可达 25 m。交通：离洛佩斯港约 40 km（维基），船程约 1 小时（Scuba Diver Life）。岛属马查利亚国家公园，有蓝脚、红脚、纳斯卡鲣鸟和南美海狮（维基）。别名：Vistazo 写当地叫'小加拉帕戈斯'（Galápagos chiquito），英文常叫'穷人的加拉帕戈斯'，未放进名字。coords 来自维基。

summary.zh: 圣地亚哥北部的海洋保护区。夏秋成群的加州豹纹鲨聚在拉霍亚海滩齐腰深的浅水，多为怀孕母鲨，浮潜就能看到；水肺潜水从海滩下水，旁边的拉霍亚湾有巨藻林、海狮和亮橙色的加州雀鲷。
summary.en: A marine reserve on San Diego's northern coast. From summer into autumn, leopard sharks, mostly pregnant females, gather in waist-deep water off La Jolla Shores, easy to see with mask and snorkel. Scuba divers enter from the beach, and neighbouring La Jolla Cove adds kelp, sea lions and orange garibaldi.

highlights.zh: 8–9 月浅水里成群的豹纹鲨
highlights.en: Leopard sharks massing in the shallows, peaking in August and September

highlights.zh: 拉霍亚湾的巨藻林与海狮
highlights.en: Kelp and sea lions at La Jolla Cove

highlights.zh: 清晨、低潮、风浪小时最容易看到鲨鱼
highlights.en: Sharks are easiest to spot early in the morning at low tide on calm days

notes: 季节：PADI San Diego 页写 7–9 月拉霍亚海滩有大群豹纹鲨（同页说圣地亚哥整体能见度最好在 12–3 月）；Everyday California（当地浮潜 / 皮划艇运营商）写约 6–12 月、8–9 月为高峰，起止随水温变化；San Diego Coastkeeper（2013）写夏季，多为怀孕母鲨（引 Scripps / Birch 水族馆研究者）。取 7–9 月。鲨鱼在 Marine Room 餐厅前、齐腰深的水里（Everyday California、Coastkeeper），浮潜或涉水即可，不需要潜水证；清晨 9 点前、低潮、无风浪时最好（Everyday California）。level 取 OW 只针对水肺潜水：PADI 把拉霍亚海滩列为岸潜点（有峡谷壁），拉霍亚湾为巨藻林岸潜。保护区：Matlahuayl 州立海洋保护区，从 Scripps 码头到拉霍亚湾，禁止带走任何海洋生物（Coastkeeper）；维基另写湾内有数百头加州海狮、garibaldi 很常见。水温 50–70°F（PADI）；能见度为估计值，冬季约 9–15 m，夏季浅水常只有几米。KPBS 2021 年的报道页面抓取为空，未列来源。新增物种 california-leopard-shark（Triakis semifasciata，正式中文名一般作'半带皱唇鲨'，未核实），与现有 leopard-shark（Stegostoma，亚洲叫豹纹鲨）不是同一种；中文名用'加州豹纹鲨'方便看懂。coords 在拉霍亚海滩南端与拉霍亚湾之间（湾为 [-117.27, 32.85]）。

summary.zh: 拉巴斯湾外的洛斯伊斯洛特斯小岛住着数百头海狮，幼崽会追着潜水员咬脚蹼；10–4 月湾内有幼年鲸鲨进食，只允许浮潜。海狮栖息地每年 6–8 月繁殖期关闭。
summary.en: Los Islotes, an islet off La Paz Bay, holds a colony of several hundred California sea lions whose pups chase divers and nibble fins. From October to April juvenile whale sharks feed inside the bay; that encounter is snorkel-only. The sea lion colony closes for breeding from June to August.

highlights.zh: 洛斯伊斯洛特斯的海狮幼崽
highlights.en: Sea lion pups at Los Islotes

highlights.zh: El Mogote 浅滩的鲸鲨浮潜（10–4 月）
highlights.en: Snorkelling with whale sharks off El Mogote, October to April

highlights.zh: Fang Ming 沉船与 El Bajo 海山
highlights.en: The Fang Ming wreck and the El Bajo seamount

notes: 合并了任务里的'拉巴斯海狮'与'巴哈鲸鲨'两项：鲸鲨季以拉巴斯湾为主（Go La Paz 旅游局：10–4 月；PADI：10–5 月），Bluewater 建议初访选 10–12 月（水暖、海狮区开放），Dive The World 把 7–11 月定为加州湾旺季；取 10–12 月。6–8 月海狮繁殖期洛斯伊斯洛特斯关闭（Bluewater：6 月 1 日–8 月 31 日；Dive The World 未提及）。12–5 月水温降至 18–24°C。El Bajo 双髻鲨为 AOW 级别的外海潜点，近年出现率不稳定。

summary.zh: 下加州太平洋岸的大海湾。10–11 月沙丁鱼在湾外聚成饵球，条纹旗鱼轮番冲进鱼群，海狮和海豚也来抢食。从圣卡洛斯港坐小艇出海找饵球，以浮潜为主、很少背气瓶，体力消耗大，每天能否遇到不一定。
summary.en: A large bay on Baja California's Pacific coast. In October and November sardines are packed into bait balls offshore, and striped marlin take turns slashing through them while sea lions and dolphins join in. Pangas from Puerto San Carlos search for the action; encounters are mostly by snorkel rather than scuba, physically demanding, and different every day.

highlights.zh: 条纹旗鱼围猎沙丁鱼饵球
highlights.en: Striped marlin working sardine bait balls

highlights.zh: 海狮、海豚，偶尔还有座头鲸和灰鲭鲨加入
highlights.en: Sea lions, dolphins and at times humpbacks or mako sharks join the feed

highlights.zh: 1–4 月湾内另有灰鲸季
highlights.en: A separate grey whale season inside the bay, January to April

notes: 季节：Dive The World 写看沙丁鱼风暴须在 10–11 月参加专程；DIVE Magazine（2022）写 10–11 月沙丁鱼在外海聚集；Divernet（2025）写 10 月中–12 月为旺季，Gallant Lady 船宿从卡波圣卢卡斯出发、一周一班。取 10–11 月，12 月为肩季。形式：Divernet 与 DIVE 都只写浮潜（从小艇跳下追饵球），Dive The World 写行程以游泳、浮潜为主、只有少量水肺潜水；level 取 OW 只表示门槛最低，实际是开阔海面追鱼群的浮潜，体力要求高。交通：本地小艇从圣卡洛斯港（Puerto San Carlos）出发，饵球多在外海 20–40 英里、单程 1–3 小时（Divernet）；DIVE 写船到湾口约 45 分钟、从卡波机场开车约 5 小时；Divernet 写从拉巴斯开车 3 小时以上；Dive The World 写船宿从圣何塞德尔卡波出发。物种：海狮一直都在（Divernet），海豚、座头鲸，偶有灰鲭鲨、虎鲸（DIVE、Dive The World），丝鲨（Divernet）；灰鲸 1–4 月在湾内（Dive The World）。水温：Dive The World 写 3–5 月最冷约 18.5°C、9 月最暖约 26.5°C，取 18–27。能见度：Dive The World 写 15–30 m、湾内通常较好，Divernet 作者遇到的水不够清，取 8–25。coords 为圣卡洛斯港（维基）。新增物种 striped-marlin（Kajikia audax，正式中文名条纹四鳍旗鱼，俗名红肉旗鱼、黄旗鱼；页面用'条纹旗鱼'）。

summary.zh: 哥伦比亚外海约 500 公里的一块孤岩，从布埃纳文图拉出发要航行 30–40 小时，保护区同一时间只允许一条船。1–5 月干季水冷、浮游生物多，却是双髻鲨成百聚集的时候。
summary.en: A lone rock about 500 km off Colombia, 30 to 40 hours' sail from Buenaventura, with only one boat allowed inside the sanctuary at a time. The January to May dry season brings cold water and plankton, and with them hammerhead schools counted in the hundreds.

highlights.zh: 数百条双髻鲨组成的鲨群
highlights.en: Hammerhead schools in the hundreds

highlights.zh: 5–8 月丝鲨成群，7–10 月有鲸鲨
highlights.en: Silky sharks May to August, whale sharks July to October

highlights.zh: 罕见的小齿锥齿鲨（1–5 月）
highlights.en: Rare smalltooth sand tiger sharks, January to May

notes: 季节有分歧：PADI 与 Diveplanit 都把 1–5 月干季定为双髻鲨季，但干季风浪大、水温 15–20°C（温跃层可到 14°C）、能见度可降至 10 米；6–12 月雨季海况平、水温 26–28°C、能见度 30 米以上，DiveIn 推荐 7–9 月。按'看点优先'取 1–5 月。2018 年起只允许哥伦比亚出发的船进入，长期只有 Ferox 一条船有固定航期。要求 AOW + 50 潜。

summary.zh: 旧金山湾区以南的冷水潜区。蒙特雷防波堤是热门的岸潜和考证点，常见海狮与港海豹；卡梅尔湾的罗伯斯角保护区只许在两处海湾下水、须预约，巨藻林高约 20 米。近年部分区域的巨藻因紫海胆泛滥变稀。
summary.en: Cold-water diving south of the San Francisco Bay Area. The Monterey Breakwater is a busy shore-dive and training site where sea lions and harbour seals are common. In Carmel Bay, the Point Lobos reserve allows diving only from two coves, by reservation, under kelp about 20 m tall. In recent years purple urchins have thinned the kelp in places.

highlights.zh: 罗伯斯角 Whalers Cove 的巨藻林
highlights.en: Kelp forest at Whalers Cove, Point Lobos

highlights.zh: 防波堤岸潜，海狮和港海豹常在身边
highlights.en: Breakwater shore dives with sea lions and harbour seals close by

highlights.zh: 狼鳗、巨型太平洋章鱼和各色海蛞蝓
highlights.en: Wolf eels, giant Pacific octopus and colourful nudibranchs

highlights.zh: 水面巨藻间偶见海獭
highlights.en: Sea otters sometimes resting in the kelp canopy

notes: 季节：PADI Monterey 页写 9–11 月最理想（海况平、能见度改善），6–8 月夏季浮游生物多、能见度下降，12–5 月较冷但巨藻长得旺；California Diving News（Point Pinos 篇）写秋季雾和风基本消失、水温全年最高、能见度最好之一。两者一致取 9–11 月；全年可潜，搜索摘要里也有本地潜店认为冬季风暴间隙能见度最好（未打开、未列来源）。水温：DAN Alert Diver（2014）写 45–55°F（7–13°C），常见 10–15°C；PADI、DAN 都建议干衣或 7 mm 带帽湿衣。能见度：DAN 写内湾差时约 3 m、卡梅尔湾与外湾好时超过 24 m，取 3–20。罗伯斯角州立自然保护区（parks.ca.gov）：只允许在 Whalers Cove 与 Bluefish Cove 潜水，须持证且提前预约；工作日 20 美元、周末 30 美元另加手续费（会变，未写进页面）；官网写巨藻林约 70 英尺高。巨藻衰退：SDI 文章有专节写紫海胆泛滥后巨藻减少；Scuba Diving 2026-10 的报道说 Lovers Point 已无巨藻（scubadiving.com 对 WebFetch 返回 403，未列来源）。海獭（parks.ca.gov、DeeperBlue 2002）多在水面，水下不保证，未列入 species。防波堤（San Carlos Beach）为考证热门点：PADI 写 Breakwater Cove 适合初学者，DeeperBlue 写是常用训练点。coords 为蒙特雷防波堤 / San Carlos Beach；罗伯斯角 Whalers Cove 约 [-121.94, 36.52]。中文名：Point Lobos 中文资料多写'罗伯斯角'，也有'洛沃斯角'。species 首位 giant-kelp 为新增物种。

summary.zh: 从哈迪港乘船约45分钟到赫斯特岛，布朗宁水道激流墙潜，需平潮下水、穿干衣。墙面布满红色软珊瑚和白色海葵，常见狼鳗、巨型太平洋章鱼与海蛞蝓，适合有冷水经验者。
summary.en: God's Pocket on Hurst Island is about 45 minutes by boat from Port Hardy, northern Vancouver Island. Browning Pass walls are dived as drifts at slack tide in a drysuit, covered in red soft corals and plumose anemones, with wolf eels, giant Pacific octopus and nudibranchs. Cold-water and current experience recommended.

highlights.zh: 布朗宁水道软珊瑚墙
highlights.en: Browning Pass soft-coral walls

highlights.zh: 狼鳗洞穴
highlights.en: Wolf eel dens

highlights.zh: 巨型太平洋章鱼
highlights.en: Giant Pacific octopus

highlights.zh: 干衣·平潮漂流
highlights.en: Drysuit, slack-tide drifts

notes: May–Oct season from a Scuba Diving magazine search snippet (page returned 403); resort page gives no dates. A 2026 trip listing says the resort requires ~100 logged dives incl. 50 cold-water/drysuit, plus nitrox; a guest review prefers spring for clarity. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 洛杉矶外海约 35 公里的海岛，从长滩等港口坐渡轮 1–1.5 小时。Casino Point 潜水公园 1962 年起受保护，沿台阶直接走进巨藻林，常见亮橙色的加州雀鲷与海狮；夏季巨型黑鲈在此聚集。
summary.en: An island about 35 km off Los Angeles, 1 to 1.5 hours by ferry from Long Beach, San Pedro or Dana Point. At Casino Point Dive Park in Avalon, protected since 1962, divers walk down steps straight into the kelp among orange garibaldi and sea lions. Giant sea bass gather here in summer.

highlights.zh: 从台阶直接下水的 Casino Point 潜水公园
highlights.en: Casino Point Dive Park, entered by steps from the shore

highlights.zh: 夏季聚集繁殖的巨型黑鲈
highlights.en: Giant sea bass gathering to spawn in summer

highlights.zh: SueJac 帆船残骸，约 18–27 米
highlights.en: The SueJac schooner wreck at about 18–27 m

highlights.zh: 秋冬能见度可超过 24 米
highlights.en: Autumn and winter visibility can top 24 m

notes: 季节：PADI Catalina 页写 5–10 月最好、7–10 月水最暖能见度最好（夏末可到 74°F）；DAN Alert Diver（2020）写'夏末到初冬'条件最好，秋冬能见度超过 80 ft；PADI 博客（洛杉矶五大潜点）写夏末和秋季水最暖、能见度最好。三者重叠取 8–10 月。水温：冬季 55–60°F（PADI），冬季温跃层下约 52°F（DAN），夏季表层约 70–74°F；取 12–23。能见度：Casino Point 常为 30–50 ft、秋季可达 100 ft（PADI），春季约 30 ft（DAN）；取 9–25。交通：渡轮从长滩、圣佩德罗、达纳角出发 1–1.5 小时到阿瓦隆或双港（PADI；DAN 另列纽波特海滩），岛距大陆约 22 英里（DAN）。Casino Point 1962 年设立，PADI 博客称是全美第一个非营利水下公园；周末考证课程多、人挤（PADI 博客）。巨型黑鲈'尤其在夏季成群聚集产卵'（DAN）；搜索摘要里 Scuba Diving 写 4 月到初秋（scubadiving.com 返回 403，未打开）。沉船：SueJac 船尾约 60 ft、船头约 90 ft；园区外的 Valiant 约 110 ft，须港务长许可（DAN）。中文名：通行叫法'卡特琳娜岛'，正式译名'圣卡塔利娜岛'。id 用 santa-catalina-island，避免与多米尼加的卡塔利娜岛（Isla Catalina）及哥斯达黎加的卡塔利娜群岛重名。garibaldi（Hypsypops rubicundus，中文维基名'红尾高欢雀鲷'，没有通行叫法）只在文案里写作'亮橙色的加州雀鲷'，未建物种；若想让卡特琳娜 / 拉霍亚有不同于巨藻的贴纸，可新增它。coords 为 Casino Point（阿瓦隆港北端）。

summary.zh: 从卡波圣卢卡斯出发航行约 24 小时的火山群岛。大洋蝠鲼会主动贴近潜水员盘旋，海豚常来互动；1–4 月座头鲸在此繁育，水下能听到鲸歌。船宿季 11–5 月。
summary.en: Volcanic islands about 24 hours by boat from Cabo San Lucas. Oceanic mantas circle in close to divers and bottlenose dolphins often join the dive; from January to April humpbacks breed here and their song carries underwater. The liveaboard season runs November to May.

highlights.zh: The Boiler 的大洋蝠鲼近距离盘旋
highlights.en: Oceanic mantas circling close at The Boiler

highlights.zh: 1–4 月的座头鲸与水下鲸歌
highlights.en: Humpbacks and their song, January to April

highlights.zh: Roca Partida 岩柱边的鲨鱼与杰克鱼群
highlights.en: Sharks and jack schools around the Roca Partida pinnacle

notes: 季节：liveaboard.com 11–5 月（FAQ 写到 6 月），Nautilus 写到 7 月；7–10 月飓风季多数船停航。座头鲸 1–4 月（一说 1–3 月）。水温 11 月约 28°C，2 月降至约 21°C。能见度随浮游生物与月相波动。多数船要求 AOW + 50 潜。种子里的虎鲨换成了更常见的丝鲨。

summary.zh: 阿尔盖罗西北的卡恰角保护区，涅柔斯洞常被称为地中海最大水下洞穴，入口约 16–32 米，洞壁长满红珊瑚，有石斑和龙虾。进洞随向导，通常需进阶证书。
summary.en: Capo Caccia, in a marine protected area northwest of Alghero, holds Nereo Cave, often called the largest underwater cave in the Mediterranean: entrances from about 16 to 32 m, walls covered in red coral, with groupers, lobsters and morays. Cave dives are guided and usually need Advanced certification; the cliff dives suit Open Water divers.

highlights.zh: 涅柔斯洞：多个入口、拱门与隧道
highlights.en: Nereo Cave: many entrances, arches and tunnels

highlights.zh: 洞壁上的红珊瑚
highlights.en: Red coral on the cave walls

highlights.zh: 阿尔盖罗“珊瑚海岸”
highlights.en: Alghero's Coral Riviera

highlights.zh: 浅水的蓝色隧道
highlights.en: The shallow Blue Tunnel

notes: Neither read source gives a season; May–Oct (summer water 18–24°C) and the Advanced-for-caves rule come from brand-host search snippets, not citable. Wikipedia coords 40.55N 8.15E, 100 m north of Neptune's Grotto; kept given coords (in sea on base map). Cave dimensions disagree across sources (200–350 m main passage); scuba only in zones B and C of the MPA. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 耶罗岛南端的拉雷斯廷加渔村紧挨“平静海”海洋保护区，岛体挡住信风，海面多半平静。区内石斑个头很大，梭鱼、鲹群和魟鱼常见；外侧的埃尔巴洪海山流急，偶有蝠鲼、鲸鲨经过，每年潜水名额有限。
summary.en: La Restinga, a fishing village at El Hierro's southern tip, sits on the La Restinga–Mar de las Calmas marine reserve, where the island shelters the sea from the trade winds. Groupers in the reserve grow large, and barracuda, jacks and rays are common. El Bajón, an offshore pinnacle with stronger currents, sometimes draws mantas or whale sharks, and the number of divers allowed there is capped each year.

highlights.zh: 保护区里的大石斑
highlights.en: Large groupers in the reserve

highlights.zh: 埃尔巴洪：双峰顶约在 6 米和 9 米，岩壁落到百米
highlights.en: El Bajón: twin peaks at about 6 and 9 m, walls dropping to 100 m

highlights.zh: “沙漠”潜点的大片花园鳗
highlights.en: A large garden eel colony at El Desierto

highlights.zh: 拉雷斯廷加港内的夜潜
highlights.en: Night dives in La Restinga harbour

notes: 季节：耶罗岛旅游局（elhierro.travel）与西班牙国家旅游局（Turespaña）都写全年水温 18–25°C、全年可潜，故 bestMonths 留空；DIVER（Divernet，2005 年旧文）建议 2–11 月。没找到蝠鲼 / 鲸鲨的可靠季节，只写'偶有'。能见度：Turespaña'最高 30 m'，旅游局'最高 50 m'，取 20–40。名额：RTVC（2023-11）报道埃尔巴洪每年潜水上限 2,300 人次，2023 年底临时加 700 个名额；保护区由西班牙农渔部管理，潜水需经当地潜水中心申请许可（mapa.gob.es 页面证书错误未能打开，细则未核实）。level 取 OW：港内、Punta Restinga 等多数点 OW 可潜；埃尔巴洪最深 41–50 m（Hello Canary Islands 标'中级'），流急，需进阶经验。物种：乌鳍石斑（Epinephelus marginatus，dusky grouper）为新增，中文名取自词典条目，未见权威分类译名，可改；jack-school 在这里指白鲹（guelly jack）与高体鰤群，barracuda 为大西洋梭鱼。坐标为拉雷斯廷加港。

summary.zh: 英格兰东北诺森伯兰外海，从锡豪西斯港乘船出发。岛上有大型灰海豹群，8–11月幼年海豹最活跃，常凑近潜水员；水温约10–15°C，通常穿干衣，另有多处沉船。
summary.en: Off Northumberland in north-east England, boats leave Seahouses for the Farne Islands and their large grey seal colony. From August to November young seals are most active and often approach divers in shallow water. Water is about 10–15 °C, so drysuits are usual; wrecks and pinnacles add variety. Pups are born in late autumn.

highlights.zh: 好奇的灰海豹
highlights.en: Curious grey seals

highlights.zh: 深秋幼海豹出生
highlights.en: Pups born in late autumn

highlights.zh: 沉船潜（Abessinia 等）
highlights.en: Wrecks such as the Abessinia

notes: Aug–Nov window and 10–15 °C come from search snippets of dive-operator / DeeperBlue pages (403 or brand hosts, not cited). Wikipedia confirms seal colony, wrecks and late-autumn pupping. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

name.zh: 科尔岛与蒂里岛（赫布里底群岛）

summary.zh: 苏格兰内赫布里底群岛科尔岛与蒂里岛之间的冈纳海峡，夏季（约6–9月）姥鲨来此觅食，多从奥本或科尔岛乘小船出海浮潜观察；数量逐年波动大，也常见海豹和海豚。
summary.en: Gunna Sound, the tidal channel between Coll and Tiree in the Inner Hebrides, is a summer feeding hotspot for basking sharks, roughly June–September. Encounters are by snorkel from small boats out of Oban or Coll. Numbers vary greatly between years; seals and dolphins are also common.

highlights.zh: 与姥鲨浮潜
highlights.en: Snorkel with basking sharks

highlights.zh: 潮汐海峡觅食点
highlights.en: Tidal feeding hotspot

highlights.zh: 也有海豹与海豚
highlights.en: Seals and dolphins too

notes: Coords moved from -6.69,56.56 (possibly on Coll's SW tip) into Gunna Sound. Sources say 'summer' without exact months. Tiree Sea Tours via HWDT: 2022 only 7 sharks, 2024 none, 2025 some returned. Snorkel only; basking sharks are UK-protected. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 土耳其南岸潜水小镇，30 多个潜点多在短船程内：C-47（DC-3）飞机残骸、峡谷双墙、古陶罐和水下艺术园。常见石斑、梭鱼；5–10 月开放，9–10 月水暖人少。
summary.en: A small town on Türkiye's south coast with 30-plus sites a short boat ride from the harbour: a C-47 (DC-3) plane wreck at Lighthouse, the Canyon walls from 20 m, ancient amphorae and an underwater art park. Groupers, barracuda and nudibranchs are common. Most centres run May–October; September–October brings warm water and fewer people.

highlights.zh: 灯塔点的 C-47 飞机残骸，适合入门沉船潜
highlights.en: C-47 Dakota at Lighthouse, a good first wreck

highlights.zh: 峡谷：20 米起的两道岩壁
highlights.en: Canyon: twin walls from 20 m

highlights.zh: 浅水古陶罐与吕基亚水下艺术园
highlights.en: Shallow amphorae and the Lycia underwater art park

highlights.zh: 能见度常达 40 米
highlights.en: Visibility often up to 40 m

notes: Single read source (water 20°C May, 28°C Aug, ~16°C Feb–Mar when most centres close; Sep–Oct recommended). Search snippets: the DC-3/C-47 was scuttled in 2009 as an artificial reef, ~26 m upright on sand; one local centre says year-round diving. Uluburun replica not confirmed by the source, left out. SM79 bomber at 55–70 m is technical. Turtles here are mostly loggerheads (not in species list), so no turtle id.

name.zh: 兰萨罗特岛（大西洋水下博物馆）

summary.zh: 兰萨罗特南部拉斯科洛拉达斯湾 12–15 米深处有 300 多座真人大小雕塑，2017 年开放，OW 船潜即可。雕塑间有时能见到扁鲨（天使鲨）和梭鱼，全年可潜。
summary.en: More than 300 life-size sculptures stand at 12–15 m in Las Coloradas Bay off Playa Blanca, southern Lanzarote; the museum officially opened in January 2017. Boat dives from Playa Blanca suit Open Water divers. Angel sharks sometimes rest among the statues, with barracuda and sardine schools around them. Diving runs all year.

highlights.zh: 300 多座真人大小的雕塑
highlights.en: 300+ life-size sculptures

highlights.zh: 12–15 米，OW 可潜
highlights.en: 12–15 m, fine for Open Water

highlights.zh: 沙地上的扁鲨（天使鲨）
highlights.en: Angel sharks on the sand

highlights.zh: 船从普拉亚布兰卡港出发
highlights.en: Boats leave from Playa Blanca port

notes: Artist site: 14 m, 300+ casts, inaugurated Jan 2017, 'rare angel sharks'; operator page: 10–14 m, all levels, year-round ~20°C. No source gives a season for the museum itself; one operator (on a brand host, not cited) calls Oct–Mar angel-shark season at Playa Grande, Puerto del Carmen. Museum entry is ticketed and guided via local centres (not verified). Angel shark is Critically Endangered. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 岛上沉船多可岸潜：南岸 Um El Faroud 是 110 米长的油轮，北端奇尔凯瓦有 P29 巡逻艇和 Rozi 拖船，瓦莱塔港的二战驱逐舰毛利人号仅十几米深。全年可潜，好沉船多在 30 米以下。
summary.en: Malta's coast mixes Second World War wrecks with ships scuttled for divers, most reached from shore. Um El Faroud, a 110 m tanker off Wied iż-Żurrieq, broke in two in the winter of 2005–06; at Ċirkewwa the P29 patrol boat and the tug Rozi sit near 35 m; HMS Maori's bow lies shallow in Valletta. Diving runs all year; most of the better wrecks are below 30 m.

highlights.zh: Um El Faroud 的烟囱与螺旋桨
highlights.en: The funnel and propeller of Um El Faroud

highlights.zh: 奇尔凯瓦岸潜：P29、Rozi 和水下拱门
highlights.en: Ċirkewwa shore dives: P29, Rozi and an underwater arch

highlights.zh: 二战布伦海姆轰炸机残骸（船潜，约 42 米）
highlights.en: A WWII Blenheim bomber (boat dive, about 42 m)

highlights.zh: 毛利人号附近找海马
highlights.en: Seahorses around HMS Maori

notes: 季节：DIVE Magazine（2022）与 Scuba Diver / Divernet（2026）都说全年可潜，故 bestMonths 留空；但对'哪季最好'说法相反——Divernet 称 5–10 月水最暖、能见度最好，DIVE 称冬春能见度最好、夏秋水暖但能见度稍差。水温：DIVE 写冬春约 18°C、夏秋浅水约 25°C，Divernet 写旺季最高 28°C，搜索所见其他资料冬季 14–16°C，取 15–27；11–5 月多需半干或干衣。深度：Um El Faroud 最深 34 m（DIVE）至 36–40 m（其他资料），P29 37 m、Rozi 34 m、Imperial Eagle 42 m、Blenheim 42 m（仅船潜）、HMS Maori 12–16 m（OW 可潜）。level 取 AOW：DIVE 称除毛利人号和两艘拖船外，好沉船大多超过 30 m；Divernet 称 P29、Karwela 用高氧才有足够底时。范围：本条只写马耳他本岛；戈佐 / 科米诺的 Karwela、Xlendi、Cominoland、P31 可以以后单列 gozo。坐标为奇尔凯瓦（P29 / Rozi 岸潜点），Um El Faroud 在南岸 Wied iż-Żurrieq（约 14.45, 35.82）。Visit Malta 有'Heritage Malta Wreck Sites'分类（历史沉船），访问规则未核实。物种：DIVE 说马耳他礁区生物'平平'，Imperial Eagle 有石斑、偶见梭鱼；Divernet 列出梭鱼、石斑、章鱼、海鳗、海蛞蝓、海马（毛利人号）等。dusky-grouper 为本批新增（见 el-hierro）。中文名'毛利人号'为 HMS Maori 意译，Um El Faroud 无通行中文名，保留英文。

name.zh: 梅德斯群岛（埃斯塔蒂特）

summary.zh: 埃斯塔蒂特镇外不到 1 海里的七座小岛，1983 年起受保护，禁渔禁锚，每日限额并须经潜水中心申请。大石斑不怕人，隧道、洞穴和柳珊瑚墙多，6–9 月通常最好。
summary.en: Seven islets less than a mile off L'Estartit, protected since 1983: no fishing or anchoring, a daily diver quota and permits through local dive centres. Large, approachable dusky groupers, tunnels, caves and gorgonian walls; barracuda are common, with eagle rays and sunfish in season. June–September is usually best.

highlights.zh: 不怕人的大石斑
highlights.en: Large, approachable dusky groupers

highlights.zh: 拉瓦卡隧道与多菲洞穴
highlights.en: La Vaca tunnel and the Dofí caves

highlights.zh: 神石（Pedra de Déu）的柳珊瑚墙
highlights.en: Gorgonian walls at Pedra de Déu

highlights.zh: 每日限额，旺季提前预约
highlights.en: Daily quota, book ahead in summer

notes: Season (Jun–Sep, Sept best) only from Divernet; Wikipedia gives location/rules but no season (a brand-host page said May–Oct, not citable). Eagle rays here are common eagle ray Myliobatis aquila, not the list's spotted eagle ray, so eagle-ray id left out. Red coral not confirmed by either source, so not tagged. Reggio Messina wreck ~32 m nearby. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 圣弗鲁图奥索湾东侧 17 米深处的青铜基督像，1954 年安放，浮潜也能看到。周边波托菲诺海洋保护区的岩壁深处多红柳珊瑚和红珊瑚，石斑、梭鱼常见，5–6 月偶有翻车鲀。
summary.en: A bronze Christ statue, placed in 1954, stands at 17 m on the east side of San Fruttuoso Bay and can be seen while snorkelling. Around it, the Portofino marine protected area has walls with red gorgonians and red coral deeper down; groupers and barracuda are common and sunfish sometimes appear in May–June. Boats use fixed moorings.

highlights.zh: 17 米深的基督像，双手约在 10 米
highlights.en: Statue at 17 m, hands at about 10 m

highlights.zh: 岩壁深处的红柳珊瑚
highlights.en: Red gorgonians on the deeper walls

highlights.zh: 5–6 月偶见翻车鲀
highlights.en: Sunfish sometimes in May–June

highlights.zh: 基阿帕角：32 米起的红珊瑚岩壁
highlights.en: Punta Chiappa: red coral from 32 m

notes: Neither read source names a best season; Jun–Oct came from a TripBase search snippet, May added for divingaway's May–June sunfish note. Water ~13°C winter / 24°C summer, thermocline 20–25 m. divingaway puts Paramuricea clavata at 45–55 m on some sites and Corallium rubrum ~70 m, so the deep walls are not beginner dives; statue itself is easy. Zone A (Cala dell'Oro) closed to diving. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

name.zh: 爱丽丝公主浅滩（亚速尔）

summary.zh: 亚速尔群岛皮库岛西南约 90 公里的海山，山顶在水下约 30 米。夏季褐背蝠鲼成群聚集，通常十来只，多时数十只，偶见大洋蝠鲼。单程船程约 3 小时，流大，船家要求进阶证和 30–50 次潜水记录。
summary.en: A seamount about 90 km southwest of Pico in the Azores, its summit around 30 m down. In summer sicklefin devil rays gather here, usually around a dozen and sometimes several dozen, with the odd giant manta or Galápagos shark. The boat ride takes about three hours each way, currents can be strong, and operators ask for Advanced Open Water plus 30–50 logged dives.

highlights.zh: 抓着下潜绳，看褐背蝠鲼成群游过
highlights.en: Hang on the descent line as groups of devil rays pass

highlights.zh: 蓝水里偶遇大洋蝠鲼、加拉帕戈斯鲨和金枪鱼
highlights.en: Chance of giant mantas, Galápagos sharks and tuna in the blue

highlights.zh: 往返途中常有海豚伴船
highlights.en: Dolphins often escort the boat on the crossing

highlights.zh: 一日两潜，船上吃午餐
highlights.en: Two dives on a full-day trip, lunch on board

notes: 季节：两家运营商一致——CW Azores（皮库岛马达莱纳出发）称 7 月初至 9 月底、成功率近 100%；DiveAzores（法亚尔岛奥尔塔出发）称 7–9 月，故 bestMonths 取 7–9。DIVER（Divernet 2019）、Save Our Seas（2017）和 IUCN ISRA 情况表（2025）称蝠鲼 6 月到、10 月底离开（怀孕雌鲼 6–10 月），6 月与 10 月算肩季。数量：ISRA 照片识别统计平均 7–15 只、最多 45 只；运营商宣传 20–40 只，summary 按 ISRA 写。门槛：官方潜点页（Visit Azores）写 AOW、平均 35 m、最深 60 m、流中到强；CW 要求 AOW + 50 次 + 18 岁 + check dive，DiveAzores 要求 AOW + 30 次 + check dive。水温 20–24°C 取自两家运营商；能见度官方'最高 40 m'，CW 15–30+ m。物种：褐背蝠鲼（Mobula tarapacana，搜索所见 FAO AGROVOC 中文名）为新增；大洋蝠鲼、加拉帕戈斯鲨、杰克鱼（almaco jack / Seriola）均见于官方潜点页，CW 也列 jacks / tunas / barracudas。保护：浅滩已纳入亚速尔海洋保护区网络 RAMPA（据搜索摘要为 Decreto Legislativo Regional 14/2024/A，2026 年仍有修订），DiveAzores 页面称 2025 年起为全保护区，运营商仍在带潜，具体规则未能从官方页面核实（portal.azores.gov.pt 返回 403）。坐标：按 ISRA 给出的'皮库岛西南 92.6 km、法亚尔岛西南 83.3 km'推算，精度约 ±15 km；维基百科坐标 37°55′N 31°30′W 与这两个距离矛盾，未采用。中文名'爱丽丝公主浅滩'沿用中文潜水资料里的译法，括号补'亚速尔'便于搜索。

summary.zh: 萨尔岛南端圣玛丽亚是潜水基地，全年可潜，水温约22–27°C。鲨鱼湾涉水及膝可见幼年柠檬鲨；潜点有沉船与洞穴，常见护士鲨、魟和绿海龟，2–4月偶见座头鲸。
summary.en: Santa Maria in southern Sal is the dive base; diving runs all year with water around 22–27 °C. At Shark Bay you wade knee-deep among juvenile lemon sharks. Boat dives cover wrecks (10–28 m) and caves such as Buracona, with nurse sharks, stingrays and green turtles; humpbacks pass February–April.

highlights.zh: 鲨鱼湾涉水看幼年柠檬鲨
highlights.en: Wade with baby lemon sharks at Shark Bay

highlights.zh: 沉船与洞穴潜
highlights.en: Wrecks and caves (Santo Antão, Buracona)

highlights.zh: 2–4月座头鲸经过
highlights.en: Humpbacks pass Feb–Apr

notes: Shark Bay (Feijoal/Parda, east coast) is a wade/snorkel nursery, not a scuba site; some guides feed the sharks. Year-round season from one 2015 blog only. Loggerheads nest on beaches Jul–Oct. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 北岸外约 35 分钟船程的安布罗西奥礁 6–10 月常见成群褐背蝠鲼，部分年份 7–8 月有鲸鲨；东北 40 多公里的福尔米加什礁流急、需进阶，有不怕人的石斑和蝠鲼。
summary.en: Ambrósio, an offshore reef about 35 minutes by RIB off Santa Maria's north coast, draws groups of sicklefin and spinetail devil rays from about June to October, with whale sharks in some summers, mostly July–August. Formigas and Dollabarat, 40-plus km northeast, have tame groupers, mantas and strong currents; Advanced certification is required.

highlights.zh: 安布罗西奥：成群蝠鲼在蓝水里盘旋
highlights.en: Ambrósio: devil rays circling in the blue

highlights.zh: 部分夏季有鲸鲨
highlights.en: Whale sharks in some summers

highlights.zh: 福尔米加什：不怕人的大石斑
highlights.en: Formigas: tame groupers

highlights.zh: 多拉巴拉特海山，能见度高
highlights.en: Dollabarat seamount, very clear water

notes: X-Ray Mag: mobulas Jun–Oct, whale sharks Jul–Aug, operators call Jul–early Sep peak. Azores Getaways: Ambrósio ~5 km off, whale sharks Jun–Sep, pelagic peak Jul–Oct. bestMonths = Jul–Sep overlap. Whale sharks are not annual. Formigas/Dollabarat (~43 km NE) is a separate, current-swept day trip. Mobulas are sicklefin (褐背蝠鲼) plus spinetail devil rays. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 1919 年德国公海舰队在奥克尼锚地自沉，剩下 3 艘战列舰倒扣在 35–45 米，4 艘轻巡洋舰侧卧在 25–35 米。能见度多不足 10 米，需干衣；2025 年起为历史海洋保护区，禁止带走物品。
summary.en: In 1919 the interned German High Seas Fleet scuttled itself in this Orkney anchorage. After decades of salvage, three battleships and four light cruisers remain: the cruisers lie on their sides at 25–35 m, the upturned battleships at 35–45 m. Water is cold and visibility often under 10 m, so drysuits are standard. Since November 2025 the wrecks are a Historic Marine Protected Area; removing anything is an offence.

highlights.zh: 侧卧的轻巡洋舰，沿甲板高度游览
highlights.en: Light cruisers lying on their sides, explored at deck level

highlights.zh: 倒扣的战列舰，巨炮从残骸中伸出
highlights.en: Upturned battleships with big guns jutting from the wreckage

highlights.zh: 伯拉海峡的浅水阻塞船，平潮时下水
highlights.en: Shallow blockships in Burra Sound, dived at slack water

highlights.zh: 船体上成片的羽状海葵与海蛞蝓
highlights.en: Plumose anemones and sea slugs covering the hulls

notes: 未核实原因：明确写季节且能打开的只有 PADI Orkney 页（最佳 4–10 月，'传统上 4 月到 11 月初'）；奥克尼旅游局 orkney.com 的潜水页（搜索摘要：复活节到 11 月初、9 月中水温约 13°C、秋季浮游生物消退后能见度变好）对 WebFetch 返回 403，未能打开；Divernet 2017 factfile 反而说约 10 条潜水船全年运营。按旅游局 / PADI 取 4–10 月；Undercurrent 读者报告（2013）写 4–9 月，未列为来源。深度：Divernet 称巡洋舰 25–35 m（Karlsruhe 最深 27 m）、战列舰 35–45 m，全部 <46 m。level 取 AOW：Divernet 2022 称主沉船需 AOW + 干衣 + 深潜专长、高氧推荐，OW 可潜其他点（丘吉尔屏障的阻塞船岸潜很浅，伯拉海峡阻塞船须平潮）。能见度：Divernet 3–10 m / 3–9 m，factfile 平均 10–15 m；春季与初秋藻华时可低于 5 m（scapaflowwrecks）。HMS Royal Oak 与 HMS Vanguard 是战争坟墓，禁止潜水。保护：苏格兰政府 2025-11-01 起设斯卡帕湾历史海洋保护区（X-Ray Mag；DIVE Magazine 2025-08 报道公告），移走、改动、扰动沉船属刑事犯罪，可以观赏潜水。物种：scapaflowwrecks 记录灰海豹与港海豹偶尔造访沉船，Stromness Museum 记录 Dresden 等沉船上的海蛞蝓（Jorunna tomentosa、海柠檬等）；seal 为新增物种。坐标指向德国舰队沉船区（Cava 以东、Barrel of Butter 附近），出发港为 Stromness（约 -3.30, 58.96）。

summary.zh: 维斯岛海域沉船多：约 30 米的特蒂号货船适合休闲潜水，瓦西利奥斯号船头较浅，72 米的 B-17 轰炸机只限技术潜。岩壁长满红柳珊瑚，缝隙有红珊瑚；潜季约 5–10 月。
summary.en: Vis has wrecks for every level: the steamship Teti at about 30 m for recreational divers, the Greek steamer Vassilios T. with a shallow bow and a stern at 53 m, and a B-17 bomber at 72 m for technical divers only. Walls carry red gorgonians, with red coral in crevices. Dive centres run roughly May–October.

highlights.zh: 特蒂号沉船（约 30 米）
highlights.en: Teti wreck at about 30 m

highlights.zh: 72 米的 B-17 轰炸机（技术潜）
highlights.en: B-17 bomber at 72 m (technical)

highlights.zh: 岩壁上的红柳珊瑚
highlights.en: Red gorgonian walls

highlights.zh: 比舍沃蓝洞，上午 10–12 点光线最好
highlights.en: Biševo Blue Cave, best light 10:00–12:00

notes: DAN: season mid-Apr–mid-Oct, surface 20–28°C with cold upwellings at depth, recompression chamber in Komiža; B-24 'Tulsamerican' at 37–52 m also off Vis. cursosdebuceo: centres open May–Oct, September best. Blue Cave is visited by boat on Biševo (~5 km SW); diving inside not confirmed. Coords are Komiža. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 希腊爱奥尼亚海南部拉加纳斯湾是国家海洋公园，红海龟5–8月上岸产卵，湾内浅水常见。从凯里港乘船可到十余个潜点，有洞穴、拱门和岩壁，深度约5–40米。
summary.en: Laganas Bay on Zakynthos' south coast is a national marine park where loggerhead turtles nest May–August and are often seen in the shallows. Boats from Keri harbour reach about a dozen sites with caves, arches and walls at roughly 5–40 m. The usual dive season runs late spring to autumn.

highlights.zh: 红海龟产卵湾
highlights.en: Loggerhead nesting bay

highlights.zh: 凯里洞穴与拱门
highlights.en: Keri caves and arches

highlights.zh: 海洋公园禁渔区
highlights.en: No-fishing marine park zones

notes: Nesting May–Aug from Wikipedia; dive season months are an estimate (no operator calendar found). dusky-grouper is a typical Med reef fish here, not confirmed by the sources read. Boating ban off nesting beaches. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

name.zh: 泽诺比亚号沉船（拉纳卡）

summary.zh: 1980 年沉没的滚装渡轮，侧卧在拉纳卡港外约 1.5 公里、42 米深的海底，货舱里还有卡车。船身最浅约 16 米，OW 可潜外侧，进舱需进阶或技术训练。常见石斑、梭鱼。
summary.en: A ro-ro ferry that sank in 1980 about 1.5 km off Larnaca and lies on her port side at 42 m, with trucks still in the holds. The shallow side at about 16 m suits Open Water divers; the deeper decks and penetration need advanced or technical training. Groupers and barracuda are common.

highlights.zh: 货舱与海底散落的卡车
highlights.en: Trucks in the holds and on the seabed

highlights.zh: 16 米船舷起潜，最深 42 米
highlights.en: From the hull at 16 m down to 42 m

highlights.zh: 常见石斑与梭鱼
highlights.en: Groupers and barracuda are common

notes: Season read only on cyprus-villa-retreats (Apr–Nov, 22–30°C); search snippets from scubadiving.com (May–Dec) and divetip (Jun–Oct recommended) could not be fetched (403/500), so bestMonths = overlap May–Nov. Wikipedia: sank 7 Jun 1980, ~1.5 km off shore, 42 m, port side. Coords match the wreck, but on the simplified base map [33.66,34.9] falls on land; [33.67,34.9] renders in the sea if the marker looks wrong. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 伊尔库茨克约 70 km 外的利斯特维扬卡是常用基地，另有吉普车穿冰面去奥利洪岛的行程。冰潜多在 2–4 月，冰下 10–15 m，能见度常超 40 m，水温约 1°C，可见贝加尔海豹与特有海绵；需干衣与冰潜训练。
summary.en: Listvyanka, about 70 km from Irkutsk, is the usual base; winter jeep trips also cross the frozen lake to Olkhon Island. Ice dives run mainly February–April at 10–15 m under the ice, often with 40 m+ visibility in water around 1°C. Baikal seals, endemic sponges and amphipods live here. Drysuit and ice-diving training required.

highlights.zh: 世界最深的淡水湖，冰下能见度常超 40 m
highlights.en: The world's deepest lake, often 40 m+ visibility under the ice

highlights.zh: 特有的贝加尔海豹（2–3 月产仔）
highlights.en: Endemic Baikal seals, which pup in February–March

highlights.zh: 淡水海绵群落与特有端足类
highlights.en: Freshwater sponge colonies and endemic amphipods

highlights.zh: 吉普车穿越冰面去奥利洪岛
highlights.en: Jeep trips across the ice to Olkhon Island

notes: Only uw360 read (divesitedirectory.co.uk did not resolve). uw360: best ice months Mar–Apr, jeep safari Feb–Mar, visibility 40–45 m Jan–mid-Mar dropping to ~10 m late March. It also says the Listvyanka dive is open water (Angara outflow stays ice-free) and the under-ice dives are at Olkhon / Cape Khoboy (~300 km from Irkutsk). Coords kept at Listvyanka as the gateway; consider moving to Olkhon (~[107.35, 53.2]). Baikal seal (nerpa) mapped to generic 'seal'. Russia visa required.

summary.zh: 辛格维利尔国家公园的淡水裂缝，夹在北美与欧亚板块之间。冰川融水经熔岩过滤数十年，水温常年 2–4°C，能见度近百米。潜水需开放水域证加干衣证或近两年 10 次干衣潜水，限深 18 米；不持证可浮潜。
summary.en: A freshwater fissure in Þingvellir National Park, in the rift between the North American and Eurasian plates. Meltwater from the Langjökull glacier filters through lava for decades before rising here at 2–4°C all year, with visibility around 100 m. Divers need Open Water plus a drysuit certificate or 10 logged drysuit dives in the past two years; the depth limit is 18 m. Snorkellers need no certification.

highlights.zh: 在北美与欧亚板块之间的裂缝里潜水
highlights.en: Dive in the rift between the North American and Eurasian plates

highlights.zh: 大裂缝、大厅、大教堂三段深峡
highlights.en: The deep Big Crack, Hall and Cathedral sections

highlights.zh: 浅湖段亮绿色的“巨魔头发”藻，一眼望出约百米
highlights.en: Bright green 'troll hair' algae in the shallow Lagoon, with about 100 m of view

highlights.zh: 8–9 月偶见北极红点鲑
highlights.en: Arctic char sometimes pass through in August and September

notes: 季节：运营商 DIVE.IS 与 Guide to Iceland 都说全年开放、水温不随季节变，bestMonths 留空；冬季（约 11–3 月）只剩丝浮拉和 Davíðsgjá 可潜，水面严寒、路上可能结冰，夏季人多。规则来自辛格维利尔国家公园官网：开放水域同级证 + 干衣证，或近两年 10 次干衣潜水并由教练书面确认；限深 18 m；禁止进洞 / 顶部封闭环境；必须结伴；干衣必穿，浮潜可穿厚湿衣。DIVE.IS 另写：最低 17 岁，导潜比 3:1、浮潜 6:1，公园费每人 1,500 ISK，不允许穿湿衣水肺潜水。能见度：DIVE.IS 说'超过 100 m'，Guide to Iceland 说'约 100 m'，保留种子值 70–100。冰川名：朗格冰川（Langjökull），融水在熔岩中渗流 30–100 年（DIVE.IS）。物种：丝浮拉看的是地形，不是动物；唯一可能见到的鱼是北极红点鲑（DIVE.IS：8–9 月繁殖季进出裂缝，矮型红点鲑常年躲在暗处，很少见到），新增 arctic-char 只是为了让这条记录有贴纸，若宁可显示圆点可删掉；特有的端足类 Crymostygius thingvallensis 太小，不适合做贴纸。中文名沿用种子'丝浮拉裂缝'，台湾资料也写'史费拉'。level 取 OW（另需干衣资质）。

name.zh: 舍尔维于（特罗姆瑟以北）

summary.zh: 冬季大批鲱鱼游进特罗姆瑟以北舍尔维于一带的峡湾越冬，虎鲸和座头鲸跟着进来觅食。游客穿干衣从小艇下水浮潜，不背气瓶，水温约 4–7°C。极夜期间每天只有几小时天光，风浪大时可能只能在船上观鲸。
summary.en: Each winter, herring move into the fjords around Skjervøy, north of Tromsø, to overwinter, and orcas and humpback whales follow them in to feed. Guests snorkel from small boats in drysuits, without scuba, in water around 4–7°C. During the polar night there are only a few hours of usable light, and rough seas can turn a snorkel trip into whale watching from the deck.

highlights.zh: 水面上看虎鲸合作围捕鲱鱼
highlights.en: Watch orcas herd herring together from the surface

highlights.zh: 座头鲸张大嘴冲进鲱鱼群
highlights.en: Humpbacks lunging through the herring

highlights.zh: 极夜正午短暂的蓝色天光
highlights.en: The brief blue midday twilight of the polar night

highlights.zh: 干衣和浮潜装备由船家提供
highlights.en: Drysuits and snorkel gear supplied by operators

notes: 季节：运营商 Whalesafari（舍尔维于港出发）写 10 月中至 1 月底；DAN Alert Diver（2026-06）写 10–1 月；Bluewater 写 10 月底至 1 月中；Visit Tromsø（旅游局）据搜索摘要为 11–1 月，但 visittromso.no 全站对 WebFetch 返回 403，未能打开。四方重叠且旅游局口径为 11–1 月，故 bestMonths 取 11、12、1，10 月中下旬算肩季。地点会变：鲱鱼越冬地 1990 年代在 Tysfjord，2014–2017 在 Andfjord，约 2018 年起在舍尔维于 / Kvænangen 峡湾（DAN），以后可能再移，每季出发前要确认。监管（以下均来自搜索摘要，原页未能打开）：挪威 2019 年《hvalsafari 条例》禁止干扰鲸，要求游泳 / 潜水在离渔船和渔具 0.4 海里以外，没有执照或船数限制；IWC 观鲸手册称 Visit Tromsø 准则不鼓励与鲸同游；2026-05 有观鲸业者对话会讨论加强规范。DAN（已打开）也说自律还是立法仍无定论，正有研究评估浮潜者是否干扰虎鲸。这里只有浮潜、不背气瓶，也不要求潜水证；level 取最低档 OW 只是因为字段没有'浮潜'选项，UI 可考虑注明。Whalesafari 最低 15 岁、单次约 2.5 小时，天气差时只能观鲸。水温：DAN 写 10 月底约 6°C、12 月约 5°C，Bluewater 写 4–6°C，取 4–7。能见度：没找到舍尔维于专门的数据，Bluewater 给挪威整体 9–24 m，加上冬季光线很暗，取 5–20 作估计。交通：Bluewater 写从特罗姆瑟坐巴士约 5 小时，并有从舍尔维于出发的 3 / 6 天船宿；搜索摘要另见'约 160 km、4–5 小时车程'和从特罗姆瑟出发的快船一日游（未核实）。中文名：Skjervøy 没有通行中文译名，按挪威语读音音译为'舍尔维于'，括号加'特罗姆瑟以北'便于搜索。坐标为舍尔维于港。

summary.zh: 冰岛北部埃亚峡湾中段，近阿克雷里，从耶尔泰里乘船。热泉烟囱从约 65 m 海底升到水下 15 m，喷出约 72°C 的淡水，可感到暖流，鳕鱼绕锥游动。热门季节 5–9 月，海流可能较强，适合进阶潜水员。
summary.en: In mid-Eyjafjörður near Akureyri, reached by boat from Hjalteyri. A hydrothermal chimney rises from about 65 m to within 15 m of the surface and vents fresh water at around 72°C; divers can feel the warm flow, and cod circle the cone. May–September is the popular season. Currents can be strong, so it suits advanced divers.

highlights.zh: 休闲深度可达的海底热泉烟囱
highlights.en: A sea-floor hydrothermal chimney within recreational depth

highlights.zh: 可感到烟囱喷出的暖水
highlights.en: Feel warm water flowing from the vents

highlights.zh: 冰岛第一个水下保护区（2001 年）
highlights.en: Iceland's first underwater protected area (2001)

highlights.zh: 附近的小斯特吕坦（最深 25 m）生物更密
highlights.en: Little Strýtan nearby (max 25 m) is dense with marine life

notes: Location agrees in both sources; season only from DAN (May–Sep most popular, cancellations for rough seas any time, author dove in October; likely diveable year-round). Depth figures differ: dive.is 70 m base / 55 m tall, DAN 65 m bottom. dive.is calls it limestone; research describes smectite clay. Operator: Strytan Divecenter, Hjalteyri. Wolffish are at nearby Arnarnesstrýtur, not Strýtan. Added species atlantic-cod. Dropped '（冰岛）' from zh name since country is shown separately. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 挪威北极群岛，探险船 7–8 月从朗伊尔城出发，少数潜水员乘冲锋艇在冰川、鸟崖和浮冰旁下水。水温约 0–3°C，冰川口较浑；海象常在附近，海象或北极熊靠近时需回船。需干衣经验。
summary.en: Norway's Arctic archipelago. Expedition ships leave Longyearbyen in July–August, and a small dive group enters from Zodiacs near glaciers, bird cliffs and drifting ice. Water is about 0–3°C and murky near glacier fronts. Walruses are often nearby; divers are recalled if walruses or a polar bear come close. Drysuit experience needed.

highlights.zh: 海象在附近游动或上岸
highlights.en: Walruses swimming nearby or hauled out on beaches

highlights.zh: 浮冰下的磷虾群
highlights.en: Krill clouds beneath drifting ice

highlights.zh: 北纬 80° 的七岛等极北潜点
highlights.en: Far-north sites such as the Seven Islands at 80°N

highlights.zh: 海带床里的杜父鱼与北极鳕
highlights.en: Sculpins and polar cod in kelp beds

notes: Diving is an add-on on expedition ships (Bluewater trip on m/v Plancius, 8–17 Aug 2024, 8 divers of 110 guests) or private sailboats (DAN 2015 account, summer). Polar bear watch / armed guide required outside Longyearbyen. Coords sit in Isfjorden off Longyearbyen; actual dive sites spread across the archipelago (Phippsøya, Alkefjellet, Nordaustlandet). Visibility 1.5–9 m near glaciers. Added species walrus.

name.zh: 托伯莫里（五英寻国家海洋公园）

summary.zh: 安大略省布鲁斯半岛北端，五英寻国家海洋公园有 20 多艘沉船。大塔布港的浅水沉船在 5–7 m，阿拉伯号约 36 m 属进阶。潜季常为 5–10 月，深处水温约 4°C；下水前须到公园游客中心登记。
summary.en: At the tip of Ontario's Bruce Peninsula, Fathom Five National Marine Park holds over 20 wrecks. Big Tub Harbour's schooner Sweepstakes and the City of Grand Rapids lie at 5–7 m; the Arabia, at about 36 m, is an advanced dive. The season runs May–October, with water near 4°C at depth. Register at the park visitor centre first.

highlights.zh: 1867 年的纵帆船 Sweepstakes，水深约 7 m
highlights.en: The 1867 schooner Sweepstakes in about 7 m

highlights.zh: 冷淡水保存完好的 19 世纪木船
highlights.en: 19th-century wooden ships preserved in cold fresh water

highlights.zh: 灯塔角的尼亚加拉陡崖岩壁（23 m）
highlights.en: Niagara Escarpment wall at Big Tub Lighthouse Point (23 m)

notes: Freshwater wreck site, not polar; no species in the list fit (wrecks are the draw), species left empty. Big Tub access is scheduled from Victoria Day weekend (May) to Thanksgiving weekend (October); in-person registration required; diving in the harbours only inside numbered areas. Invasive zebra mussels cover parts of the wrecks. zh name uses 五英寻 (readable) instead of 五噚. · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 卡累利阿岸坎达拉克沙湾，基地多在丘帕一带，乘雪地摩托或船到冰洞下水。冰期约 12–4 月，冰潜多在 2–4 月；水温约 −1°C，能见度可达 30 m，可见软珊瑚、海葵、狼鱼与海带。需干衣与冰潜经验。
summary.en: Kandalaksha Bay on the Karelian shore; bases around Chupa reach holes in the ice by snowmobile or boat. The sea is frozen roughly December–April, with ice dives mostly February–April in water near −1°C and up to 30 m visibility. Expect soft corals, anemones, wolffish in boulder holes and shallow kelp. Drysuit and ice-diving experience needed.

highlights.zh: 从冰洞下水，冰下能见度可达 30 m
highlights.en: Enter through holes cut in the sea ice; up to 30 m visibility

highlights.zh: 软珊瑚与海葵覆盖的岩壁
highlights.en: Walls covered in soft corals and anemones

highlights.zh: 躲在石缝里的狼鱼
highlights.en: Wolffish hiding in boulder holes

highlights.zh: 北极圈边缘的冰海
highlights.en: A frozen sea on the edge of the Arctic Circle

notes: One source (X-Ray Mag): ice Dec–Apr, base Nereis Dive Center in Chupa, sites Kartesh Cape / Chernyshov Is. 30–35 m, Deer Island wreck 18 m; water −1 to 2°C under ice. Feb–Apr window is the usual ice-diving season but not stated explicitly. Lion's mane jellyfish (in the seed 'why') are a summer sighting per search results, not an ice-season one, so left out. Coords are the MSU White Sea Biological Station; Chupa base is ~[33.06, 66.27]. Added species wolffish.

summary.zh: 鹿儿岛以南的奄美群岛主岛，南侧大岛海峡隔开加计吕麻岛。1–3 月座头鲸来此育幼，可观鲸、浮潜共游（通常需持潜水证）；春夏沙底可见星空河豚筑的“海底麦田圈”，多在 30 米左右。
summary.en: Main island of the Amami group south of Kagoshima, with the sheltered Oshima Strait between it and Kakeroma. Humpbacks raise calves here from about late January to March; whale-swim boats usually ask for a scuba licence and calm seas. In spring and summer, white-spotted pufferfish build sand circles, often around 30 m.

highlights.zh: 1–3 月观座头鲸、浮潜共游
highlights.en: Humpback whale watching and swims, Jan–Mar

highlights.zh: 星空河豚筑的“海底麦田圈”
highlights.en: Sand 'mystery circles' built by white-spotted pufferfish

highlights.zh: 约 15 米软珊瑚上的豆丁海马
highlights.en: Pygmy seahorses on soft coral at about 15 m

notes: 两个来源都出自同一家旅行社（Saiyu）。座头鲸季取其行程页：1 月下旬至 3 月上旬数量最多，2–3 月育幼。星空河豚（アマミホシゾラフグ，Torquigener albomaculosus）的来源只证实了 5 月，4–8 月繁殖季是常识推断，待核实；“约 30 米”出自搜索摘要。豆丁海马是日本豆丁海马（Hippocampus japapigu）。新物种：white-spotted-pufferfish。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 深圳东部大鹏半岛南澳一带。杨梅坑鹿嘴的礁石区有成片软珊瑚，西涌乘船可到情人岛，小丑鱼较多。夏季以入门级岸潜、浮潜为主，能见度通常只有数米。
summary.en: On the Dapeng Peninsula in east Shenzhen. Rocky reefs off Luzui at Yangmeikeng carry patches of soft coral, and a short boat ride from Xichong beach reaches Qingren (Lovers') Island, known locally for clownfish. Mostly beginner shore dives and snorkelling in summer; visibility is often only a few metres.

highlights.zh: 杨梅坑鹿嘴礁石区的软珊瑚
highlights.en: Soft coral on the Luzui reefs at Yangmeikeng

highlights.zh: 西涌情人岛的小丑鱼
highlights.en: Clownfish around Qingren Island off Xichong

highlights.zh: 乘船可达的鬼湾“海底花园”
highlights.en: Guiwan (Ghost Bay), a boat-access underwater garden

highlights.zh: 珠三角周末可往返
highlights.en: A weekend trip from the Pearl River Delta

notes: 只有中国日报（2017）一篇来源，季节只写了“夏季适合入门”，5–10 月是按华南常规推的，待核实。本地宝搜索摘要（没读原文）提到杨梅坑片区沙滩曾不开放下海、西涌情人岛能见度约 6 m，出发前要确认现状。小丑鱼列为新物种 clownfish。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 陵水外海小岛，距三亚约80公里，岸边乘船约10分钟登岛。潜点多在7–18米：大小沉船、小战斗机残骸、峭壁和堡礁；水温约20–27°C，能见度通常5–20米，常用作考证。
summary.en: A small island off Lingshui, about 80 km from Sanya and a 10-minute boat ride from the shore. Sites sit mostly at 7–18 m: two sunken boats, a small fighter-jet wreck, a wall and a barrier reef. Water about 20–27°C, visibility usually 5–20 m; widely used for training courses.

highlights.zh: 大小沉船（7–18米）
highlights.en: Two sunken boats at 7–18 m

highlights.zh: 小战斗机残骸（14–16米）
highlights.en: A small fighter-jet wreck at 14–16 m

highlights.zh: 堡礁珊瑚与礁鱼
highlights.en: Barrier-reef corals and reef fish

highlights.zh: 浅水人造景观（3–6米）
highlights.en: Shallow man-made features at 3–6 m

notes: 季节说法互相矛盾：攻略多写 10–次年 4 月风浪小，也有写 5–10 月水下更好、6–9 月台风多；hellodive 只写常年可潜。bestMonths 取两派都不排斥的春秋 3–5、9–11 月，为估计，待潜水中心公示核实。能见度 hellodive 一处写 5–20 m、一处写 15–25 m，取前者。

summary.zh: 台东外海 33 公里的火山岛，富冈乘船 40–50 分钟。黑潮流经、水清，石朗、柴口可岸潜和浮潜。石朗外海 18 米处的「大香菇」是巨型团块珊瑚，2016 年台风后受损、正在复育。东北季风期出船受限。
summary.en: A volcanic island about 33 km off Taitung, 40–50 minutes by ferry from Fugang. The Kuroshio keeps the water clear, and Shilang and Chaikou are easy shore dives and snorkelling spots. Off Shilang at about 18 m stands Big Mushroom, a single giant Porites colony damaged by a 2016 typhoon and now regrowing. North-east monsoon months limit boat trips.

highlights.zh: 石朗外海的「大香菇」巨型珊瑚
highlights.en: Big Mushroom, a giant Porites coral off Shilang

highlights.zh: 石朗、柴口的岸潜与浮潜
highlights.en: Easy shore dives and snorkelling at Shilang and Chaikou

highlights.zh: 公馆鼻一带的海蛞蝓、躄鱼和豆丁海马
highlights.en: Nudibranchs, frogfish and pygmy seahorses around Gongguan on the north side

highlights.zh: 石朗水下约 11.5 米的海底邮筒
highlights.en: An underwater postbox at about 11.5 m off Shilang

notes: 季节有分歧，按管理处取 4–9 月：东部海岸风景区管理处写石朗 4 月（飞鱼）与夏季最宜、柴口 6–8 月（西南季风背风面）；Taiwan Scene 写 4–9 月、10–3 月东北季风船程颠簸宜避开。Underwater360（原载 Asian Diver 2014）写全年可潜、7–9 月台风；AmCham Topics（台湾观光部门供稿）写能见度可达 20 m、不少潜水员偏爱冬季。故冬季并非不能潜，只是出船与潜点受季风限制。水温 22–29°C 取 Underwater360（冬 22–25、夏 26–29）；能见度 10–30 m 综合 AmCham（最高 20 m）与 Underwater360（通常超过 30 m）。大香菇：管理处一页写根部 18 m、另一页写水深 20 m、高约 12 m；Underwater360 写高约 10 m、周长约 31 m；2016 年莫兰蒂台风后受损。豆丁海马 / 躄鱼 / 海蛞蝓来自 Underwater360 的公馆鼻（北岸，3–9 月最佳）与管理处潜点表。没有找到海龟的官方来源，未列。渡轮 40–50 分钟（AmCham，富冈出发）。名称按大陆写法，country 为中国。坐标指向石朗潜水区。垦丁为另一候选，留给第二波。

summary.zh: 八重山最大岛，石垣港乘高速船约40分钟。北侧巴拉斯岛一带适合初学；南侧鹿川湾冬到初夏常见蝠鲼，仲之神岛流急、多洄游鱼；夏秋海况最稳，冬季北风常停船。
summary.en: The largest island of the Yaeyama group, about 40 minutes by fast boat from Ishigaki. Beginner sites lie around Barasu islet in the north; mantas are frequent at Kanokawa Bay in the south from winter to early summer, and Nakano-Ogan has strong current and pelagics. Seas are calmest summer to autumn; winter north winds often cancel boats.

highlights.zh: 鹿川湾的蝠鲼
highlights.en: Manta rays at Kanokawa Bay

highlights.zh: 仲之神岛的洄游鱼群（进阶）
highlights.en: Pelagics at Nakano-Ogan (advanced)

highlights.zh: 5–6月满月后的珊瑚产卵
highlights.en: Coral spawning after the May–June full moons

highlights.zh: 麒麟鱼等微距
highlights.en: Macro such as mandarinfish

notes: Yonara 水道（Manta Way）在西表与小滨岛之间，石垣条目已提到，多由石垣出船。iriomote-tour 是订票站，页面同时写「潜水暂停」，应是该站业务状态。Marine Diving 季节表是图片未能读取；珊瑚产卵它写 5–9 月夜潜，iriomote-tour 写 5–6 月。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 八重山群岛的主岛，那霸飞约 1 小时。西北岸川平石崎的蝠鲼清洁站水浅、几乎无流，新手也能在礁边看蝠鲼盘旋，9–11 月求偶季有机会看到多条追逐。冬季北风大时北岸常出不了船。
summary.en: The main island of the Yaeyama group, about an hour's flight from Naha. Off Kabira Ishizaki on the north-west coast, shallow cleaning stations with almost no current let new divers watch reef mantas circle, and from September to mid-November several may chase each other in courtship. Strong winter northerlies can keep boats off the north side.

highlights.zh: 川平石崎清洁站上盘旋的蝠鲼
highlights.en: Reef mantas circling the Kabira Ishizaki cleaning stations

highlights.zh: 9–11 月蝠鲼求偶追逐
highlights.en: Manta courtship trains, September to November

highlights.zh: 礁上全年可见的海龟
highlights.en: Turtles on the reef all year

highlights.zh: 礁岩下休息的白顶礁鲨
highlights.en: Whitetip reef sharks resting under ledges

notes: 季节：JNTO 写潜水最佳 3–10 月、蝠鲼夏到初秋聚集、冬季海况差；OCVB 写 Manta Scramble 蝠鲼通常 4–11 月；Marine Diving 写 Manta City 4–11 月、Manta Scramble 9 月初–11 月中为求偶季。三者交集 4–10 月；11 月仍可见蝠鲼但北风渐强。Marine Diving 列出 4 个蝠鲼点：川平石崎 Manta Scramble、Manta City、Yonara 水道（小滨岛与西表岛之间，流急，仅限进阶）、Panari Big Corner；冬季北岸停潜时运营商多改去南边水道，此说法来自运营商页面，未作为来源。海龟（全年，川平石崎）与白顶礁鲨（Yonehara W reef）来自 Marine Diving。水温 22–30°C 为运营商常见说法（冬 23–25、夏 28–30），OCVB 冲绳全年均值为 21.5–28.6°C；能见度 15–30 m 为估计，三个来源均未给数字。Manta Scramble 最大水深 25 m、几乎无流、所有级别（Marine Diving）。坐标指向川平石崎外的 Manta Scramble。

summary.zh: 伊豆半岛在东京以西约 100–150 公里，大濑崎是关东潜水员常去的岸潜点：湾内几乎无流，全年开放，天晴时隔着骏河湾能看到富士山。以微距为主，秋季水温最高、鱼多，冬季约 14–16°C，但水更清。
summary.en: The Izu Peninsula lies 100–150 km west of Tokyo, and Osezaki is a favourite shore dive for divers from the Kanto region. The inner bay has almost no current and is open nearly all year, with Mount Fuji across Suruga Bay on clear days. It is mainly a macro site: autumn brings the warmest water and the most fish, while winter drops to 14–16°C but is clearer.

highlights.zh: 湾内岸潜，隔海看富士山
highlights.en: Shore dives in the bay with Mount Fuji across the water

highlights.zh: 躄鱼、虾虎鱼、海蛞蝓等微距生物
highlights.en: Frogfish, gobies and nudibranchs for macro

highlights.zh: 秋季随黑潮来的热带鱼和鰤鱼群
highlights.en: Tropical strays and schools of amberjack in autumn

highlights.zh: 早春偶见翻车鲀，冬季有鮟鱇
highlights.en: Occasional sunfish in early spring, anglerfish in winter

notes: 季节：Marine Diving 大濑崎页（数据截至 2024-10）写秋季（9 月下旬–12 月）水清鱼多、是一年中最好的时候，湾内向导另称冬季（雪富士、人少）是「隐藏的最佳季节」；PADI 日文博客（2017-09）写多数潜水员认为秋季是最佳季节，伊豆、纪伊半岛近海秋季随黑潮和台风来热带鱼；JNTO 静冈潜水指南写冬季能见度极好、秋季伊东有鰤鱼群、大川有热带鱼。取秋季 9–11 月，Marine Diving 的秋季延到 12 月。全年可潜：Marine Diving 写大濑崎几乎不受天气影响，湾内除台风和大型活动外很少关闭；PADI 英文博客（2025-09）写湾内入水点长 200 多米、通常平静少流、四季都有看点；JNTO 写湾内几乎全年平静、适合新手和老手。水温取 Marine Diving：冬（1–3 月）14–16°C、春 16–18°C、夏 18–24°C、秋最高约 26°C 最低约 18°C，冬春建议干衣或 6.5 mm 以上带帽两件式。能见度 5–20 m 为估计（来源无数字；Marine Diving 写秋冬更清，人多时被扬起的泥沙让能见度变差）。物种（Marine Diving）：常驻躄鱼、虾虎鱼、海蛞蝓、剃刀鱼、天竺鲷；春季一本松偶见翻车鲀、佛岩有鹰鳐；夏季岬角偶有双髻鲨、鲸鲨、蝠鲼；冬季海蛞蝓一潜可见几十种、有鮟鱇。规则：在大濑崎自潜需有两名有当地经验者或一名专业级证书持有者在场；岬角（Misaki no Sentan）在大濑神社范围内，只在周末和节假日开放（Marine Diving）。交通：东京乘新干线约 40–55 分钟到三岛，转到沼津站坐公交 1 小时多（每天 2 往返）；夏季有沼津港 30 分钟渡船；自驾约 2 小时 10 分（PADI）。神子元岛双髻鲨（南伊豆，初夏到秋）是另一个独立目的地，未并入。坐标为大濑崎（日文维基百科 35.029°N, 138.788°E）。

summary.zh: 高知县西南端大月町的小岛，有桥连本土，黑潮与丰后水道交汇，记录鱼类逾千种。主潜点后滨似海底日式庭园，珊瑚与温带鱼混生，微距丰富。高知机场转车到宿毛，潜店多可接送。
summary.en: A small island at the south-west tip of Kochi Prefecture, linked to the mainland by bridge, where the Kuroshio meets the Bungo Channel; over 1,000 fish species are recorded. The main site, Ushironohama, looks like an underwater Japanese garden of coral and temperate fish. Fly to Kochi, take the train to Sukumo; shops usually pick up.

highlights.zh: 记录鱼类逾 1000 种
highlights.en: Over 1,000 fish species recorded

highlights.zh: 后滨的“海底日式庭园”
highlights.en: Ushironohama, an underwater Japanese garden

highlights.zh: 五彩鳗、小型乌贼等微距
highlights.en: Ribbon eels, paintpot cuttlefish and other macro

notes: japan.travel 写约 1000 种（占日本鱼种约三分之一），Marine Diving 写 1300 种以上。该页的季节日历是图片，读不到；全年可潜是按黑潮推断，有博客说冬季更清，待核实。同页“冬季低至 2°C”看着不对，没采用。躄鱼、豆丁海马没有来源，未列。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 台湾南端的国家公园，海域包括离岸 1 公里内。黑潮流经，水温约 22–29°C，全年可潜。后壁湖一带入水平缓，常用来带新手和考证；10–3 月东北季风（落山风）强，潜店多改去西岸合界等背风处。
summary.en: The national park at Taiwan's southern tip takes in the sea within 1 km of its coast. The Kuroshio keeps the water at about 22–29°C, so diving runs all year. Gentle entries around Houbihu make it a common place for first dives and courses. When the north-east monsoon blows hard from October to March, operators move to sheltered west-coast sites such as He Jie.

highlights.zh: 后壁湖平缓的岸潜和珊瑚
highlights.en: Easy shore entries and coral around Houbihu

highlights.zh: 南湾深处独立礁上的豆丁海马
highlights.en: Pygmy seahorses on a deep pinnacle in Nan Wan

highlights.zh: 西岸合界：约 20 米的沉船和微距生物
highlights.en: He Jie on the west coast: a wreck at about 20 m and plenty of macro life

notes: 季节：X-Ray Mag #117（Simon Pridmore，2023-01）写潜店全年出船、水从不太冷，夏季黑潮支流带来暖水和更多生物，冬春东北风让南湾太浪，潜店多改去半岛西侧，此时合界最好；Scuba Diver Australasia 2016（Underwater360 转载）写全年、夏季较暖约 29°C、潜水轻松适合培训、有的点有涌；同刊 2014 写绿岛和垦丁全年可潜。三个来源一致，bestMonths 留空（全年）。垦丁国家公园管理处（地域环境页）：水温 22–29.5°C，黑潮流经、水质清澈；10 月到次年 3 月东北季风特强，阵风每秒 10–17 m，俗称落山风；7–9 月常有台风；5–10 月雨量约占全年 82%；核三厂出水口附近约 1 km 的珊瑚有白化。管理处后壁湖页：入水、出水和导航都简单，底质多为细泥沙、新手容易搅浑；有一大丛雀屏珊瑚由当地潜水员维护，鱼不太怕人；后壁湖海洋保护示范区让鱼变多。X-Ray 潜点：南湾独立礁（深水尖礁，豆丁海马、长鞭珊瑚、躄鱼，从后壁湖乘船）、Xiao Lao Gu（海扇、豆丁海马、大礁石）、Nan Hai Dong（洞穴和峡谷，海况允许时）、最常用的岸潜训练点 Wei Yu Qu、西岸合界（约 20 m 沉船，海蛞蝓、躄鱼、海马；从后壁湖开车 15 分钟再走一段石滩，或乘船 40 分钟）；Xiao Lao Gu、Nan Hai Dong、Wei Yu Qu 的中文写法未核实，未写进正文。国家公园海域为离岸 1 km 内、面积 14,891 公顷（管理处认识垦丁页）；夜潜需向管理处申请（海域游憩规范页有夜潜申请单）。能见度 8–25 m 为估计，来源无数字。名称按大陆写法，country 为中国。坐标为后壁湖港。

summary.zh: 那霸泊港乘高速船 35–60 分钟可到的国立公园海域，水色清透，海龟常见，多数潜点平缓、适合新手。5–10 月有蝠鲼到清洁站；12–4 月座头鲸来此繁殖，船上可见，水下有时能听到鲸歌。
summary.en: A national park of small islands 35–60 minutes by fast ferry from Naha's Tomari Port. The water is very clear, turtles are common and most sites are gentle enough for new divers. Mantas visit a cleaning station from May to October; humpback whales breed here from December to April, seen from the boat and sometimes heard underwater.

highlights.zh: 清透的「庆良间蓝」与大片珊瑚
highlights.en: Clear 'Kerama blue' water over broad coral reefs

highlights.zh: 礁上休息、觅食的绿海龟和玳瑁
highlights.en: Green and hawksbill turtles resting and feeding on the reef

highlights.zh: 5–10 月来清洁站的蝠鲼
highlights.en: Manta rays at a cleaning station, May to October

highlights.zh: 冬季船上看座头鲸，水下听鲸歌
highlights.en: Humpbacks from the boat in winter, and their song underwater

notes: 季节：Marine Diving 写最佳为夏到秋；JNTO 冲绳潜水指南写多数岛屿夏到秋最好；OCVB 冲绳潜水指南写 6 月起舒适、夏季最宜出海、8–10 月注意台风、11–2 月北风大。三者一致，取 6–10 月；全年可潜，5 月与 11 月为肩季。座头鲸：环境省 12–4 月、JNTO 12 月下旬–4 月上旬，冬季是看鲸季不是潜水旺季，故不放进 bestMonths。蝠鲼：OCVB 写 Ijyakajya 清洁站 5–10 月；Marine Diving 写 Ugan 夏秋偶见。水温 21–29°C 取 OCVB 冲绳全年均值 21.5–28.6°C（非庆良间单点）。能见度 20–50 m：Marine Diving 写渡嘉敷最高 50 m、Shimosone 夏季 30–50 m，20 m 下限为保守估计。渡轮：JNTO 写最快 35 分钟到渡嘉敷；Marine Diving 写高速船约 1 小时到座间味 / 阿嘉（2020 年 2 月数据）。海龟种类：环境省写绿海龟、玳瑁；OCVB 另提蠵龟。坐标为座间味—阿嘉之间的主潜区。冲绳另一候选与那国岛（冬季双髻鲨，JNTO 写冬到春、Marine Diving 推荐 12–2 月）留给第二波。

summary.zh: 从那霸乘飞机或渡轮前往。东南外海的 Tonbara 岩深约35米、偶有强流，需进阶证，有浪人鲹、梭鱼，冬季可遇双髻鲨；其他潜点常见蝠鲼。全年可潜。
summary.en: Reached from Naha by plane or ferry. Tonbara, a rock off the south-east coast (to 35 m, occasionally strong current, advanced certification), has giant trevally, dogtooth tuna, barracuda and, in winter, hammerheads. Mantas are seen at other sites. Diving runs all year; water about 21–23°C in winter and 25–29°C in summer.

highlights.zh: Tonbara 岩的冬季双髻鲨
highlights.en: Winter hammerheads at Tonbara

highlights.zh: 浪人鲹、梭鱼等洄游鱼
highlights.en: Giant trevally, barracuda and other pelagics

highlights.zh: 蝠鲼
highlights.en: Manta rays

highlights.zh: Shichugama 的洞穴与拱门
highlights.en: Caves and arches at Shichugama

notes: 两页都只写 Tonbara 有双髻鲨、季节性。「冬季」出自搜索摘要（Scubago、Marine Diving 区域页），没有读原文，具体月份待核实。Marine Diving 新闻（en.marinediving.com/?p=10589）写蝠鲼列队求偶通常在 3–4 月。果之滨沙洲是浮潜 / 上岛点，不是水肺潜点；坐标在岛东侧果之滨附近，可改到 Tonbara。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 台东东南外海的小岛，黑潮流经，水清。主要潜点是八代湾的韩国货轮残骸：1983 年沉没，断成三截躺在约 40 米处，桅杆最浅约 20 米，常有流，适合进阶潜水员。台东飞约 25 分钟，也可从富冈乘船。
summary.en: A small island south-east of Taitung, washed by the Kuroshio and known for clear water. The signature dive is a Korean freighter that sank in Badai Bay in 1983 and lies in three pieces at about 40 m, its mast rising to 20 m; currents are common, so it suits advanced divers. Flights from Taitung take about 25 minutes, or there is a ferry from Fugang.

highlights.zh: 八代湾沉船：桅杆约 20 米，船体约 40 米
highlights.en: Badai Bay wreck: mast at about 20 m, hull at about 40 m

highlights.zh: 船身上的大海扇，甲板下住着海龟
highlights.en: Large sea fans on the hull and a turtle living under the deck

highlights.zh: 机场外礁区清澈的水和梭鱼、梅鲷
highlights.en: Clear water with barracuda and fusiliers on the reef off the airport

highlights.zh: 西北岸岸潜点峡谷里的海蛇
highlights.en: Sea snakes in the canyons of a north-west shore dive

notes: 未核实原因：潜水季节说法不一，也没有找到台东县或兰屿乡的官方说法（台东县政府、兰屿乡公所网站从本机连不上，本轮 WebSearch 额度中途用尽）。Asian Diver 2014 年第 5 期（Underwater360 转载，Howard Chen）写最佳为 2–5 月、全年能见度 30–50 m、水温 22–29°C；Scuba Diver Australasia 2016（同站转载）写冬季潜西岸、夏季潜东北岸，水温冬 22°C、夏约 28°C；公视（2025-05）写入夏后东部海域潜水活动变多、鲸鲨约 5 月随水温上升来东部，但在兰屿遇到的机率不高；Wikivoyage 写 11–3 月天气常变差、航班和船班易停。暂取 4–9 月（与相邻绿岛条目按东管处取的 4–9 月一致），有官方或潜店公示的季节后再改。X-Ray Mag #118（Simon Pridmore，2023-04）：八代湾沉船为 1983 年沉没的韩国货轮，断成三截在 40 m，装货桅杆最浅约 20 m，有固定导绳到船尾，常有流，下潜时能见度通常够看清整条船，甲板下住着一只海龟；去八代湾和机场外礁（Airport Perimeter Reef，有梅鲷、梭鱼）多从南边龙门港出船；从东北东清港去的 Warship 有 30–36 m 的海扇、沙底 40 m；西北岸岸潜点 Lady Rock 峡谷里海蛇很多、海洞里有成群的 copper sweeper。Taiwan News 转载《光华》（2024-05）：货轮名 Fortress（中文常称「堡垒号」），约 40 年前由日本开往新加坡途中遇风浪沉没，2023 年小犬台风毁坏了甲板结构；黑潮主流经过兰屿和绿岛，水特别清；船上有大海扇。飞鱼季在春夏，是达悟族文化与信仰的核心（观光署页、X-Ray）；搜索摘要里有自由潜机构称飞鱼季期间限制潜水活动（MS Ocean 页面 403，未核实），出发前要向当地确认。交通：观光署写富冈渔港的船停靠开元港；Wikivoyage 写台东飞兰屿约 25 分钟、每天约 6 班，富冈船程约 2 小时、全年有班，夏季另有后壁湖的船；Asian Diver 写从后壁湖乘渔船近 3 小时。能见度 15–40 m 为保守估计。等级 AOW：主沉船在 20–40 m 且常有流。物种：海龟、梭鱼来自 X-Ray，海扇来自《光华》，用 soft-coral 代表。中文名用大陆通行写法，country 为中国。坐标为八代湾（兰屿机场外侧，机场约 22.028°N, 121.535°E）。

summary.zh: 伊豆半岛下田外海的无人岛，船程 30–60 分钟。黑潮带来暖水，6–10 月常见路氏双髻鲨成群，7–9 月最盛。激流放流潜，适合有经验的潜水员；偶见鹰鳐、翻车鲀、海豚。
summary.en: An uninhabited islet 30–60 minutes by boat off Shimoda on the Izu Peninsula. The warm Kuroshio draws schooling scalloped hammerheads from June to October, peaking July–September. Drift dives in strong current, for experienced divers; eagle rays, ocean sunfish and dolphins turn up at times. Shimoda is about 2.5 hours from Tokyo by limited express.

highlights.zh: 6–10 月路氏双髻鲨群
highlights.en: Schooling scalloped hammerheads, Jun–Oct

highlights.zh: 黑潮激流中的放流潜
highlights.en: Drift dives in the Kuroshio current

highlights.zh: 东京出发可周末往返
highlights.en: A weekend trip from Tokyo

notes: 季节取 bluejapan（6–10 月，7–9 月最盛；水温需高于 20°C）。JAL 套餐页返回 403，搜索摘要写全年可潜、5 月下旬至 11 月上旬最忙、激流、限进阶，与 bluejapan 一致，但没读到原文，所以 verified 为 false。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 伊良部岛和下地岛一带洞穴、拱门密集：魔王宫殿、通池、安东尼·高迪等要求进阶证，W 拱门适合新手。那霸飞约 45 分钟。夏季多潜北侧，冬季为避北风改去南侧，全年都能潜。
summary.en: The reefs around Irabu and Shimoji are riddled with caverns and arches. Satan's Palace, Toriike and Antoni Gaudi call for advanced certification, while W-Arch suits newer divers. Miyako is about 45 minutes by air from Naha. Boats work the north side in summer and move to the south side in winter to avoid the northerlies, so diving runs all year.

highlights.zh: 魔王宫殿：洞顶透光的大洞穴
highlights.en: Satan's Palace, a large cavern lit through openings in its roof

highlights.zh: 通池：穿过隧道进入陆上的池塘，可见淡水与海水分层
highlights.en: Toriike, a tunnel from the sea into an inland pond where fresh and salt water layer

highlights.zh: W 拱门：18 米内的浅拱门，适合新手
highlights.en: W-Arch, shallow arches within 18 m for newer divers

highlights.zh: 八重干濑：一百多片珊瑚礁组成的礁群
highlights.en: Yabiji, a field of more than 100 coral reefs

notes: 季节：Marine Diving 写为避风夏季潜北部、冬季潜南部，八重干濑（Yabiji）为 5 月到 10 月底，南部 Ushi-san 系列洞穴冬季热门；JNTO 宫古岛潜水指南写夏季吹南风时潜伊良部北侧、冬季转到下地岛一侧（原文方向表述混乱）；PADI 日文博客（2020-02）写宫古岛没有河流和山，全年透明度好。三者都表明全年可潜、按风向换边，所以 bestMonths 留空（全年）。另记：JNTO 冲绳总指南写多数岛屿夏到秋最好，OCVB 冲绳潜水指南写 6 月起舒适、8–10 月注意台风、11–2 月北风大，是冲绳整体说法。洞穴数据：OCVB 写 W 拱门 18 m、初学；魔王宫殿 27 m、通池 45 m、安东尼奥·高迪 33 m，三者中级 / 进阶、需进阶证。Marine Diving 写通池最深 40 m、入口约 24 m、入口有盐跃层与温跃层、仅限有经验者；高迪入口约 10 m，再头朝下降到 20 m、几乎无流；W 拱门 18 m、所有级别。日文维基百科：通池两池地下相连，靠海一池深约 45 m，2006 年被定为国家名胜及天然纪念物（未列来源）。中文名：魔王の宮殿 = 魔王宫殿，通り池 = 通池，アントニオ・ガウディ = 安东尼奥·高迪，八重干瀬 = 八重干濑。物种：Marine Diving 写 White City 有玻璃鱼群、中之岛水道有海蛞蝓；JNTO 列全年可见海蛞蝓、麒麟鱼、犬齿金枪鱼群、鲹鱼群、拟乌贼；贴纸用玻璃鱼群代表洞里的小鱼群，第二位用 hard-coral 代表八重干濑。水温 21–29°C 用 OCVB 冲绳全年均值 21.5–28.6°C 估计，能见度 20–40 m 为估计，几个来源都没给数字。交通：那霸约 45 分钟、石垣约 35 分钟、羽田约 3 小时，宫古、池间、伊良部约 80 家潜店，多数接送住处（Marine Diving）。洞穴潜建议带手电。坐标为下地岛西岸洞穴区（通池附近）。

summary.zh: 台北周边最常去的岸潜区，开车约1小时。龙洞湾有礁区、海蛞蝓和鱼群；基隆潮境是保育区，适合初学，3–5月虎纹乌贼产卵，5月起海蛞蝓多。夏季能见度最好，冬季东北季风浪大。
summary.en: Taipei's weekend shore-diving coast, about an hour's drive away. Longdong Bay has reef, nudibranchs and fish; Chaojing in Keelung is a beginner-friendly conservation area where cuttlefish spawn in March–May and nudibranchs appear from May. Summer brings the best visibility; winter north-east swells often stop diving.

highlights.zh: 龙洞湾的海蛞蝓
highlights.en: Nudibranchs at Longdong Bay

highlights.zh: 潮境约22米的海苹果与躄鱼
highlights.en: Sea apples at about 22 m and frogfish at Chaojing

highlights.zh: 春季乌贼产卵
highlights.en: Cuttlefish spawning in spring

highlights.zh: 台北出发1–2小时
highlights.en: 1–2 hours from Taipei

notes: 龙洞与潮境相距约 13 km，合为一条，坐标指龙洞湾；潮境（约 121.80, 25.14）以后可拆成单独条目。taiwanoutdoors 水温：夏 24–29°C、冬 16–19°C；冬季能见度 5–15 m。潮境 2016 年 5 月设望海巷潮境湾资源保育区；潮汐会搅起泥沙，能见度可降到零（bluetrend）。

summary.zh: 东京以南约 1000 公里的世界自然遗产群岛，没有机场，坐小笠原丸约 24 小时。父岛一带常遇飞旋和瓶鼻海豚，二见港的沉船旁有沙虎鲨；2–4 月座头鲸来此。夏季海况最稳，北边的聟岛列岛只在夏季出船。
summary.en: A World Heritage archipelago about 1,000 km south of Tokyo with no airport; the Ogasawara Maru ferry takes about 24 hours. Spinner and bottlenose dolphins are often met around Chichijima, and sand tiger sharks gather at a wreck in Futami Port. Humpbacks visit from February to April. Seas are calmest in summer, the only season boats run to the Mukojima group in the north.

highlights.zh: 水下偶遇飞旋海豚、瓶鼻海豚
highlights.en: Underwater encounters with spinner and bottlenose dolphins

highlights.zh: 二见港沉船旁的沙虎鲨
highlights.en: Sand tiger sharks at a wreck in Futami Port

highlights.zh: 聟岛列岛「金枪鱼洞」里成群的犬齿金枪鱼
highlights.en: Schools of dogtooth tuna at Tuna Hole in the Mukojima group

highlights.zh: 2–4 月座头鲸、8–9 月抹香鲸（船上观赏）
highlights.en: Humpbacks in February–April and sperm whales in August–September, watched from the boat

notes: 季节：PADI 英文博客（2025-08）写聟岛列岛全年基本可潜、5–9 月海况最稳；JNTO 东京潜水指南写聟岛列岛（ケータ列島）距父岛船程约 2 小时，只在夏季海况好时去；X-Ray Mag #90（Don Silcock，网页 2018-04）写 8–9 月天气最好、海面平静；观光厅多语解说文（海豚）写海豚游泳以夏季最佳。取 6–9 月。冬春是看鲸季：X-Ray 写座头鲸 2–4 月，小笠原村观光局活动页写座头鲸观赏团约 12 月底到 5 月，JNTO 写冬到春；座头鲸周围 100 m、抹香鲸周围 50 m 禁止下水靠近（鲸主动游来除外，X-Ray），所以看鲸只写船上观赏。抹香鲸多在父岛东南巽岛外约 10 km 的深水，8–9 月常见（X-Ray）。沙虎鲨：X-Ray 写聚在二见港入口东侧一艘沉船附近，夜里进港觅食，在浮码头灯下就能看到；PADI 写在聟岛列岛。海豚：飞旋海豚和印太瓶鼻海豚（观光厅、X-Ray、UWPG）；观光厅写船只接近海豚群的次数和数量有当地规定。PADI 潜点：父岛 Dobu Iso 海底约 50 m、流强、限进阶；母岛 Horaine 沉船（Daini Saikai Maru）约 20 m、适合新手；嫁岛 Tuna Hole 顶部约 10 m、底约 50 m，旺季可达上百条犬齿金枪鱼。交通：东京竹芝码头乘小笠原丸约 24 小时（JNTO、GO TOKYO、X-Ray；UWPG 2018 写约 26 小时）；GO TOKYO 写旺季 3–4 天一班、其余时间每周一班；PADI 写 2025-04 起 11:00 开船、次日 11:00 到父岛。2011 年列入世界自然遗产（PADI）。水温 20–28°C 为估计（UWPG 写 5 月 22–25°C）；能见度 20–40 m 为估计。等级定 AOW：大物点流强（Dobu Iso、聟岛），但母岛沉船和父岛礁区新手也能潜。X-Ray 评价父岛珊瑚礁状况很好，但潜水「不算惊艳」，大物和鲸看运气。坐标为父岛二见港。

summary.zh: 恩纳村的真荣田岬是本岛有名的潜点，青之洞窟入口约 5–6 米深，阳光从洞口照进来一片蓝。可以走 65 级台阶岸潜，也可从附近港口乘船，常与浮潜客同场。南边砂边海堤一带入水平缓，适合体验潜水。
summary.en: Cape Maeda in Onna is one of the main island's best-known dives: the mouth of the Blue Cave sits at 5–6 m, and sunlight turns the cavern blue. Divers walk down 65 steps to the water or come by boat from nearby ports, often alongside snorkellers. Further south, the Sunabe seawall offers easy entries for try-dives.

highlights.zh: 青之洞窟里透进来的蓝光
highlights.en: Blue light filtering into the Blue Cave

highlights.zh: 洞外的礁区和陡坡，偶见苏眉和海龟
highlights.en: Reef and drop-offs outside the cave, with the odd Napoleon wrasse or turtle

highlights.zh: 砂边海堤：软珊瑚和小丑鱼，适合体验潜水
highlights.en: Sunabe seawall: soft corals and anemonefish, good for try-dives

highlights.zh: 古宇利岛外约 40 米的埃蒙斯号残骸（50 潜以上）
highlights.en: The USS Emmons wreck at about 40 m off Kouri, for divers with 50+ dives

notes: 本条不在本轮清单里：清单 13 处中 6 处已在库（庆良间、石垣、绿岛、涠洲、蜈支洲、济州），分界洲岛第一波已明确不选，只剩 7 处，所以补了冲绳本岛作第 8 条——大陆游客到冲绳最常去的潜点之一，和庆良间分开预订；不需要可整条删除。季节：JNTO 冲绳潜水指南写多数岛屿夏到秋最好；OCVB 冲绳潜水指南写 6 月起舒适、夏季最适合、8–10 月注意台风、11–2 月北风大。取 6–10 月，与庆良间条目一致；这是冲绳整体说法，没有来源写真荣田岬单点的季节（Marine Diving 季节表是图片）。OCVB 本岛潜点页：真荣田岬最深 40 m、岸潜和船潜、流中等、初学级，青之洞窟有阳光透入，洞外有陡坡和大片礁区，偶见苏眉和海龟；砂边从砂边海堤入水、25 m、几乎无流、适合体验潜，礁顶有软珊瑚；南部大度海岸（John Man Beach）遇到海龟的机率高。Marine Diving：真荣田岬所有级别、最深 30 m、流有时强；洞口约 4 m 宽、5–6 m 深，往里继续变深（页面写到 50 m，所指不明）；洞口附近有约 10 m 宽、顶部透光的气室；西海岸潜店乘船来（前兼久港 20 分钟、恩纳港 30 分钟），那霸一带潜店从岸上下 65 级台阶入水；砂边 No.1 最深 20 m，软珊瑚里有小丑鱼，2016 年 4 月设了水下邮筒；USS Emmons 沉船限进阶、需 50 潜以上，页面写最深 35 m、残骸约 40 m，古宇利港出发 20 分钟。机场到恩纳 / 读谷约 70 分钟车程。水温 21–29°C 取 OCVB 冲绳全年均值 21.5–28.6°C；能见度 15–30 m 为估计。物种中海龟种类来源未写明，按本岛常见种用 green-turtle。坐标为真荣田岬。

summary.zh: 澎湖南部的海洋国家公园（东吉、西吉、东屿坪、西屿坪），需乘船前往。记录珊瑚200多种、覆盖率高，东屿坪一带有「薰衣草森林」珊瑚群；海流强。3月下旬至8月底东北季风减弱，较适合潜水。
summary.en: A marine national park of four islands south of Penghu (Dongji, Xiji, Dongyuping, Xiyuping), reached by boat. Over 200 coral species are recorded, with high cover; the 'lavender forest' coral field off Dongyuping is the best-known spot. Currents are strong. Late March to August, once the north-east monsoon eases, is the usual season.

highlights.zh: 东屿坪「薰衣草森林」珊瑚群
highlights.en: The 'lavender forest' coral field off Dongyuping

highlights.zh: 200多种珊瑚、覆盖率高
highlights.en: Over 200 coral species with high cover

highlights.zh: 西吉屿蓝洞
highlights.en: Blue cave at Xiji

highlights.zh: 大型鱼群
highlights.en: Large fish schools

notes: 没有读到官方原文。公园内潜水需向海洋国家公园管理处申请，旅游攻略称开放期 4/1–9/30（taiwantour.net，未读原文），故 bestMonths 取 4–9 月。维基导游写 3 月下旬–8 月底适合、能见度 5–8 m，是澎湖整体的说法。东吉、西吉靠近黑水沟，珊瑚覆盖较低（求真百科摘要）。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 香港的珊瑚群落集中在不受珠江淡水影响的东部水域。西贡一带的桥咀洲、果洲和海下湾海岸公园是本地常去的潜点，海下湾记录到 64 种石珊瑚。能见度受风和潮水影响大，可能突然降到 2–3 米。
summary.en: Hong Kong's coral communities are concentrated in its eastern waters, away from the Pearl River's fresh water. Around Sai Kung, Sharp Island, the Ninepins and Hoi Ha Wan Marine Park are regular local dive sites, and Hoi Ha Wan alone has 64 recorded hard coral species. Wind and tide can cut visibility to 2–3 m with little warning.

highlights.zh: 海下湾海岸公园的石珊瑚群落
highlights.en: Hard coral communities in Hoi Ha Wan Marine Park

highlights.zh: 东部水域 20–25 米深处的柳珊瑚
highlights.en: Sea fans at 20–25 m in the eastern waters

highlights.zh: 东北水域东平洲海岸公园的 65 种石珊瑚
highlights.en: 65 hard coral species at Tung Ping Chau Marine Park to the north-east

notes: 未核实原因：没有找到写潜水季节的来源（旅发局 discoverhongkong.com、WWF 香港页面都返回 403，本轮 WebSearch 额度中途用尽）。暂取 5–10 月，依据是天文台 1991–2020 年月平均海面温度：北角 / 横澜岛 5–10 月 24.7–27.4°C，11 月约 24°C，12 月约 20°C，1–3 月 17.0–18.7°C；冬季需要厚湿衣或干衣（估计）。需要本地潜水机构或旅发局的说法再改。来源要点：渔护署海下湾页——1996 年 7 月首批海岸公园、约 260 公顷、在西贡西郊野公园以北，浮潜和水肺潜水很受欢迎，不要站在珊瑚上；海下湾生态页——香港 80 多种石珊瑚中有 64 种，最好的点超过 50 种，珊瑚鱼类 120 多种；珊瑚问答页——最丰富的珊瑚群落在东部水域（不受珠江影响），柳珊瑚 26 种、多在东部 20–25 m，黑珊瑚 8 种、多在东北部 10–20 m，常见的珊瑚区生物包括螺类和海蛞蝓；东平洲生态页——2001 年设立，65 种石珊瑚、130 多种礁鱼（东平洲在大鹏湾，属东北水域、不算西贡，只放在看点里）。中国香港潜水总会（HKUA，CMAS 香港区总部）安全提示页列出常见潜点：牛尾洲、桥咀洲、赤洲、果洲、东平洲、海下、鹅眉洲、白腊仔，并提醒能见度会因潮水和风向瞬间急降；其《休闲潜水安全手册》（2009-05）写本港潜点大多在东部和东北部海岸、易受强季风影响，能见度可降到 2–3 m，沉船多在海下湾、印洲塘、外牛尾海、滘西等低能见度或航道区，只有海下湾和尖洲少数沉船适合休闲潜水。能见度 2–10 m 为估计。水温取月均值 17–27°C，夏季个别日子会更高。等级 OW。坐标为西贡市中心码头，作为去东边各岛的出发点。country 为中国。

summary.zh: 西归浦港外约 1.3 公里的蚊岛一带受暖流影响，岩壁长满紫红色软珊瑚，也有亚热带鱼群。水温偏低、流常较急，要看潮水下潜。9–10 月水暖、能见度较好。2024、2026 年夏季部分软珊瑚出现倒伏。
summary.en: Munseom and its neighbouring islets lie about 1.3 km off Seogwipo harbour. Warm currents let purple and red soft corals cover the walls, with subtropical fish alongside. The water is cool and currents are often strong, so dives are timed to the tide. September and October bring the warmest water and best visibility. Some soft corals slumped in the summers of 2024 and 2026.

highlights.zh: 岩壁上成片的紫红色软珊瑚
highlights.en: Walls carpeted in purple and red soft corals

highlights.zh: 礁石间穿梭的雀鲷鱼群
highlights.en: Schools of damselfish weaving between the rocks

highlights.zh: 西归浦港出船几分钟就到潜点
highlights.en: Dive sites a few minutes by boat from Seogwipo harbour

notes: 季节：Korea Herald（2025-08）写 9–10 月水暖、能见度最好；京乡新闻（2001-04）写春季海藻融化、能见度不如秋季，春季成山浦水温约 15°C。两者都指向秋季，取 9–10 月；6 月中–7 月底为梅雨。每日新闻（2014）称一年四季都有人潜，并写软珊瑚覆盖 15–60 m 岩壁、平潮最好潜、新手宜选小潮。Visit Jeju（济州观光公社）：蚊岛在西归浦港以南 1.3 km，有 92 种珊瑚虫类、成片的棘穗软珊瑚类（Dendronephthya，밤수지맨드라미、자색수지맨드라미 等），可见雀鲷（자리돔）群；섶섬（Seopseom）多分枝状硬珊瑚，所以第二物种用 hard-coral。中文名「蚊岛」取自 Visit Jeju 中文页正文（该页标题误作「秃岛」），没有用虎岛 / 森岛等未核实的译名。风险：fnnews（2026-08-26）报道市民科学调查在蚊岛「见面广场」10–25 m 调查区超过 50% 出现软珊瑚倒伏，2024 年也有过，原因未定（高水温、低盐度等）；建议每年复查。管控：文化财厅 2021-12 把出入限制扩大到海域（含水肺），2023-04-07 恢复原范围，现按济州道管理指南执行（NewsSeoul 2023-11）。等级定为 OW：Korea Herald 称 10–30 m 适合休闲与进阶潜水员，Visit Jeju 也列有无证体验潜；但流急时不适合新手，범섬（Beomseom）尤其如此（每日新闻 2020），选潜点要听向导。水温 14–26°C、能见度 5–20 m 为估计。坐标为蚊岛。

name.zh: 知床流冰潜水（宇登吕·罗臼）

summary.zh: 北海道知床半岛。2–3 月鄂霍次克海流冰靠岸，宇登吕一侧在冰面开洞下潜，看海天使（裸海蝶）；罗臼一侧以昆布林潜水为主。水温约 -2°C，需干衣经验，冰况和风暴可能导致取消。
summary.en: On the Shiretoko Peninsula, Hokkaido. In February–March drift ice from the Sea of Okhotsk packs the Utoro coast, and divers enter through holes cut in the ice to see sea angels (Clione). The Rausu side is known for kelp diving. Water is near -2°C; operators usually ask for drysuit experience, and ice or storms can cancel dives.

highlights.zh: 在流冰上开洞下潜
highlights.en: Entry through holes cut in the drift ice

highlights.zh: 海天使（裸海蝶）
highlights.en: Sea angels (Clione)

highlights.zh: 罗臼的昆布林
highlights.en: Kelp forest diving at Rausu

notes: 坐标从罗臼（145.2, 44.02）改到宇登吕近海：日本环境省页面写流冰潜水在宇登吕，罗臼是昆布林潜水。环境省写 2–3 月；JAL 页返回 403、PADI 博客不可引用，两者的搜索摘要都写 2–3 月，并提到 -2°C 水温、OW 加 20 次干衣潜水的门槛、偶见海豹。宇登吕的潜店是 Robinson Diving Service。新物种：clione。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 北部湾里的火山岛，北海乘船约 1.5 小时。岛周浅海是珊瑚礁国家级海洋公园，以跟教练的体验潜为主，可见鹿角珊瑚、柳珊瑚和小鱼群，能见度多为几米。4–5 月前后风浪小、水最清；冬春可乘船出海看布氏鲸。
summary.en: A volcanic island in the Beibu Gulf, about 90 minutes by ferry from Beihai. Its shallow reefs form a national marine park, dived mostly as guided try-dives among staghorn corals, sea fans and small fish; visibility is usually a few metres. The sea is calmest and clearest around April and May, and boats go out to look for Bryde's whales in winter and spring.

highlights.zh: 春季风平浪静时清澈的「玻璃海」
highlights.en: Glass-clear water on calm spring days

highlights.zh: 浅水区的鹿角珊瑚、柳珊瑚和珊瑚修复区
highlights.en: Staghorn corals, sea fans and coral-restoration plots in the shallows

highlights.zh: 冬春乘船寻找布氏鲸（船上观赏）
highlights.en: Boat trips to look for Bryde's whales in winter and spring, watched from the deck

highlights.zh: 火山岩塑造的海底地形
highlights.en: A seabed shaped by volcanic rock

notes: 季节：国际在线（转广西日报，2025-06）写「玻璃海」每年 3–5 月出现在蓝桥一带，风平浪静、泥沙不起；中国气象局（中国气象报，2020-11）写 4–5 月东南风、天气温和，6–9 月西南季风浪大、7–9 月大风台风最多，冬季北风风速全年最大，海上 7 级以上停航。两者都指向 4–5 月，取 4–5 月；3 月雾多（气象局：雾集中在 12–4 月，2–3 月最多），9–11 月有攻略推荐但无官方来源。广西文旅厅、广西海洋局、北海市政府网站从本机连不上（gxzf.gov.cn 超时 / 被重置），改用央媒与气象局；文旅厅转载的《中国旅游报》称岛上有浮潜、岸潜、船潜，因未能打开未列为来源。水温：气象局写 6–9 月海水接近 30°C，冬季 18°C 为攻略常见值（无官方数字）。能见度：央视（2025-12）写深潜平台水下能见度超过 5 米；中国日报转人民日报（2019-11）写天气差时不到 1 米，3–10 m 为估计。人民日报（2019）：62 种珊瑚、近岸珊瑚礁近 3000 公顷、海洋公园 2012 年 12 月设立、北海国际客运港乘船约 90 分钟。布氏鲸：新华社（2024-03）写 1–4 月几乎每天可见十几头，央视写 12 月到次年 4 月概率较大；只在船上看，潜水看不到，故排第二。新物种 hard-coral / brydes-whale / soft-coral 见 newSpecies。坐标为岛南侧（南湾—石螺口之间）。

summary.zh: 三亚湾内的小岛，距市区约8海里，乘船约15分钟。属三亚珊瑚礁保护区，潜区水深约3–12米，能见度约8–15米，以浅水珊瑚礁和体验潜水为主。
summary.en: An island in Sanya Bay, about 8 nautical miles from the city and roughly 15 minutes by boat. It lies in the Sanya coral reef reserve; the dive area is shallow, about 3–12 m, with visibility around 8–15 m, and is mostly used for try dives over coral reef.

highlights.zh: 浅水珊瑚礁（3–12米）
highlights.en: Shallow coral reef at 3–12 m

highlights.zh: 适合体验潜水
highlights.en: Suited to try dives

highlights.zh: 三亚珊瑚礁保护区
highlights.en: Inside the Sanya coral reef reserve

notes: 只有一个低质量攻略来源（tttl.cn，写 10–4 月最佳、7–9 月台风停潜），与蜈支洲岛条目所据中国日报「三亚 4–10 月最佳」相反；为与三亚其他条目一致取 4–10 月，待官方来源核实。8 海里、肖旗港出发见搜索摘要（新浪博客），未读原文。

summary.zh: 三亚海棠湾内的小岛，从浅水体验潜到 OW、AOW 课程都有。南侧珊瑚礁保护较好，体验潜一般在 3–8 米。海洋牧场和游客种珊瑚在持续修复礁区。能见度随天气变化大，节假日游客多。
summary.en: A small island in Sanya's Haitang Bay offering everything from shallow try-dives to open-water and advanced courses. The better-kept reef is on the south side, and try-dives stay at 3–8 m. A marine ranch and visitor coral-planting are slowly rebuilding the reef. Visibility swings with the weather, and holidays are busy.

highlights.zh: 南侧浅水区的珊瑚礁
highlights.en: Coral reef in the shallows on the south side

highlights.zh: 跟着教练在海底种一株珊瑚

notes: 未核实原因：只有中国日报（海南记者站，2026-04-12）明确写「每年 4 月至 10 月是三亚海域最佳潜水期」，是三亚整体而非蜈支洲岛单点；另一个写季节的 intotravelchina.com（4–11 月）是商业旅行社页面，未列为来源；中国天气网（2009）只写水温常年 21–27°C。需要第二个官方来源（三亚旅文局、海南省旅文厅或潜水中心公示）再改 true。景区官网票务页：能见度 6–27 m、南部海域珊瑚礁保护较好、珊瑚礁潜水 3–8 m / 25 分钟 / 7–60 岁；能见度取 6–20 m，27 m 是最好情况（人民日报海外版 2020 也写最高 27 m）。三亚旅文局（2025-10，转三亚日报）：2021 年起游客累计移植珊瑚超 3 万株。中国日报（2022-03）：国家级海洋牧场示范区，可考 PADI OW / AOW 与自由潜。水温 22–30°C 为估计。物种：来源只写「形态各异的珊瑚」、石斑鱼、海参、龙虾等，没有海龟的可靠来源，所以用新增的 hard-coral / soft-coral。没选陵水分界洲岛（任务给的二选一），它有圈养海豚项目，且不在三亚。坐标为蜈支洲岛。

summary.zh: 屏东东港外的珊瑚礁小岛，绿海龟多，杉福渔港一带岸潜常见。杉福沉船断成两截，船头约15米、船尾约19米；美人洞可岸潜。水温全年约25°C，7–8月台风。
summary.en: A small coral island off Donggang, Pingtung, with many green turtles, often seen on shore dives around Shanfu harbour. The broken Shanfu wreck lies in two parts at about 15 m (bow) and 19 m (stern); Beauty Cave is a shore dive in the north-west. Water is around 25°C all year; typhoons in July and August.

notes: 季节有分歧：X-Ray Mag 写 11–4 月最佳、7–8 月台风；twosevenths 写 4–10 月，又称 11–12 月人少、能见度 10–30 m。两者都写全年水温约 25°C，故给全年。坐标从岛中央移到西岸杉福渔港。禁止触摸海龟，违者罚款（twosevenths）。 · waterTempC / visibilityM estimated from the sea region, not sourced

summary.zh: 三亚市区以东的海湾，从亚龙湾码头乘船15–20分钟到东排、西排两个潜点。西排以软珊瑚、柳珊瑚和鱼群为主，东排以鹿角、脑珊瑚等硬珊瑚为主；能见度约10–18米。
summary.en: A bay east of Sanya city. Boats from the Yalong Bay pier take 15–20 minutes to the two main sites: Xipai, with soft corals, sea fans and fish schools, and Dongpai, with staghorn, brain and table corals. Visibility around 10–18 m; water about 22–28°C depending on season.

notes: 季节有分歧：hellodive 只给水温（4–10 月 26–28°C，11–4 月 22–26°C）；tttl.cn 写 10–4 月最佳。取 4–10 月与蜈支洲岛条目一致。别名里的大东海 / 小东海是另一处海湾，未并入；野猪岛两个来源都没写。坐标指东排、西排一带。

summary.zh: 日本最西端的岛，那霸飞约 1.5 小时。冬季西崎外常有成群双髻鲨，多为放流，流急，需要进阶经验。南岸新川鼻外的「海底遗迹」是阶梯状巨岩，1986 年被发现，是天然还是人工至今有争议。
summary.en: Japan's westernmost island, about 90 minutes by air from Naha. In winter, schools of hammerheads gather off Cape Irizaki; the dives are drifts in strong current and need advanced experience. Off the south coast lies the 'Underwater Ruins', a stepped rock formation found in 1986 whose origin, natural or man-made, is still argued over.

notes: 季节：JNTO 景点页写 12–2 月可见双髻鲨；JNTO 冲绳潜水指南写与那国和其他岛相反，看遗迹和鲨群冬到春最好；OCVB 潜点页写 Hammerhead Rock 约 11 月到 5 月上旬，OCVB 岛页写 11–4 月、最多约 100 条；Marine Diving 地区页写西崎与遗迹宜 12–5 月，其 2020-01 报道写 12–5 月有大群、当季几乎天天见、有时超过 200 条。取各方都覆盖的 12–4 月，11 月与 5 月算肩季。冬季北风大时其他点关闭，南岸遗迹点仍可潜（Marine Diving）。鲨鱼点：西崎（Irizaki）一带，Marine Diving 写 25–30 m、流有时很强、中级以上，要快速下潜、上升后抓船绳；OCVB 写 Hammerhead Rock 35 m、需进阶证；PADI 日文博客（2024-09，未列来源）写近年九部良也能看到。OCVB 岛页写周围没有礁盘挡流，多数潜点只适合进阶潜水员。海底遗迹：OCVB 写 1986 年发现、深 25 m、列为初学可潜（指体验潜）；Marine Diving 写最深 17 m、中级以上、流有时强、距久部良港 20 分钟，北风季也能潜；X-Ray Mag（2013）写约 20 m 处有穿越洞。成因 JNTO、OCVB 都写天然与人工两说并存；日文维基百科称水下考古与地貌学界多认为是天然地形（未列为来源）。遗迹约在 123.01°E, 24.44°N（新川鼻外），坐标取西崎—久部良港一带的鲨鱼点。物种：几个来源都只写 hammerhead，没写种名，贴纸沿用 species.json 的路氏双髻鲨；Marine Diving 列双髻鲨、梭鱼、犬齿金枪鱼、大眼鲹、旗鱼、偶见鲸鲨；JNTO 写鲸鲨罕见，未列。水温 22–29°C 为估计（X-Ray 1 月记 23°C；OCVB 冲绳全年均值 21.5–28.6°C）；能见度 20–50 m，Marine Diving 写海况好时超过 50 m。交通：那霸约 1.5 小时每天 1 班、石垣约 35 分钟每天 3 班；石垣渡轮约 4–4.5 小时、每周 2 班，常颠簸（Marine Diving、JNTO）。
